rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Independent Media

Independent Media comprises The Independent, Standard Digital, Bulletin, BuzzFeed UK, HuffPost UK, Tasty UK, Seasoned, IndyBest and indy100.

Harnessing market-leading innovation and excellence across its portfolio of pioneering brands, Independent Media has unrivalled scale, integrity and authority via its sites, apps, video, audio, experiential, newsletters and social media.

While each Independent Media brand speaks in an authentic, unique voice to a loyal and distinct audience, they stand together in their commitment to positivity, inclusivity, and quality journalism and content.

Independent Media’s network reaches 650 million users each month, with 1.1 billion content views across its brands and platforms, including web, apps, social media, podcasts, email, YouTube, syndication partners and print.

The role and the team

As a Data Analyst, you will support the Digital Analytics team in providing reporting, analysis and insight across Independent Media, with a particular focus on understanding how our journalism and content performs across our digital platforms and syndication partners.

Working closely with analysts and stakeholders across Editorial, Audience, Product, Commercial Licensing & Syndication and Marketing teams, you will help produce regular performance reporting, maintain dashboards and respond to day-to-day analytical requests.

This would suit someone with some experience working with digital or audience data who is looking to develop their career in analytics within a fast-paced news and publishing environment.

You will be responsible for:

Compile regular editorial and management reports using key audience and content data sources.Support the Licensing & Syndication team with reporting and analysis to understand how our content performs across third-party and off-platform partners.Support analysis of website traffic, audience engagement, search, social media and video performance.Work with the Customer Analytics and Marketing teams to track and analyse marketing activity, helping to understand how campaigns drive users through the registration and subscription funnels and increase audience frequency and engagement.Use GA4 and other analytics platforms to investigate changes and trends in audience behaviour.Help maintain BI dashboards and recurring reports used by stakeholders across the business.Monitor performance and highlight significant or unusual changes that may require further investigation.Support the team with ad hoc analytical requests, ensuring outputs are accurate and delivered within agreed deadlines.Work with editorial and audience teams to help them understand how their content is performing.Use SEO and search performance tools to understand how content performs through search e.g. Google Search ConsoleAnalyse social media performance using relevant platform metrics and analytics tools e.g. SupermetricsHelp ensure reporting definitions and methodologies are applied consistently.Carry out appropriate quality assurance and sense-checking before data or analysis is shared.Develop a working knowledge of the databases, analytics platforms and reporting tools used across the business.Handle data responsibly and securely, in accordance with GDPR, the Data Protection Act and the Company’s Code of Conduct.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We champion diversity in our teams and in our reporting. As a growing and global brand, we must have a workforce that’s more representative of our readers, viewers, clients and partners, and a workplace that creates a sense of belonging for everyoneWe are committed to hiring and developing a diverse workforce regardless of background, and we support our people to thrive in their careers here.

The Independent is an equal opportunities employer, if you require any reasonable adjustments to complete your application, please do not hesitate to advise us accordingly.

About You

You are curious, analytical and have a strong attention to detail. You enjoy solving problems and investigating why something has happened rather than simply reporting the numbers.

You have an interest in news, digital publishing and how audiences discover and engage with content online. You will have some previous experience in an analytics, insights, digital marketing or similar role and be keen to develop your skills further.

You should be comfortable working with data and able to communicate your findings clearly to colleagues with different levels of data knowledge.

Essential Skills And Experience

Degree level, ideally in a numerate, analytical or relevant subject.Around 1-2 years’ experience in an analytics, insights, digital marketing or similar data-focused role.Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, reliable work.Strong problem-solving skills and a curious approach to data, with an interest in understanding the reasons behind changes in performance.Experience using GA4 or another digital analytics platform, such as Adobe Analytics.Good working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets.An interest in news, digital publishing and audience behaviour.An ability to interpret data and communicate findings clearly to non-technical colleagues.Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple requests and deadlines.Good written and verbal communication skills.A collaborative approach and willingness to learn new tools and techniques.

Desirable Skills And Experience

Experience analysing social media metrics across platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, TikTok or YouTube.Experience working with BI or visualisation tools such as Domo, Looker, Tableau or Power BI.Some knowledge of SQL or an interest in developing SQL skills.Experience working with content, audience or editorial data.Previous experience within digital publishing, media or a newsroom environment.Familiarity with tools such as Chartbeat or other real-time audience analytics platforms.An understanding of how SEO, social media and other referral channels contribute to digital audience growth.Key responsibilities and accountabilities

Our values – you will deliver across all our values

Inclusive: We champion diversity in our teams and in our reporting. Working as a team, we put transparency and effective communication at the heart of everything we do.

Innovative: From the very beginning, The Independent has been breaking the mould. We take risks and are always looking to try new ideas in pursuit of excellence.

Independent: Nobody tells us what to think; we make up our own minds and aren’t afraid to do things differently. Like our readers, we value honesty and integrity above outside influences.

rows.title: 2027 Industry Placement, Marketing
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are  

FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.

At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.

Are you ready to make your impact?

About The Role

Are you passionate about marketing and delivering high-quality results? Are you looking to work on a wide range of marketing projects, and gain exposure to all aspects of the marketing mix? We’re looking for an intern to join our UK & Ireland Corporate marketing team, to help support delivery and implementation of the UK & Ireland and EMEA marketing strategy, as well as to provide operational support on the day-to-day running of the function.

You will have a busy, diverse, hands-on-role which will touch on all aspects of the marketing programme, from supporting planning processes through to implementation and delivery of key initiatives. You will work closely with the EMEA marketing leader, senior marketing executive, the UK & Ireland segment marketing teams, country marketing teams and the global functional marketing teams. You will also work with senior stakeholders in the business and key account teams, to help support strategic marketing initiatives across our key buyer groups.

A successful candidate is someone who will thrive in a fast-paced, professional team environment. This person must be able to interact and communicate with individuals at all levels of the organization and have the ability to juggle multiple, competing tasks and demands, with strong attention to detail.

What You'll Do

Support the UK & Ireland marketing team to ensure efficient planning, execution, and measurement of campaigns and initiatives as part of our UK & Ireland marketing strategy, working with the relevant functional marketing teams as required.Help to ensure consistency of ‘best in class’ approach to larger marketing investments, including assisting with setup and preparation of briefing calls and briefing packs.Support UK & Ireland corporate marketing team with preparation of presentations and regular reporting for EMEA business leadership and global marketing leadership, ensuring formatting and branding is in line with company templates and standards.Assist with digital and website content development and maintenance, including review of service, industry and biography webpages.Help to create compelling and innovative communications that meets various internal and external messaging needs, including drafting of client mailings, newsletters and social media posts.Support events management for internal team events and external client events, including conferences, seminars, roundtable breakfasts/dinners, and networking drinks/dinners.Assist with production of collateral, including proofreading and liaising with creative and content teams.Conduct market and competitor research to inform marketing strategies and activities.Assist with other day-to-day team tasks and ad hoc projects, including web and email enquiries, management of shared mailboxes, processing invoices, etc.Building social media assets and copy for any upcoming marketing activations.Organise upcoming tasks for the team and recording key updates in meetings.Work with segment marketing teams on UK&I marketing campaigns as required.

How You'll Grow

We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on-the-job learning, self-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth.

As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.

Basic Qualifications

What You Will Need to Succeed

Applicants must be completing a sandwich course at university and due to graduate in 2029Applicants must be available for this placement year from 6th September 2027 to 25th August 2028Applicants must be predicted a 2:1 or above final grade (or equivalent) for their degreeApplicants should be proficient in Microsoft Office applications (particularly PowerPoint and Excel)Ability to prioritise and manage time, workload and projects effectivelyStrong communication abilities, both verbally and in writing and comfortable communicating at all levels of an organisationWillingness to learn how to navigate a complex organisation and establish networks, with excellent stakeholder management skillsProactive workload management – Demonstrates the ability to prioritise tasks effectively, make time for important work, and proactively seek clarification or support when needed to keep work progressing and ensure deadlines are met.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience in a marketing or corporate environment, ideally professional services or B2BPrior experience in events management, including online events.Experience in assisting with the creation and co-ordination of collateral both digital and paper basedExperience with using Eloqua (Oracle email marketing) or similar packagesExperience with using Salesforce (CRM Sales Cloud) or similar packagesLeadership experience desirable – Experience of taking on leadership or responsibility is desirable, whether gained through employment, education or extracurricular activities. This could include leading a sports team, contributing to a university society, taking responsibility in a hospitality role, participating in military youth programmes, volunteering, or other team-based activities

Our Application Process

The deadline for applications is 29th October 2026

STEP 1: Complete our online application form and submit your CV (no cover letter required).

STEP 2: Complete a pre-recorded video interview.

STEP 3: Attend a competency based In Person interview and written task to explore your skills and motivations in our Offices in London on the 25th of November 2026.

STEP 4: Attend a 2nd virtual interview with our senior managers between 1st – 10th December 2026.

STEP 5: Job offers are made to successful candidates before Christmas.

FTI Consulting is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, protected veteran status, religion, physical or mental disability, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation.

rows.title: User Acquisition Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Miniclip is looking for a User Acquisition Specialist to join our Marketing team in our London (UK) Office.

What will you be doing at Miniclip?

This is a varied and exciting role, working with a leading digital games and entertainment company. You will work closely with our existing UA team, with the following responsibilities

 Managing the full UA process for a mobile game Planning and execution of user acquisition campaigns  Oversee acquisition marketing campaigns across multiple mobile channels  Produce comprehensive UA reporting, analyse ROI and identify new opportunities to support key titles  Experiment and analyse campaigns for existing and upcoming games  Running multiple marketing tests and present results to stakeholders with concrete recommendations  Use data-driven insights to enhance performance through sub-publisher optimisation, customised targeting and segmentation  Develop briefings for new ad creatives and oversee the production of marketing material  Manage business relationships with day-to-day communication and reporting 

What are we looking for?

 Minimum 6 months of experience in paid digital marketing or media buying required  Prior experience in app business or gaming  Knowledge of marketing channels such as Facebook, Tiktok, Google Ads, Applovin, Unity  Experience with tracking tools like Appsflyer for mobile ad campaigns is a significant advantage  Having prior exposure to a soft launch will greatly benefit the candidate  Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal in English 

About Miniclip

Miniclip is a global leader in games and one of the world's biggest developers and publishers of mobile games, with a mission of unleashing the gamer in everyone. It distributes highly engaging games to a global audience of over 450 million monthly and 60 million daily active users across mobile, PC, console, social, and online platforms. Operating in 15 countries, Miniclip develops and launches games in multiple categories across its 22 studios.

Founded in 2001 with an internationally recognised brand name, Miniclip has successfully grown a global audience across 195 countries and six continents. It has a unique understanding of the games space, developing and distributing a strong portfolio of over 60 high-quality mobile games globally.

To date, Miniclip’s studios and companies have generated more than 12 billion downloads, including the following games 8 Ball Pool, Subway Surfers, Golf Battle, Football Strike, Carrom Pool, OSM - Online Soccer Manager™, Football Rivals , Pure Sniper , Puzzle Page™, Head Ball 2, Motorsport Manager, Darts of Fury, Mini Football, Triple Match 3D™, Agar.io, PowerWash Simulator, Sudoku.com™, and We Are Warriors™.

rows.title: Senior Specialist, Product Management
rows.descriptionText:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Senior Specialist, Product Management

Overview

Mastercard's Digital Assets & Blockchain team is seeking a Senior Specialist, Product Management to support the commercialization and market expansion of digital asset and blockchain-based solutions in Europe. This role will contribute to go-to-market execution, partnership development, market analysis, and product adoption initiatives for products including crypto-linked card programs, stablecoin and digital currency BVNK sales enablement, and emerging blockchain solutions.

The ideal candidate is passionate about digital innovation, payments, and emerging technologies, with experience supporting product launches and commercialization initiatives. They are highly collaborative, analytical, and comfortable working across cross-functional teams in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

Role

Product Commercialization & Market Support

 Drive the execution of commercialization strategies for digital assets and blockchain solutions. Conduct consultative solutions based engagement with customers to support sales efforts Craft product localization strategies, market readiness assessments, and launch activities to support successful market expansion. Partner with regional and global stakeholders to ensure alignment on commercialization priorities and customer opportunities.


Go-to-Market Execution

 Develop go-to-market plans for digital asset products and solutions. Support sales enablement activities, including value proposition development, customer-facing materials, and internal education. Coordinate with product, business development, marketing, legal, compliance, and regional teams to drive launch readiness.


Partnership Enablement

 Support the identification, onboarding, and management of strategic partnerships focused on one to many distribution opportunities. Help maintain strong relationships with customers and partners to support product adoption and business growth. Assist in evaluating partnership opportunities and preparing business cases.


Market Intelligence & Opportunity Analysis

 Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and ecosystem monitoring across the digital assets and blockchain landscape. Analyze customer, market, and industry trends to identify commercialization opportunities and inform strategic priorities. Support opportunity sizing, market segmentation, and customer targeting efforts.


Performance Tracking & Insights

 Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and commercialization metrics to assess product performance and adoption. Prepare reports, presentations, and recommendations for stakeholders based on market and performance data. Help identify opportunities to optimize product adoption and commercial outcomes.


All About You

 Experience in product commercialization, product management, business development, consulting, strategy, payments, fintech, or a related field. Understanding of digital assets, blockchain technology, cryptocurrencies, stablecoins, tokenization, or emerging payment technologies. Curious and fast learner with a passion for supporting product launches, go-to-market activities, partnership initiatives, or business growth programs. Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize market, competitive, and customer insights into actionable recommendations. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a dynamic, cross-functional environment. Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.


Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;Report any suspected information security violation or breach, andComplete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

rows.title: Go To Market Engineer - London
rows.descriptionText:
About the roleChain of Events is behind some of the most commercially ambitious events in AI and blockchain, including RAISE Summit, MACHINA and Signal Week. Following its acquisition by Hyve Group, we’re looking for an exceptional commercial leader to build and drive MACHINA’s go-to-market engine - while acting as a connector and force multiplier across Hyve’s Global Ventures portfolio.This is much more than a single-event role. You’ll bring teams together across sales, marketing, product and operations; turn insight into action; and transfer the playbooks, skills and commercial discipline that help new ventures scale faster.Global Ventures is Hyve’s dedicated accelerator: the place where new event concepts are launched and high-potential businesses are supercharged. It combines the pace and ownership of a start-up with the reach and resources of a global group - powered by obsessive customer focus, rapid experimentation, simple decision-making and entrepreneurial energyThis is a pure outbound role. You are not responsible for inbound. Your focus is building and running campaigns that convert cold contacts into conversations, using AI agent workflows, smart data, and sharp copy as your primary tools. If you are energised by seeing a sequence you built result in a meeting with a company that becomes a sponsor, this role is for you.
What you will ownOutbound sequences & campaign architectureBuild, deploy and optimise outbound campaigns - you own the sequence from first touch to booked meeting.Multi-channel campaign architecture - email, LinkedIn, and any channel that converts. You decide the mix, the timing, and the message for each campaign.Own the full funnel from campaign launch to booked meeting - we care about meetings generated, not sends or replies - we'll support you with the tools, data, and feedback loops to make sure the campaigns you build are converting.Messaging strategy and copy direction - own the testing roadmap. Continuously iterate on what converts to meetings, not what gets opens.AI agent workflows as default - use AI for research, personalisation and outreach as standard operating procedure, not as occasional add-ons. You should be building workflows that would take an SDR hours in minutes.Data-driven outreachTarget list construction - source and pull target account and contact data using existing tools to build campaign-specific lists, working closely with the team to make sure targeting is sharp before any sequence goes out.Enrolment logic - define and automate which contacts enter which sequences based on ICP score, data signals and funnel stage. No contact enrolled in the wrong sequence, no duplicate sends.ICP scoring and segmentation - apply and adjust scoring models and segmentation logic in HubSpot to keep campaigns targeting the right accounts at the right moment.Account Smart Mapping - map multiple ICP contacts per target account across seniority levels. AEs should never be working a single thread into a key account.Data quality governance - maintain enrichment coverage above threshold and audit records on a regular cycle, so the team always has clean, reliable data to work from.Buying committee research - surface full decision-making units per account, automated via enrichment tools where possible, manual review for the highest-priority targets.Infrastructure & toolingDomain and mailbox warm-up - you will own sender reputation and inbox placement, with full visibility into performance so you can stay ahead of any deliverability issues before they affect campaigns.Day-to-day tool management - own the outreach tool stack (Lemlist, Instantly, Klenty, Alta, Artisan and equivalents). Keep it running, keep it optimised.Weekly growth and deliverability report - reply rates, inbox placement, meetings booked, campaign-attributed pipeline. You will have a clear view of performance and share that with leadership each week.
What we are looking for2+ years’ experience in GTM engineering, growth or outbound-focused roles, ideally within events, media or B2B SaaSStrong commercial acumen - you understand how GTM activity translates into qualified pipeline, revenue and long-term customer valueA demonstrable track record of building outbound sequences that book high-quality meetings, rather than simply generate activityHands-on experience managing outbound email infrastructure using Lemlist, Instantly, Smartlead or equivalent platformsStrong working knowledge of data enrichment tools and processes, including Clay, waterfall enrichment and contact and account-data qualityConfident HubSpot capability - you can build workflows, refine scoring models and interpret performance reports without external supportAn AI-native approach to outreach, using AI agents for research, personalisation and workflow automation as part of your day-to-day workExcellent commercial copywriting skills, with the ability to create precise, relevant messaging that converts without relying on volumeA curious, experimental mindset - you test new approaches, identify what works and use data and customer feedback to improve performance quicklyThe ability to distil new learning into clear, repeatable playbooks and teach others how to apply it across different ventures and marketsA natural cross-functional collaborator who can connect sales, marketing, product and operations, transferring knowledge and raising capability across Global VenturesA self-directed approach - you can identify what needs to be built, take ownership and move forward confidently while remaining connected to the wider teamFamiliarity with the AI industry and media landscape would be a strong advantage
Why this roleYou will own the outbound engine for events that attract the most commercially active companies in AI and blockchain globally - the ICP is strong and the product sells itself to the right contactsYour output is directly visible - a meeting you book today can become a six-figure sponsorship by end of quarterCompensation is tied to commercial outcome, not activity - you are rewarded for what closes, not what you sendThe tool stack is modern and you will have input into what gets added - no legacy CRM debt or spreadsheet-based prospecting

rows.title: Real Estate Finance Analyst (Irish Team) – Internship to Full-Time
rows.descriptionText:
About us:Fiduciam is a fintech private credit lender with a focus on bridging and development loans, based in Central London. With funding from institutional investors, family offices, and private credit houses, our primary focus is to grow our loan book. Currently our core markets are the UK, Ireland, Spain, Germany, and Luxembourg. To find out more about us: www.fiduciam.co.uk or Fiduciam LinkedIn.
Why join our team?We believe we are a great company to work for. This is what you get as a member of our team:Experience and exposure: you will be working alongside people with extensive industry experience in real estate lending;An established training program:get trained by our senior staff;A dynamic and international environment (over 15 nationalities and 21 languages);An opportunity to accelerate your career by assuming significant responsibility in a meritocratic environment with little hierarchy and good intra-company career prospects;Involvement in the development of new products and entry into new market segments; andA competitive salary,health insurance, pension and a discretionary bonus.
Your mission:This position offers you the ability to take part in the full life cycle of Fiduciam’s loans,from researching and structuring new enquiries, to dealing with current clients and managing the portfolio.
As a Real Estate Finance Analyst in our Irish team, you will handle new Irish loan enquiries, assist with the underwriting process through to completion, and ensure clients have a smooth experience. You will manage a pipeline of multiple transactions at different stages, assisting underwriters and portfolio managers. This role can be based in either London or Dublin. You will also visit properties across Ireland, and connect with clients to grow your network, developing your understanding of the Irish real estate, development, and bridging lending market. 
From this entry position, you can steer your career towards a variety of roles including client-facing origination, underwriting, or portfolio management.
Specific Responsibilities:  Conducting financial analysis and credit due diligence on borrowers, including cash flow, debt serviceability, and balance sheet review; Assessing loan structuring metrics - LTV, LTC, gearing, and exit strategy - to support risk-adjusted lending decisions; Preparing credit papers to support underwriters in assessing and approving loan applications; Reviewing valuations and development appraisals alongside instructed valuers; Liaising with solicitors on facility documentation and security structuring; Performing AML, KYC, and compliance checks; Tracking pipeline performance and maintaining accurate loan records;Contributing to our marketing, such as drafting deal case studies, market updates and LinkedIn content that showcase Fiduciam to borrowers and brokers;Helping to build relationships with brokers, introducers and other referral sources, including representing Fiduciam at industry events;Researching the Irish property and lending market to spot opportunities and inform our marketing and origination; Engaging with borrowers and their advisors to assess business plans and repayment capacity; Applying sound risk judgment, underpinned by knowledge of credit policy and compliance; and Managing multiple transactions concurrently through to redemption. 
About you:Academic degree (bachelors/master) with a strong track record;Excellent communication and commercial skills;Outstanding project management and organisational skills;Knowledge of Irish Real Estate (bonus not a requirement);Outgoing and proactive, with an interest in marketing and building relationships;Strong attention to detail;Team player;Hungry to learn and push your boundaries in a growing company;Ability to work well under pressure to meet tight deadlines;Enjoy working in an international environment; andEligible to work in Ireland or the UK.

rows.title: Marketing CRM Assistant
rows.descriptionText:

rows.title: Talent Partner (Financial Services) - AI Scale-up
rows.descriptionText:
Talent Partner (Financial Services)Compensation: up to £100,000 + bonus + equityLocation: London, onsite
Hawkwood is partnering with one of the fastest-growing enterprise AI companies in financial services as it continues to build its London and European organisation.
The company has raised more than $300m, with a reported valuation of approximately $2bn. It is backed by some of the world's leading tech investors, including Sequoia and Thrive Capital, alongside strategic investment from a number of major global banks.
Having established significant traction in the US, the business is now investing heavily in its international expansion. As part of that growth, they are looking for an experienced recruiter to take ownership of hiring across their strategic financial services organisation in London and Europe.
This is a unique recruiting challenge. You'll build relationships with high-calibre front-office professionals across investment banking, private equity, hedge funds, trading and corporate finance, engaging people who may not have previously considered leaving traditional finance for a technology company.
You'll work closely with the company's Co-Founder, senior business leaders and EMEA Talent leadership to define the profiles they need, map the market and build long-term pipelines of finance talent. The role combines the rigour and relationship-building of executive search with the pace, ownership and breadth of an in-house role at a rapidly scaling AI company.
The company operates with a high-performance, high-ownership culture, so this is an opportunity for someone who wants to build networks, solve difficult talent problems and play a key role in shaping how an international organisation scales.
What you'll do:Build and own proactive pipelines of high-calibre front-office finance talent across London and Europe, spanning investment banking, private equity, hedge funds, trading, corporate finance and adjacent investment backgrounds.Lead full-cycle recruitment, from market mapping and initial engagement through screening, interview management, offer negotiation and close.Partner closely with the cofounder and senior business leaders to define roles, calibrate talent profiles and establish what exceptional finance talent looks like as the European organisation grows.Develop long-term relationships with passive candidates, creating talent communities and networks rather than relying primarily on active applicants or transactional sourcing.Help position the company as a compelling career destination within London and European finance, engaging relevant alumni communities, referral networks and industry events.Build talent segmentation and market-mapping frameworks that give leadership a clear view of the strongest talent pools across different financial institutions, functions and European markets.Act as a trusted advisor on the external talent market, bringing insight around candidate availability, compensation, competitors and the realities of persuading high-performing finance professionals to move into AI.Operate comfortably across both strategy and execution, from challenging and refining a hiring brief to personally sourcing, engaging and closing candidates.Use recruiting technology, data and AI tools to identify pipeline gaps, improve workflows and build a more scalable approach to hiring as the organisation grows.Deliver a high-quality candidate experience throughout, recognising that many of the people you engage will be making a significant and potentially unconventional career move.
You will bring:5+ years of recruiting experience, ideally with meaningful exposure to front-office financial services, investment professionals or another highly competitive talent market.A strong understanding of the London financial-services talent landscape, with European market exposure particularly valuable.Excellent proactive sourcing and market-mapping capability, with a track record of identifying and engaging high-performing candidates who are not actively looking to move.The credibility and communication skills to engage bankers and investors who are progressing successfully within prestigious and highly compensated traditional career paths.Strong relationship-building instincts and an interest in developing genuine networks and talent communities rather than relying on high-volume outbound activity.Commercial judgement and the confidence to advise senior stakeholders on talent strategy, challenge assumptions and help shape a brief rather than simply execute against it.The ability to operate with both search-level rigour and startup pace, managing multiple concurrent searches without compromising the quality of talent or candidate experience.High agency and genuine comfort with ambiguity. You'll be joining an international organisation that is still being built, so priorities will evolve and there won't always be an established process to follow.Intellectual curiosity around finance, AI and technology, and an ability to articulate why someone with a successful career in traditional finance might choose to apply their experience to transforming the industry instead.
We recognise how challenging this current job market is for candidates, and Hawkwood are therefore striving to provide the best candidate experience we can. If you are interested in this opportunity, we kindly request that you apply via this LinkedIn advert, as opposed to sending us an email or LinkedIn direct message. 
We are eager to ensure that each candidate application is considered fairly, and receives a consistent experience. Unfortunately, we cannot ensure this standard if you inquire about a role via email or LinkedIn message, as it falls outside of our established process.

rows.title: Research Executive (Consulting)
rows.descriptionText:
Research Executive (Consulting)Farringdon, London£26,000 per annumFull Time, PermanentClosing date – 16/10/26Interview Date – w/c 19/10/26 first round virtual interviews


Join Tapestry and Help Make the Complex Beautifully Simple

At Tapestry, we believe in making the complex beautifully simple. We help some of the world's leading brands make better decisions through insight, research and strategic thinking. Our client portfolio spans sectors including streaming, media and entertainment, health and wellness, and sports.

We're looking for a curious, ambitious and commercially minded Research Executive to join our growing consulting team. This is an exciting opportunity for someone looking to develop a career in market research and insight consulting, gaining hands-on experience across a diverse range of projects while learning from experienced consultants.

About the Role

As a Research Executive, you will play a key supporting role in the delivery of high-quality research and insight projects for our clients. You'll be involved throughout the research lifecycle, from background research and questionnaire design through to analysis, reporting and presenting insights.

This role is perfect for someone who is naturally inquisitive, enjoys solving problems, and is eager to develop their research, analytical and consulting skills in a fast-paced environment.

Working closely with senior team members, you will contribute to client projects, build knowledge of different research methodologies, and develop an understanding of the commercial challenges facing some of the most exciting brands and organisations in the market.

Key Responsibilities

You will support the successful delivery of client research projects by conducting desk research, contributing to questionnaire design, analysing data and helping to develop engaging client reports and presentations. You'll work collaboratively with colleagues across the business, liaising with delivery teams and supporting project management activities to ensure projects run smoothly and efficiently.

You'll actively contribute to client meetings by taking notes, sharing ideas and ensuring agreed actions are followed through. As your experience grows, you'll take ownership of specific project elements and develop confidence in providing meaningful insight and recommendations.

Alongside project work, you'll stay informed about industry developments, emerging research techniques and the latest news across our key client sectors. You'll also contribute to proposal development, client brainstorming sessions and wider business initiatives, helping to strengthen Tapestry's expertise and reputation.

About You

We're looking for someone who combines strong analytical ability with genuine curiosity about people, markets and consumer behaviour.

You will have:

Degree-level education or equivalent relevant experience.A genuine interest in market research, insight and consulting.Strong numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills.Excellent written and verbal communication skills.The ability to think critically and translate data into meaningful stories and insights.Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively as part of a team.The ability to manage multiple priorities and perform well in a fast-paced environment.A keen interest in current affairs, business, media, technology or consumer trends.

Previous exposure to market research methodologies, data analysis or commercial research projects would be advantageous, but most importantly we're looking for someone with the enthusiasm and willingness to learn.

Why Join Tapestry?

You'll be joining a collaborative and supportive team that is passionate about insight, innovation and continuous learning. You'll have the opportunity to work with leading brands across a diverse range of sectors while building a strong foundation for a successful career in research and consulting.

If you're naturally curious, enjoy uncovering insights and want to help clients solve complex challenges through research and strategic thinking, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and start your journey with Tapestry.

Tapestry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be treated in a fair and equal manner and in accordance with the law regardless of gender, marital status, race, religion, colour, age, disability or sexual orientation.

**Absolute amazing opportunity to progress and develop within a generalist IT role in a growing Hedge Fund! – would suit 2nd jobber someone strong academics who wants an IT career in a Hedge Fund**
Martis Search is partnering with a boutique Hedge Fund to appoint a permanent “Hedge Fund Data Analyst” (IT role) to join its team.
This is a newly created position offering an exceptional opportunity to join a dynamic, rapidly growing firm and play a key role in shaping its data infrastructure and reporting capabilities.
The successful candidate will help automate and streamline processes using Excel, Python, SQL, Power BI, and have ideally coding/ Macros skills. 
The Data Analyst role will lead into a broad Hedge Fund IT Technologist role and will grow into being responsible for the following areas, so is such a great opportunity:
Software Development & AutomationDatabase Management & Data AnalyticsMicrosoft 365 & Power PlatformIT Infrastructure & Trading SystemsArtificial Intelligence & Emerging Technologies
This is a genuinely wide-ranging Data Analyst role offering direct interaction with senior stakeholders and exposure across the entire Hedge Fund.
Who they are looking for: 
Our client will look at a graduate calibre individual with Advanced Excel, Python and Power BI” skills. Candidates may come from:
• 2023/ 2022 STEM subject graduates (1st Class Honours, or 2:1 in a BSc type degree) with no Hedge Fund experience but with “Advanced Excel, Python, SQL and Power BI skills” with full “on-the-job-training” as being provided.• STEM subject graduates (1st Class Honours, or 2:1 in a BSc type degree) Graduates with x 1–3 years’ experience in a Hedge Fund, Asset Manager, Investment Bank or Trading company in an IT/Tech-focused role.
The client is looking for someone who genuinely enjoys working with complex datasets and analytical tools. This is not intended as a short-term path into a front-office investment role.
The role is hybrid and you must be comfortable working independently and taking initiative on data projects.
Salary
£60,000 k pa - £80,000 k pa dependent upon experience, plus a very good bonus, pension, healthcare etc

rows.title: Senior Actuarial Analyst - Individual Annuity Pricing
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Job Type: Permanent

Location: This role will be based in our London office with some flexibility to work between the office (ideally 2 days per week) and home. We will discuss what is important to you and balancing this with business requirements during the recruitment process. You can read more about flexible working here.

Salary and benefits:  c.£60,000+ (subject to experience), plus competitive bonus, private medical cover, 38 days annual leave, excellent pension, 12x salary life assurance, career breaks, income protection, 3x volunteering days and much more.

If you’re a part-qualified actuary with pricing experience and a strong commercial mindset, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and use your expertise to help shape how we price, compete and grow across our Individual Annuity business.

Who are we?

We’re Standard Life, a retirement specialist focused entirely on retirement savings and income. We champion the belief that everyone’s journey to and through retirement can be better, and for more than 200 years, we’ve been helping our customers plan and prepare for their financial futures.

Life today is increasingly complicated, uncertain and unpredictable. People move through different careers, face unexpected moments and navigate important choices. We offer our colleagues flexibility, trust and benefits that work for whatever life brings. In return we expect curiosity, connection, accountability and high standards. We make room for what matters - so you can bring your best, every day.

The Opportunity

If you’re a part-qualified actuary looking to build your career in pricing, this is an opportunity to work at the heart of Standard Life’s Individual Annuity business, using your actuarial expertise and commercial judgement to influence pricing decisions, customer outcomes and our position in the market.

Joining our Individual Annuity Pricing team, you’ll gain hands-on exposure across our Lifetime and Fixed-Term Annuity products, combining market insight, customer behaviour and actuarial analysis to help shape how we compete and grow.

It’s a role with plenty of breadth and opportunity to make an impact. You’ll analyse how our products are performing, understand what’s happening across the market and turn complex data into meaningful commercial insight. You’ll also contribute to the development of our pricing approach, assumptions, tools and products, building both your technical expertise and broader commercial understanding as your career develops.

Key Responsibilities

You'll play an important role in helping us understand performance, respond to the market and make well-informed pricing decisions. Here are some of the key responsibilities you’ll undertake:

 Analyse pricing competitiveness and market insight, identifying opportunities to balance customer value, competitiveness and profitability  Produce pricing MI and turn data into clear commercial insight and recommendations  Implement pricing changes within production environments, ensuring accuracy and appropriate controls  Support the development and review of pricing bases and assumptions  Contribute to the ongoing development and enhancement of our Lifetime and Fixed-Term Annuity products  Undertake pricing calculations and analyse proposition, market and business data to support decision-making  Make recommendations to senior colleagues based on your analysis and emerging market insight  Identify and implement opportunities to improve our tools, processes and overall pricing capability  Collaborate with colleagues across the business, developing your understanding of how pricing decisions support our wider commercial ambitions 

What are we looking for?

We’re looking for someone with strong actuarial foundations, commercial curiosity and the appetite to continue developing.

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

 Part-qualified actuarial status, with relevant insurance experience and a commitment to achieving full qualification, which we’ll support you with  Experience and a good understanding of pricing within a retail flow business; individual annuity pricing experience is particularly valuable  An understanding of key pricing metrics and relevant regulatory frameworks, including Solvency II and IFRS  Strong analytical and quantitative skills, coupled with a practical problem-solving mindset  The ability to turn analysis and complex information into clear insights and recommendations  Strong working knowledge of tools such as Excel, VBA and Power BI  Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the confidence to build relationships across different teams  A proactive and curious approach, with a desire to continue building both your technical and commercial knowledge 

We Want To Hire The Whole Version Of You.

We are committed to ensuring that everyone feels accepted and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If your experience looks different from what we’ve advertised and you believe that you can bring value to the role, we’d love to hear from you.

If you require any adjustments to the recruitment process, please let us know so we can help you to be at your best.

We’re reviewing applications as they come in, so apply early to avoid missing out.

Find out more about working at Standard Life

 Guide for Candidates: standardlifeplc.pagetiger.com/guideforcandidates  Find or get answers from our colleagues: www.standardlifeplc.com/careers/talk-to-us

rows.title: Commercial Performance Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Looking for a challenge in one of the world’s largest airfreight logistics organisations?

At IAG Cargo we are in the business of moving things. From antibiotics to groundbreaking tech, gold bullion to avocados and everything in between. We move cargo that positively impacts society worldwide. Whatever people need, wherever they are. At IAG Cargo we open the skies and fly the world to bring people the things they really need.  

We are the logistics and cargo brand of International Airlines Group (Aer Lingus, British Airways, Iberia, Level and Vueling). Powered by five airlines, our reach is truly global – but it’s the impact we make that defines us. At IAG Cargo, we believe in keeping the world’s economies turning, and do everything with determined attitudes, curious minds, collaborative actions and heartfelt pride. Join us at our globally recognised logistics business, that is Trusted to Deliver.

About The Role

The Commercial Performance Analyst role is an exciting opportunity to join a team focused on transforming how we use data to drive commercial success. You’ll play a key role in supporting a transformation of performance reporting, developing new analytical capabilities within the Commercial team, and delivering insights across the business that help shape more dynamic decisions that maximise performance. The role is a core driver as part of the transformation of Commercial reporting that will help develop new and innovative ways to surface, interpret, and act on proactive performance data by turning complex data sets into actionable insights that drive decision-making and unlock value across the business

The Following Will Be Key To Your Success

Being able to articulate complex pieces of information into stories and outputs which are understood by a range of seniority and experience levels,Maintaining good relationships with external suppliers to ensure strong collaboration on model accuracy.

What You’ll Do

Working as part of the Commercial Performance team, demonstrate commerciality and curiosity to provide proactive, data-led insights that support improved commercial decision-making across all areas.Work closely with colleagues in Contribution Management, Sales, and Operations to understand business needs and translate them into actionable and proactive analysis.Working alongside stakeholders across the Commercial business areas and with Data & Analytics team, develop intuitive real time dashboards and visual tools that bring performance insights to life for stakeholders at all levels in real time.Provide teams across Contribution Management and wider Commercial area with proactive insight that drives improved commercial decision making, helping grow IAG Cargo’s contribution.

It's All About You

What you’ll bring to IAG Cargo:

Strong analytical skills with experience in performance reporting and business intelligenceStrong interpersonal and influencing skillsAbility to translate complex data into clear, compelling insightsExperience working with cross-functional teams in a commercial settingAdvanced analytical ability, with a good understanding of how to build models in Excel or similar as well as Tableau and/or Power BI experienceComfortable working with and managing external suppliers to deliver the correct outcome.Support ad hoc analysis requests and special projects.Ensure data accuracy and consistency across systems

Required

Skills and Experience:

Experience with data visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and ExcelAbility to work collaboratively and communicate insights clearly to stakeholders at all levelsAbility to make decisions and exercise sound judgement based on detailed analysisAbility to drive change identified from analysis and decisionsA strong team player with energy and drive to achieve the team’s objectives

Desirable

Understanding of the airfreight businessUnderstanding of airfreight/logistics processes and data

We’ll treat you right

Wherever you work within IAG Cargo, you’ll play a part in helping us deliver what the world needs and join a diverse and inclusive business that’s making a difference.

As well as a competitive salary, bonus, we offer a range of benefits to support our colleagues, which include:

A hybrid environment with 3 days a week in the office and two from home.From the day you join us, you’ll get access to brilliant staff travel benefits including unlimited basic and premium standby tickets on British Airways and group airlines. You’ll also receive up to 30 discounted ‘Hotline’ airfares per year for yourself, friends, and family.Flexible bank holiday policy- Individuals not on shift have the flexibility to swap the statutory public holidays, with the days you choose to take off instead.All our colleagues get access to LinkedIn learning and Rosetta Stone Language coursesFor health and wellbeing we offer a free onsite gym facility as well as access to the UNMIND app and a community of Mental Health First AidersAccess to discounts on Apple, Cinema tickets and loads of other goodies through Perks at work

Diversity and Inclusion

Our recruitment procedures positively support our diversity and inclusion agenda.

All candidates are considered strictly on their merits in relation to the criteria for the role, treated fairly and consistently, and have their individual needs responded to throughout the process.

rows.title: Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
We don't just believe in better. We make it happen.

Better content. Better products. And better careers.

Working in Tech, Product or Data at Sky is about building the next and the new. From broadband to broadcast, streaming to mobile, Sky Stream to Sky Glass, we never stand still. We optimise and innovate. We turn big ideas into the products, content and services millions of people love. And we do it all right here at Sky.

Role/Team Overview

We're part of Europe's leading entertainment and communications company, serving more than 22 million customers across five countries. Within Sky Data, the OTT Data Science & Optimisation team partners with stakeholders across the UK, Italy and Ireland to use data, machine learning and AI to improve customer experiences and drive commercial growth across our streaming services.

As a Data Scientist, you'll work on high-impact initiatives spanning customer acquisition, engagement, retention and personalisation. You'll combine large-scale behavioural data, experimentation, advanced analytics and predictive modelling to identify opportunities, optimise customer journeys and support key business decisions.

Working closely with Product, Marketing, Commercial and Technology teams, you'll help develop scalable data science solutions that influence how millions of customers discover, engage with and enjoy our content. This is an exciting opportunity to apply cutting-edge data science and AI techniques to real customer and business problems at scale in a fast-paced international environment.

What You'll Do

Develop strong relationships with stakeholders across Group territories, build a deep understanding of business objectives and translate requirements into impactful data science solutions.Identify commercial opportunities through data analysis and predictive modelling to improve decision-making and business outcomes.Design, develop and deploy machine learning models and predictive analytics solutions to optimise customer journeys and commercial outcomes.Develop, refine and scale data science procedures, frameworks and best practices to improve efficiency, consistency and impact.Identify and apply AI, Generative AI and Agentic AI techniques to enhance data science workflows, analytics capabilities and business processes.

What You’ll Bring

Essential criteria:

Demonstrable experience applying statistical, machine learning and optimisation techniques to solve complex business problems.Programming skills in Python and SQL.Experience working with large-scale customer, transactional or behavioural datasets using cloud data platforms and distributed processing technologies.A positive, can-do attitude and the adaptability to work with quickly evolving objectives, with the ability to communicate findings to non-technical audiences.High levels of logical thinking and problem-solving, with the ability to address complex problems using innovative and industry-leading techniques.

Desirable Skills And Experience

Understanding of modern AI techniques, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Agentic AI frameworks.

Benefits And Perks

There's one thing people can't stop talking about when it comes to life at Sky: the perks. Here's a taster:Free Sky TV or NOW package, including Sky Sports and Sky CinemaPension package with up to 9% employer contributionPrivate healthcare with mental health supportAviva Digital GP and dental insuranceDiscounts on Sky products, including Sky Mobile, Sky Broadband, Sky Glass and Sky ProtectSharesave and Tech schemesA range of Sky VIP rewards and experiences

How You Will Work

We've adopted a hybrid working approach to give more flexibility on where and how we work. The hybrid working expectations for this role are 2 days in the office per week.

Your office base

Our Sky Group HQ. Equipped with state-of-the-art technology and workspaces, there’s plenty of space to see your big ideas come to life. Here you’ll find 13 subsidised restaurants and cafes. You can re-energise at our gym, catch the latest films at our cinema, get your car washed and even get pampered at our beauty salon.

Our Osterley Campus is just a 10-minute walk from Syon Lane train station, or you can get one of our free shuttle buses from Osterley, Gunnersbury and Ealing Broadway stations. Plus, there’s free onsite parking available for cars, motorbikes and bicycles.

Who We Are

We're Sky, a leading media and entertainment company who connect millions with entertainment, sports, news and arts through innovative products and services. Working with us means you'll be bringing the joy of a better experience to more people, every day. All so we can do better and deliver better for our customers, colleagues and society.

We're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We're a Disability Confident Accredited Employer, and welcome and encourage applications from all candidates. We will look to ensure a fair and consistent experience for all and will make reasonable adjustments to support you where appropriate. Please flag any adjustments you need as early as you can.

Just so you know: if your application is successful, we'll ask you to complete a criminal record check. And depending on the role you have applied for and the nature of any convictions you may have, we might have to withdraw the offer.

rows.title: Physical AI Data Scientist - QuantumBlack Labs
rows.descriptionText:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

Your Impact

You will be part of QuantumBlack Labs and the Robotics and Physical AI team within our Advanced Industries Sector, a group of engineers, scientists, product managers, and machine learning specialists building a first of its kind physics AI capability that accelerates and scales how the world designs and builds physical systems.

Our team is responsible for:

Building multi-physics simulation frameworks, digital twins, and surrogate models that stand in for slow, expensive physics solversApplying physics-informed machine learning and robotics to real-world engineering systems across advanced industries, from chip design to aircraft manufacturingDeploying scalable, production grade tools on HPC infrastructure that embed our distinctive technical approach and engineering knowledge for industrial clients

You will lead technical workstreams on client engagements, building multi-physics simulation frameworks and digital twins, developing surrogate and machine learning models, applying physics-informed machine learning to real-world engineering systems, deploying scalable production tools on HPC infrastructure, and translating computational insights into strategic recommendations and solutions that deliver measurable impact for clients.

You’ll create surrogate models that replace costly simulations, compress design cycles from weeks to minutes, and bring autonomy to robotic systems on the factory floor. Collaborating with global, multidisciplinary teams, you’ll drive innovation, develop impactful technologies, and grow as a leader in physical AI.

You will work with diverse and complex engineering data sets, develop scientific software products, and write optimized code to enhance our internal tools. Collaborating with scientists, engineers, and designers, you will leverage advanced math, statistics, and machine learning to deliver impactful solutions and grow the firm’s capacity to deliver at scale.

Your work will help clients address their most pressing challenges by deploying cutting-edge technology and amplifying impact across industries. You will also contribute to the broader physical AI community by writing papers, presenting at conferences, and sharing knowledge with colleagues.

You will be based in London or Madrid and collaborate closely with scientists, data engineers, machine learning engineers, designers, and product managers around the world. Together, you’ll work on interdisciplinary projects to solve complex engineering challenges across a range of industries, leading the development and application of cutting-edge physics AI solutions that drive measurable business impact.

You’ll grow as a technologist and leader in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment, pushing the boundaries of innovation while shaping the future of physical AI and robotics.

Your Qualifications and Skills

We don't just believe in better. We make it happen.

Better content. Better products. And better careers.

We're part of Europe's leading entertainment and communications company, serving more than 22 million customers across five countries. Our Sky Group HQ. Equipped with state-of-the-art technology and workspaces, there’s plenty of space to see your big ideas come to life. Here you’ll find 13 subsidised restaurants and cafes. Maximise your chances of a successful application to this job by ensuring your CV and skills are a good match.
