rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Independent Media

Independent Media comprises The Independent, Standard Digital, Bulletin, BuzzFeed UK, HuffPost UK, Tasty UK, Seasoned, IndyBest and indy100.

Harnessing market-leading innovation and excellence across its portfolio of pioneering brands, Independent Media has unrivalled scale, integrity and authority via its sites, apps, video, audio, experiential, newsletters and social media.

While each Independent Media brand speaks in an authentic, unique voice to a loyal and distinct audience, they stand together in their commitment to positivity, inclusivity, and quality journalism and content.

Independent Media’s network reaches 650 million users each month, with 1.1 billion content views across its brands and platforms, including web, apps, social media, podcasts, email, YouTube, syndication partners and print.

The role and the team

As a Data Analyst, you will support the Digital Analytics team in providing reporting, analysis and insight across Independent Media, with a particular focus on understanding how our journalism and content performs across our digital platforms and syndication partners.

Working closely with analysts and stakeholders across Editorial, Audience, Product, Commercial Licensing & Syndication and Marketing teams, you will help produce regular performance reporting, maintain dashboards and respond to day-to-day analytical requests.

This would suit someone with some experience working with digital or audience data who is looking to develop their career in analytics within a fast-paced news and publishing environment.

You will be responsible for:

Compile regular editorial and management reports using key audience and content data sources.Support the Licensing & Syndication team with reporting and analysis to understand how our content performs across third-party and off-platform partners.Support analysis of website traffic, audience engagement, search, social media and video performance.Work with the Customer Analytics and Marketing teams to track and analyse marketing activity, helping to understand how campaigns drive users through the registration and subscription funnels and increase audience frequency and engagement.Use GA4 and other analytics platforms to investigate changes and trends in audience behaviour.Help maintain BI dashboards and recurring reports used by stakeholders across the business.Monitor performance and highlight significant or unusual changes that may require further investigation.Support the team with ad hoc analytical requests, ensuring outputs are accurate and delivered within agreed deadlines.Work with editorial and audience teams to help them understand how their content is performing.Use SEO and search performance tools to understand how content performs through search e.g. Google Search ConsoleAnalyse social media performance using relevant platform metrics and analytics tools e.g. SupermetricsHelp ensure reporting definitions and methodologies are applied consistently.Carry out appropriate quality assurance and sense-checking before data or analysis is shared.Develop a working knowledge of the databases, analytics platforms and reporting tools used across the business.Handle data responsibly and securely, in accordance with GDPR, the Data Protection Act and the Company’s Code of Conduct.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We champion diversity in our teams and in our reporting. As a growing and global brand, we must have a workforce that’s more representative of our readers, viewers, clients and partners, and a workplace that creates a sense of belonging for everyoneWe are committed to hiring and developing a diverse workforce regardless of background, and we support our people to thrive in their careers here.

The Independent is an equal opportunities employer, if you require any reasonable adjustments to complete your application, please do not hesitate to advise us accordingly.

About You

You are curious, analytical and have a strong attention to detail. You enjoy solving problems and investigating why something has happened rather than simply reporting the numbers.

You have an interest in news, digital publishing and how audiences discover and engage with content online. You will have some previous experience in an analytics, insights, digital marketing or similar role and be keen to develop your skills further.

You should be comfortable working with data and able to communicate your findings clearly to colleagues with different levels of data knowledge.

Essential Skills And Experience

Degree level, ideally in a numerate, analytical or relevant subject.Around 1-2 years’ experience in an analytics, insights, digital marketing or similar data-focused role.Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, reliable work.Strong problem-solving skills and a curious approach to data, with an interest in understanding the reasons behind changes in performance.Experience using GA4 or another digital analytics platform, such as Adobe Analytics.Good working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets.An interest in news, digital publishing and audience behaviour.An ability to interpret data and communicate findings clearly to non-technical colleagues.Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple requests and deadlines.Good written and verbal communication skills.A collaborative approach and willingness to learn new tools and techniques.

Desirable Skills And Experience

Experience analysing social media metrics across platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, TikTok or YouTube.Experience working with BI or visualisation tools such as Domo, Looker, Tableau or Power BI.Some knowledge of SQL or an interest in developing SQL skills.Experience working with content, audience or editorial data.Previous experience within digital publishing, media or a newsroom environment.Familiarity with tools such as Chartbeat or other real-time audience analytics platforms.An understanding of how SEO, social media and other referral channels contribute to digital audience growth.Key responsibilities and accountabilities

Our values – you will deliver across all our values

Inclusive: We champion diversity in our teams and in our reporting. Working as a team, we put transparency and effective communication at the heart of everything we do.

Innovative: From the very beginning, The Independent has been breaking the mould. We take risks and are always looking to try new ideas in pursuit of excellence.

Independent: Nobody tells us what to think; we make up our own minds and aren’t afraid to do things differently. Like our readers, we value honesty and integrity above outside influences.

rows.title: Insights Analyst, Mobile for Development
rows.descriptionText:
Team: Emerging Tech programme

Location: London, candidates must have right to work in the UK

Position type: 1 year contract (inside IR35)

What The Hiring Manager Says

‘Artificial intelligence is reshaping economies around the world but unlocking its potential in low- and middle-income countries requires robust evidence, practical insights and strong collaboration across the ecosystem. As an Insights Analyst in the EmergingTech programme, you'll join a collaborative team exploring how AI and emerging technologies can drive sustainable development. You'll contribute to research that informs industry, policymakers and donors, while developing your expertise in one of the fastest-evolving areas of technology and international development. This role is ideal for someone who is naturally curious, enjoys solving complex problems and wants to contribute to research with real-world impact.’

Eugénie Humeau, Senior Insights Manager - EmergingTech

About The Team

GSMA Mobile for Development (M4D) is a dedicated global team within the GSMA, which brings together our mobile operator members, tech innovators, the development community and governments, to prove the power of mobile in emerging markets.

The GSMA EmergingTech programme accelerates sustainable development and climate action by fostering the adoption of AI and emerging technologies in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). We work with innovators across the public, private and third sectors to support the development and scaling of inclusive and responsible AI solutions.

About The Role

As an Insights Analyst, you will contribute to the delivery of high-quality research on AI and emerging technologies, helping generate evidence and insights that help address real-world challenges in LMICs. Working alongside a team of researchers and specialists, you'll contribute to every stage of the research process, from evidence gathering and analysis through to stakeholder engagement, publication and dissemination.

You'll help produce research that is rigorous, practical and influential, working with innovators, mobile operators, governments, researchers and development partners. Whether contributing to reports, analysing emerging trends, interviewing ecosystem stakeholders or developing presentations, you'll help translate complex technological developments into insights that inform decision-making.

Key Responsibilities For This Role Include

Support qualitative and quantitative research on AI and emerging technologies, including literature reviews, desk research and interviews, while working closely with Insights Managers and Senior Insights Managers.Analyse and synthesise research findings, contributing to reports, blogs, presentations, briefing papers and other knowledge products for industry, policymakers and development partners.Support the delivery of research projects by coordinating project activities, managing timelines and documentation, and liaising with external research partners and suppliers to help deliver high-quality outputs on time.Contribute to the dissemination of research findings by identifying relevant events and engagement opportunities, supporting webinars, workshops and conference activities, and developing presentations and other communication materialsMonitor developments in AI and emerging technologies, identifying relevant evidence, case studies and emerging trends that strengthen the programme's research and thought leadership.Work collaboratively across the EmergingTech programme and the wider M4D team, contributing to cross-programme research, events, thought leadership and knowledge sharing.

About You

We're looking for someone who is excited by the opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, digital innovation and international development. You'll bring strong research skills, excellent written communication and experience in (or a desire to learn about) emerging technologies and their application in low- and middle-income countries. While prior experience in every aspect of our work isn't expected, you'll be motivated to learn quickly and develop expertise in a collaborative environment.

We welcome applications from individuals with the following demonstrated qualifications and skills:

Demonstrable experience conducting or supporting qualitative and/or quantitative research, using appropriate research methodologies and synthesising evidence into clear, evidence-based insights.Strong analytical skills, with the ability to analyse complex evidence, apply structured approaches to research questions and extract meaningful insights.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing reports, presentations or other research outputs and communicating complex technical concepts in clear and accessible language.Understanding of, or strong interest in, AI, emerging technologies and their application in international development. Familiarity with the mobile ecosystem or broader digital development landscape would be advantageous.Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while working collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams and contributing to multiple research projects.Comfortable engaging with stakeholders from different sectors and cultural contextsA proactive and intellectually curious approach, with a willingness to learn, take initiative and contribute to a collaborative team environment.

About Your Skills

This role is based on the following core capabilities:

Analysis – Analysis is central to this role, enabling the interpretation of evidence, identification of trends and translation of complex information into clear, actionable insights that underpin high-quality research.

Communication – Essential for producing high-quality research outputs and communicating complex technical concepts clearly to audiences across industry, government and the development ecosystem.

Delivery – Strong delivery skills ensure research activities are effectively managed, priorities are balanced and outputs are delivered to a high standard.

Agility – Agility is essential in the rapidly evolving AI landscape, enabling continuous learning, adaptability and responsiveness to emerging developments.

Teamwork – Teamwork is fundamental to the way we work, supporting effective collaboration with colleagues and partners across GSMA and the wider ecosystem.

Contract type

Short term Contractor

Worker type

Contingent Worker

What We Offer

Working at the GSMA offers you unparalleled access to the mobile industry. We offer a chance to truly shape the direction of mobile, whatever your role. By joining the GSMA, you will be exposed to a fast-paced rapidly evolving environment, working on global solutions, genuinely fascinating and industry-changing projects and a stimulating and dynamic environment designed to enable you to flourish.

In addition to architect-designed offices and competitive compensation, our benefits include fantastic learning & development opportunities, generous holiday allowances, four additional days off for professional development and many others.

To learn more about the GSMA, visit our career site, our LinkedIn page and our Twitter page.

Being You at the GSMA

We care deeply about diversity, equity and inclusivity and aspire to be the best at it. Your well-being and work/life balance is important, so flexi-time and remote working is available to all staff. We're keen to ensure everyone is equal, represented and connected so we particularly encourage applications from all demographics. The sucess of the GSMA year on year will continue to be contributed by people from all walks of life.

GSMA Values

Our values not only drive our culture – they shape how we work and interact inside and outside our global organisation.

Passionately driven

We approach everything we do with unparalleled capability, tenacity and commitment, knowing that the challenging scale, pace and complexity of our work is what leads to its world-changing impact.

Insightful leaders

We continually develop and engage our expertise, insight and creativity so that we’re always ready to respond to the changing landscape with authority, agility and nuance.

Stronger together

We lean on each other so the industry can lean on us, embracing our diversity by actively seeking out perspectives and skill sets beyond our own, fuelling each other’s successes and constantly asking how we can help.

Underpinning our values is our collective mindset to show up purposefully as good human beings every day, in every situation. When we’re at our best – we are collaborative, considerate and compassionate to others, and we create a safe space for one another to thrive, assuming positive intent in our colleagues. And if we aren’t at our best and the pressure is on – we feel free to be ourselves but still remain curious, lean into the tough stuff and we are always respectful to others and accountable for the part we play.

rows.title: Facilities Management Data Analyst

You will produce accurate, timely and commercially relevant insights that help clients and operational teams make better decisions. Working closely with analysts, FM teams and technology platforms, you’ll validate and interpret data, turning it into clear recommendations and practical actions.

Analyse energy, BMS, IEQ, asset and FM operational data across multiple client portfolios.Produce high-quality dashboards, reports, commentary and prioritised recommendations.Support the development of Power BI reporting, insight summaries and performance narratives.Identify trends, anomalies, risks and opportunities relating to energy use, asset performance, comfort and operational efficiency.Translate complex findings into clear, action-focused insights for non-technical stakeholders.Use platforms including Concerto, Power BI, Demand Logic, Tapp+, Clearworld, Pulse and Carrot, alongside IoT sensors and Bellrock’s remote Triage Bureau.Work with FM teams, supply chain partners and the Bellrock Bureau to turn insights into operational action.Escalate data quality issues and risks with clear evidence and recommendations.Help improve analytics processes, dashboards, rules and automation.Maintain strong data integrity, documentation and analytical governance.

Experience in analytics, data analysis or performance reporting within FM, property, energy, sustainability or operational environments (or strong transferable skills).Familiarity with BI tools (Power BI preferred) and data analysis techniques.Understanding of energy data, asset performance, BMS or FM data is advantageous but not essential.Experience working with CAFM/IWMS, IoT, BMS or operational datasets is desirable.Strong analytical thinking with the ability to interrogate data and challenge assumptions.Confidence working with time-series and operational datasets and explaining results clearly.Ability to balance detail with commercial relevance, focusing on what matters most to the client.Willingness to learn new platforms, technologies and FM concepts in a fast-moving environment.Collaborative mindset, working effectively with analysts, engineers, consultants and operational teams.

About Independent Media

Independent Media comprises The Independent, Standard Digital, Bulletin, BuzzFeed UK, HuffPost UK, Tasty UK, Seasoned, IndyBest and indy100.

Harnessing market-leading innovation and excellence across its portfolio of pioneering brands, Independent Media has unrivalled scale, integrity and authority via its sites, apps, video, audio, experiential, newsletters and social media.

While each Independent Media brand speaks in an authentic, unique voice to a loyal and distinct audience, they stand together in their commitment to positivity, inclusivity, and quality journalism and content.

Independent Media’s network reaches 650 million users each month, with 1.1 billion content views across its brands and platforms, including web, apps, social media, podcasts, email, YouTube, syndication partners and print.

The role and the team

As a Data Analyst, you will support the Digital Analytics team in providing reporting, analysis and insight across Independent Media, with a particular focus on understanding how our journalism and content performs across our digital platforms and syndication partners.

Working closely with analysts and stakeholders across Editorial, Audience, Product, Commercial Licensing & Syndication and Marketing teams, you will help produce regular performance reporting, maintain dashboards and respond to day-to-day analytical requests.

This would suit someone with some experience working with digital or audience data who is looking to develop their career in analytics within a fast-paced news and publishing environment.

You will be responsible for:

Compile regular editorial and management reports using key audience and content data sources.Support the Licensing & Syndication team with reporting and analysis to understand how our content performs across third-party and off-platform partners.Support analysis of website traffic, audience engagement, search, social media and video performance.Work with the Customer Analytics and Marketing teams to track and analyse marketing activity, helping to understand how campaigns drive users through the registration and subscription funnels and increase audience frequency and engagement.Use GA4 and other analytics platforms to investigate changes and trends in audience behaviour.Help maintain BI dashboards and recurring reports used by stakeholders across the business.Monitor performance and highlight significant or unusual changes that may require further investigation.Support the team with ad hoc analytical requests, ensuring outputs are accurate and delivered within agreed deadlines.Work with editorial and audience teams to help them understand how their content is performing.Use SEO and search performance tools to understand how content performs through search e.g. Google Search ConsoleAnalyse social media performance using relevant platform metrics and analytics tools e.g. SupermetricsHelp ensure reporting definitions and methodologies are applied consistently.Carry out appropriate quality assurance and sense-checking before data or analysis is shared.Develop a working knowledge of the databases, analytics platforms and reporting tools used across the business.Handle data responsibly and securely, in accordance with GDPR, the Data Protection Act and the Company’s Code of Conduct.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We champion diversity in our teams and in our reporting. As a growing and global brand, we must have a workforce that’s more representative of our readers, viewers, clients and partners, and a workplace that creates a sense of belonging for everyoneWe are committed to hiring and developing a diverse workforce regardless of background, and we support our people to thrive in their careers here.

The Independent is an equal opportunities employer, if you require any reasonable adjustments to complete your application, please do not hesitate to advise us accordingly.

About You

You are curious, analytical and have a strong attention to detail. You enjoy solving problems and investigating why something has happened rather than simply reporting the numbers.

You have an interest in news, digital publishing and how audiences discover and engage with content online. You will have some previous experience in an analytics, insights, digital marketing or similar role and be keen to develop your skills further.

You should be comfortable working with data and able to communicate your findings clearly to colleagues with different levels of data knowledge.

Essential Skills And Experience

Degree level, ideally in a numerate, analytical or relevant subject.Around 1-2 years’ experience in an analytics, insights, digital marketing or similar data-focused role.Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, reliable work.Strong problem-solving skills and a curious approach to data, with an interest in understanding the reasons behind changes in performance.Experience using GA4 or another digital analytics platform, such as Adobe Analytics.Good working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets.An interest in news, digital publishing and audience behaviour.An ability to interpret data and communicate findings clearly to non-technical colleagues.Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple requests and deadlines.Good written and verbal communication skills.A collaborative approach and willingness to learn new tools and techniques.

Desirable Skills And Experience

Experience analysing social media metrics across platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, TikTok or YouTube.Experience working with BI or visualisation tools such as Domo, Looker, Tableau or Power BI.Some knowledge of SQL or an interest in developing SQL skills.Experience working with content, audience or editorial data.Previous experience within digital publishing, media or a newsroom environment.Familiarity with tools such as Chartbeat or other real-time audience analytics platforms.An understanding of how SEO, social media and other referral channels contribute to digital audience growth.Key responsibilities and accountabilities

Our values – you will deliver across all our values

Inclusive: We champion diversity in our teams and in our reporting. Working as a team, we put transparency and effective communication at the heart of everything we do.

Innovative: From the very beginning, The Independent has been breaking the mould. We take risks and are always looking to try new ideas in pursuit of excellence.

Independent: Nobody tells us what to think; we make up our own minds and aren’t afraid to do things differently. Like our readers, we value honesty and integrity above outside influences.

With expertise in brand consulting, sales strategy, data-driven insights, and talent optimization, Elevate gives its clients a competitive edge in the fight for people’s precious time and attention. Established in 2018, Elevate set out to help sports teams and leagues spark innovation and drive performance. In the years since, the world of sports has transformed, today standing at the convergence of media, entertainment, and consumer brands, with Elevate supporting some of the world’s most ambitious businesses across these sectors. Elevate’s proprietary technology, data sources, and software products combined with our thoughtful insights, and people-centric approach give clients a 360-degree view of their customers, underpinning intelligent decision-making on marketing spend, growth strategy, and more.

Our team of 700+ employees spans the globe with in 20 locations worldwide. We value recruiting diverse individuals to our team to bring new perspectives to our company and look forward to learning more about you in the recruitment process. To learn more and see what we’ve been up to, follow Elevate on X, LinkedIn, and Instagram.

Overview

Elevate operates as a fully integrated partner for its clients, adding insight, expertise, and in-market marquee asset sales activity to accelerate and enhance revenue in collaboration with the client’s leadership, partnership teams and wider stakeholder landscape (e.g. marketing and brand, hospitality, technology, community, venue operations, etc.)

Elevate is seeking a passionate and talented individual to join our Strategy and Insights team within the International Partnerships department. Based in London, the ideal candidate will have a deep interest in sports and a proven ability to research and analyse businesses across various industries. We value curiosity and seek someone who can methodically channel their efforts to deliver actionable insights that drive success across sponsorship sales projects. The role requires creativity in aligning brands with sports properties and the ability to communicate ideas effectively through both written and verbal formats. The candidate will also play a key role in sourcing, managing, and leveraging data to build value for rights holders and venues. A flair for crafting innovative materials and creating compelling sales narratives to support our objectives is essential

Key Deliverables

Conduct detailed research on companies, including spend analysis, target geographies, marketing budgets, and previous sponsorship activities, as well as broader industry trends to identify opportunities and inform strategy.Create and maintain organised data sets and dashboards in Excel to house research findings, ensuring accessibility and usability for the broader team.Develop creative brand alignment concepts in collaboration with the Partnerships team, leveraging research to match brands with sports properties effectively.Provide ongoing support for sales conversations by sourcing relevant information, crafting tailored materials, and contributing insights to enhance client engagement.Manage reporting processes, ensuring accurate and timely updates for both internal stakeholders and clients, and oversee the effective use of the CRM system to track progress and outcomes.Collaborate with internal teams to produce impactful sales narratives and presentations, translating research and insights into compelling client-facing materials.Support the preparation and execution of sales pitches, client meetings, and brand negotiations by articulating insights and presenting data confidently in both written and verbal formats.Support with managing relationships with data providers, including briefing on requirements, monitoring data delivery, and maintaining effective partnerships.

PERSON SPECIFICATION

Demonstrates a genuine passion for sports and a strong interest in understanding its intersection with business and sponsorships.Combines analytical and creative thinking to uncover insights, identify opportunities, and translate them into actionable strategies.Enjoys conducting thorough research, demonstrating curiosity and the ability to investigate topics on a deeper level.Proficient in Microsoft Excel, with the ability to organise and analyse data effectively, as well as experience in creating professional and visually engaging presentation slides.Experience using CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) is highly desirable, with the capability to manage and utilise client and sales data efficiently.Possesses excellent interpersonal and communication skills, enabling clear articulation of ideas and confident collaboration with team members, clients, and stakeholders.A strong team player who is adaptable and proactive in providing support and contributing to shared goals.Able to balance multiple priorities and meet deadlines under pressure while maintaining a high standard of work.Goal-oriented with a results-driven mindset and a commitment to delivering exceptional outcomes.Ability to work in the UK

Benefits Overview

This position is open to all qualified candidates. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability in connection with the application process, you may contact us at HR@oneelevate.com

rows.title: Digital Data, Systems & Insights Officer

location.linkedinText: Kingston Upon Thames, England, United Kingdom

rows.descriptionText:
Here at South Thames Colleges Group, we are seeking a Digital Data, Systems & Insights Officer to support the development, enhancement, and effective operation of the Group's digital systems, reporting tools, and data processes.

Maximise your chances of a successful application to this job by ensuring your CV and skills are a good match.

Working within the Information Development Team as part of the Management Information Systems (MIS) function, you will play a key role in ensuring our core systems and reporting solutions are reliable, efficient and aligned with the needs of both Group management and learners.

You will contribute to the development and maintenance of internal applications, scripts, and system integrations, helping to enhance existing platforms through troubleshooting, functionality improvements and the delivery of new features. You will support the design and optimisation of data flows across systems, undertake testing and quality assurance activities and maintain clear technical documentation to ensure robust and effective digital solutions across the Group.

A significant part of the role will involve developing and maintaining SQL queries, reports and data extracts, as well as supporting and enhancing MS Reporting services reports and Power BI dashboards. Working closely with senior developers, you will help ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of data, while supporting compliance with College policies and relevant regulatory requirements. You will also investigate data issues, identify opportunities for process improvement, and implement effective solutions that drive better insight and decision-making across the Group.

As our Digital Data, Systems & Insights Officer, you will bring experience in supporting and maintaining relational databases, alongside strong technical expertise across a range of systems, software applications and digital platforms. You will be confident in writing and maintaining SQL queries, reports and data extracts, with proven experience of using data analysis tools to cleanse, manipulate, and interpret large or complex datasets. A meticulous eye for detail and a commitment to data accuracy will be essential, particularly when supporting KPI reporting and business intelligence activities.

It would be helpful if you have some experience of Tribal EBS and AdvancedOne Pro products, including configuration areas such as business rules, workflows, data structures and process automation. Understanding or experience of full software development lifecycle, you will be capable of supporting application development from analysis and design through to implementation, testing and ongoing support. In addition, you will have hands-on experience developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, Power Apps and Power Automate solutions, helping to drive data-led decision-making and continuous improvement across the Group.

Under Hybrid Working policy this role will be divided between home-based working and travel to and/or work from any of the South Thames Colleges Group sites.

Closing date for the return of completed applications is 18th October 2026.

The benefits package includes generous annual leave of 27 days plus up to 8 additional days over Christmas/New Year as well as an additional 5 days Wellbeing leave to enhance employees’ physical and mental health. There is an excellent pension scheme that receives a significant financial contribution from the employer (Teachers Pensions or Local Government Pension Scheme), subsidised sports facilities and professional development and training plus a salary sacrifice cycle to work scheme.

As part of our due diligence checks on prospective employees, successful candidates will be subject to an enhanced DBS check, satisfactory references, an online search and proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

As outlined in the Public Sector Equality Duty of the Equality Act 2010, we are committed to equality of opportunity for all staff and applications from individuals are encouraged regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and marriage and civil partnerships.

The South Thames Colleges Group is made up of Carshalton College, Kingston College, Merton College and South Thames College, which merged on 1 August 2017. South Thames Colleges Group is one of London’s largest providers of post-16 education and training and is an ongoing and significant contributor to its local communities. We aim to put students’ success at the heart of everything we do.

We are looking for hard-working and collaborative people who can join our team and help challenge our students to achieve and progress

rows.title: Graduate Analyst Programme - Public Sector Consulting
rows.descriptionText:
About Baringa

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Analyst Roles

Our Analyst roles give you the opportunity to build a career in an award-winning management consultancy firm while contributing to meaningful client work from day one. You will develop an understanding of the consulting business model as well as hands-on experience across the consulting project lifecycle, from understanding client challenges and analysing evidence through to developing recommendations and supporting delivery.

As an Analyst you will join a real consulting team, working and learning from experienced consultants, with exposure to meaningful client work alongside structured development to help you learn more about Baringa and working as a consultant.

About The Government Team At Baringa

Our Government team helps departments, agencies and public services solve complex problems and deliver better outcomes for citizens. Our work spans Central Government, Home Affairs, and Health and Public Infrastructure, from redesigning services and strengthening operations to using data, technology and AI to improve decisions and delivery.

We work on Government’s most complex changes, partnering with departments across Whitehall and the wider public sector, using our skills in Strategy and Business Cases, Project Delivery, Operational Delivery, DDaT and Government Commercial.

The UK public sector is navigating significant challenges and opportunities, including the delivery of major national priorities and missions. As our Public Sector team continues to grow, we are looking for curious and motivated Analysts who are excited to learn, contribute and develop with us. You do not need previous consulting or public sector experience – we are interested in how you approach problems, learn new things and apply your skills to real-world challenges.

What you will be doing

We will embed you in client projects as part of a consulting team, working alongside experienced consultants to learn while delivering real client outcomes. You will not be expected to know how to do all of this from day one. You will be supported throughout and given opportunities to build your skills through meaningful project work.

Depending on the project you join, you may have the opportunity to:

Analyse quantitative and qualitative information to identify insights, trends and opportunities for improvement.Explore how data, digital technology, automation or AI could help improve public services.Develop recommendations and delivery plans, considering how people, technology and data work together.Support the development of client materials, including presentations, reports, workshop outputs and project updates.Contribute to meetings and workshop discussions, helping to capture key points, actions and decisions.Learn how consulting teams work together to solve problems, structure ambiguous challenges and communicate clearly with clients and colleagues.

Examples of the type of projects you could be working on are:

Support transformation projects that help government and public sector organisations improve services, strengthen operations and deliver better outcomes for citizens.Help review how services and processes work, from frontline delivery through to internal operations, identifying opportunities to make them simpler, more effective or more resilient.Contribute to digital, data and analytics work, including projects that use AI or data-led approaches to help clients make better decisions.Support the development of business cases and funding proposals, helping clients assess different options and make evidence-based decisions.Help design how services should operate, looking at how people, processes, technology and data come together to deliver better results within operating models and service blueprints.Support commercial and procurement activity, such as researching suppliers, comparing options and helping prepare materials for decision-making.

What are we looking for?

We welcome applications from students across a broad range of academic disciplines, including STEM and non-STEM subjects, and are particularly keen to hear from students who enjoy solving complex problems using evidence, data, technology and creative thinking. You do not need to have previous experience in consulting or the public sector - what matters most is your curiosity, willingness to learn and interest in helping public sector organisations solve complex challenges.

Skills

We are looking for people who are excited by the opportunity to learn how consulting teams work, contribute to meaningful client projects and develop their skills in a supportive environment. You may be a good fit if you bring:

Structured problem solving, with the ability to break down unfamiliar questions and identify what matters.Data analysis skills, and comfort working with data to surface insight and support evidence-based recommendations. Digital and AI literacy, with genuine curiosity about AI and its practical application, and a foundational understanding of how to use these tools responsibly and ethically.Interest in policy, government and public service, and how national priorities translate into delivery on the ground.Commercial and financial curiosity, with an interest in how money, value and delivery decisions shape public services, and comfort working with numbers to support them.Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain ideas simply and structure your thinking in writing and conversation.A collaborative approach, with enthusiasm for working in teams and learning from others.Willingness to learn and adapt, particularly in a fast-paced project environment where priorities can evolve.Attention to detail and ownership, taking pride in the quality of your work and following through on tasks.A proactive attitude, with the confidence to ask questions, contribute ideas and get involved.

We do not expect you to have all the answers from day one. We are looking for potential, enthusiasm and a genuine interest in developing your consulting skills while contributing to work that matters.

What's in it for you?

An Analyst role at Baringa is what you make it.

This is a permanent role where you will gain real project experience alongside structured coaching, training and development. You will build your analytical, communication and problem-solving skills while learning how to support clients, work within high-performing teams and grow as a consultant.

You will be part of a collaborative, supportive environment where you can learn from experienced consultants, explore different types of public sector work, and build a long-term career with Baringa.

Requirements

Applicants should have a strong academic record or equivalent experience, with an interest in consulting and public sector work. Applicants must have the permanent right to work in the UK now and in the future and be eligible for a UK Security Check (SC) clearance. All applicants will be asked for proof if invited to an assessment centre.

Please note we’re unable to sponsor individuals for this opportunity.

Key dates

Application window closes: Monday 19th October, 12pm GMT Midday

Assessment centres: New Year 2027

We are looking for individuals to start with Baringa May & September 2027

What a career at Baringa will give you

Putting People First.

Benefits

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include:

Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people.

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this.

Using business as a force for good.

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve.

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

Join us

All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. Please contact a member of our Recruitment Team to discuss further.

Baringa Privacy Notices

For UK & EU

Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our UK Recruitment Privacy Notice / EU Recruitment Privacy Notice, to evaluate your application and meet our legal and reporting obligations. In line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to request access to, rectification, or erasure (subject to legal limitations) of your personal data. For more information, please contact us at privacy@baringa.com

For the USA

Your personal data may be retained by Baringa for up to two years, as outlined in our Recruitment Privacy Notice (AMER & APAC), to support the recruitment process and internal reporting requirements. Where applicable, and in accordance with relevant federal and state laws, you may have the right to request access to or correction of your personal information. For further details, please contact privacy@baringa.com

For Australia & Singapore

Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our Recruitment Privacy Notice (AMER & APAC), to assess your application and meet applicable reporting and legal obligations. In line with the Australian Privacy Act and Singapore’s Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA), you may have rights to access, correct, or request limited deletion of your personal data. For more information, please contact us at privacy@baringa.com

rows.title: Intelligence Analyst II
rows.descriptionText:
About Crisis24

Crisis24 is a global, AI-enhanced provider of travel risk management, mass communications, critical event management, crisis-security consulting, personal protection solutions and global medical concierge capabilities, allowing prominent organizations, disruptive brands and influential people to operate with confidence in an uncertain world. At Crisis24, we go beyond mere employment; we pave the way to a realm where your skills become instrumental in shaping global security, guiding clients through a multifaceted and challenging landscape. Your journey with us will be deeply fulfilling, driven by a powerful sense of purpose and accomplishment. Within our thriving environment, you'll discover abundant chances for both personal and career advancement. Seize this moment to push your limits, broaden your expertise, and elevate your professional journey to unprecedented levels. Join the Crisis24 team today and be a part of something extraordinary where growth and impact converge.

More information is available at www.crisis24.garda.com

Who We Are Looking For

We are seeking full-time GSOC Analysts to join an embedded Global Security Operations Centre (GSOC), providing 24/7/365 support to global operations. The GSOC supports the security function of a multinational client with a global footprint, requiring close collaboration with client stakeholders in a dynamic international environment. This role is suited for candidates with strong research and professional writing skills, and with previous experience in, or a strong interest in, global security, geopolitics, intelligence, and investigations. The role is primarily operational in nature, while also including investigative and analytical responsibilities to support security operations, incident response, and stakeholder reporting. The successful candidate will be a strong team player who can also work independently with minimal supervision, manage competing priorities, and deliver accurate work to tight deadlines. They should be comfortable working in a fast-paced operational environment and communicating clearly and professionally with a wide range of stakeholders. This is an office-based role located at the Crisis24 office in central London. As the GSOC provides continuous 24/7 coverage, the position requires regular office presence and operates on a shift-based rota, including night shifts, weekends, and public holidays. The ideal candidate will therefore be based in the London area or within a commutable distance of central London. Successful applicants typically have 1-4 years of experience.

Fluency in Arabic or Portuguese would be highly desirable.

What You Will Work On

Monitor global security developments through a range of sources, including internal reporting, stakeholders, open-source, social media, and intel monitoring platformsIdentify, assess, and escalate incidents requiring attention, and support relevant stakeholders in their responsePrepare and distribute security alerts, warnings, situational awareness updates, and travel security communicationsSupport emergency notification processes during incidents, crises, exercises, and other relevant situationsContact employees and travellers during emergencies and provide timely updates to key stakeholders, as requiredCoordinate with regional and global security teams in response to significant incidents requiring cross-regional supportSupport crisis management activities, exercises, and event security operationsProvide security and crisis management support to employees and business travellersAct as a point of contact for employees and travellers by managing security communication channels and responding to security-related queries and requests for supportSupport travel security processes, including the monitoring of submissions, approvals, and traveller tracking where requiredProvide pre-travel security advice and support to travellersCoordinate actions in line with crisis management procedures, evacuation plans, and other security protocolsSupport the maintenance of accurate records relating to sites, employees and travellers, ensuring information can be made available quickly during incidents, crises, or exercisesMonitor access control and CCTV systems, where requiredCarry out any other GSOC-related duties as directed by the GSOC Manager, Regional Security Directors, or key stakeholders

Who You Will Work With

The Security Analyst will be part of the Global Security Operations Centre (GSOC) team, supporting the delivery of operational security monitoring, incident response, crisis management, and traveller support. The role will work closely with the GSOC Manager, Regional Security Directors, and other members of the client’s Security function, as well as employees and key stakeholders across the organisation.

What You Will Bring

1–4 years of relevant experience in security operations, intelligence, investigations, or a related fieldStrong research, analytical, and professional writing skills, with the ability to deliver clear, accurate, and timely output in a fast-paced environmentExcellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate complex issues clearly and professionally to a range of stakeholdersPrevious experience in, or a strong interest in, global security, geopolitics, intelligence, or investigationsThe ability to assess information, exercise sound judgement, and escalate issues appropriately in support of security operations and incident responseA sound understanding of security-related issues in a corporate or operational environment, and the ability to make balanced, business-relevant decisionsStrong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and perform effectively under pressureStrong interpersonal skills and a collaborative approach, with the ability to work both independently and as part of a teamConfidence in using a range of systems and technology to support operational monitoring, communication, and stakeholder engagementA bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience, in a relevant discipline such as International Relations, Security Studies, Intelligence, Criminology, or a related fieldFluency in Arabic or Portuguese would be highly desirable

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Independent Media

Independent Media comprises The Independent, Standard Digital, Bulletin, BuzzFeed UK, HuffPost UK, Tasty UK, Seasoned, IndyBest and indy100.

Harnessing market-leading innovation and excellence across its portfolio of pioneering brands, Independent Media has unrivalled scale, integrity and authority via its sites, apps, video, audio, experiential, newsletters and social media.

While each Independent Media brand speaks in an authentic, unique voice to a loyal and distinct audience, they stand together in their commitment to positivity, inclusivity, and quality journalism and content.

Independent Media’s network reaches 650 million users each month, with 1.1 billion content views across its brands and platforms, including web, apps, social media, podcasts, email, YouTube, syndication partners and print.

The role and the team

As a Data Analyst, you will support the Digital Analytics team in providing reporting, analysis and insight across Independent Media, with a particular focus on understanding how our journalism and content performs across our digital platforms and syndication partners.

Working closely with analysts and stakeholders across Editorial, Audience, Product, Commercial Licensing & Syndication and Marketing teams, you will help produce regular performance reporting, maintain dashboards and respond to day-to-day analytical requests.

This would suit someone with some experience working with digital or audience data who is looking to develop their career in analytics within a fast-paced news and publishing environment.

You will be responsible for:

Compile regular editorial and management reports using key audience and content data sources.Support the Licensing & Syndication team with reporting and analysis to understand how our content performs across third-party and off-platform partners.Support analysis of website traffic, audience engagement, search, social media and video performance.Work with the Customer Analytics and Marketing teams to track and analyse marketing activity, helping to understand how campaigns drive users through the registration and subscription funnels and increase audience frequency and engagement.Use GA4 and other analytics platforms to investigate changes and trends in audience behaviour.Help maintain BI dashboards and recurring reports used by stakeholders across the business.Monitor performance and highlight significant or unusual changes that may require further investigation.Support the team with ad hoc analytical requests, ensuring outputs are accurate and delivered within agreed deadlines.Work with editorial and audience teams to help them understand how their content is performing.Use SEO and search performance tools to understand how content performs through search e.g. Google Search ConsoleAnalyse social media performance using relevant platform metrics and analytics tools e.g. SupermetricsHelp ensure reporting definitions and methodologies are applied consistently.Carry out appropriate quality assurance and sense-checking before data or analysis is shared.Develop a working knowledge of the databases, analytics platforms and reporting tools used across the business.Handle data responsibly and securely, in accordance with GDPR, the Data Protection Act and the Company’s Code of Conduct.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We champion diversity in our teams and in our reporting. As a growing and global brand, we must have a workforce that’s more representative of our readers, viewers, clients and partners, and a workplace that creates a sense of belonging for everyoneWe are committed to hiring and developing a diverse workforce regardless of background, and we support our people to thrive in their careers here.

The Independent is an equal opportunities employer, if you require any reasonable adjustments to complete your application, please do not hesitate to advise us accordingly.

About You

You are curious, analytical and have a strong attention to detail. You enjoy solving problems and investigating why something has happened rather than simply reporting the numbers.

You have an interest in news, digital publishing and how audiences discover and engage with content online. You will have some previous experience in an analytics, insights, digital marketing or similar role and be keen to develop your skills further.

You should be comfortable working with data and able to communicate your findings clearly to colleagues with different levels of data knowledge.

Essential Skills And Experience

Degree level, ideally in a numerate, analytical or relevant subject.Around 1-2 years’ experience in an analytics, insights, digital marketing or similar data-focused role.Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, reliable work.Strong problem-solving skills and a curious approach to data, with an interest in understanding the reasons behind changes in performance.Experience using GA4 or another digital analytics platform, such as Adobe Analytics.Good working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets.An interest in news, digital publishing and audience behaviour.An ability to interpret data and communicate findings clearly to non-technical colleagues.Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple requests and deadlines.Good written and verbal communication skills.A collaborative approach and willingness to learn new tools and techniques.

Desirable Skills And Experience

Experience analysing social media metrics across platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, TikTok or YouTube.Experience working with BI or visualisation tools such as Domo, Looker, Tableau or Power BI.Some knowledge of SQL or an interest in developing SQL skills.Experience working with content, audience or editorial data.Previous experience within digital publishing, media or a newsroom environment.Familiarity with tools such as Chartbeat or other real-time audience analytics platforms.An understanding of how SEO, social media and other referral channels contribute to digital audience growth.Key responsibilities and accountabilities

Our values – you will deliver across all our values

Inclusive: We champion diversity in our teams and in our reporting. Working as a team, we put transparency and effective communication at the heart of everything we do.

Innovative: From the very beginning, The Independent has been breaking the mould. We take risks and are always looking to try new ideas in pursuit of excellence.

Independent: Nobody tells us what to think; we make up our own minds and aren’t afraid to do things differently. Like our readers, we value honesty and integrity above outside influences.

Collaboration & Global Alignment

rows.title: Data & AI Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Data Analyst

Our Data & AI team is made up of curious, client‑focused professionals who help organisations turn data into insight, decisions, and action. We’re looking for a Data Analyst who combines strong business analysis capability with data product management skills to shape, define, and deliver high‑value use cases across analytics, AI, and modern data platforms.

If you’re passionate about understanding how businesses work, translating that into well‑defined data and AI use cases, and working closely with both business and technology stakeholders, we’d love to talk.

Together We Do What Matters.

Come join us

As a member of Avanade’s Data & AI practice, you’ll work at the intersection of business and technology, helping clients unlock value from their data across AI, Agentic AI, data platforms, reporting, and analytics. You’ll play a critical role in shaping data‑driven products and solutions, ensuring they are well‑defined, client‑centric, and deliver measurable outcomes.

This role is ideal for analytically minded professionals who are curious, collaborative, and motivated by driving meaningful change through data.

What You’ll Do

Partner with clients to understand business problems, opportunities, and priorities, translating them into clear data, analytics, and AI use casesCombine business analysis and data product thinking to define scope, success measures, roadmaps, and requirements for data‑driven solutionsAnalyse source systems, APIs, and data feeds, assessing data quality, structure, and suitability for analytics and AI use casesDesign and document analytics‑focused data models, including dimensional models and star schemasProduce source‑to‑target mappings, business rules, and transformation logic to support data engineering and analytics deliveryWork closely with data engineers, architects, and AI specialists to ensure requirements are well understood and effectively deliveredEngage confidently with both business and technology stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor and translator between worldsSupport the evolution of data products over time, incorporating feedback, learning, and changing business needs

Qualifications

Skills and experience

Proven experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or Analytics Consultant within data, analytics, or AI programmesStrong background in business analysis, including requirements definition, stakeholder engagement, and use‑case developmentExperience analysing source systems, APIs, and data integrations, with an understanding of how operational data is used for analyticsSolid knowledge of data modelling for analytics, particularly dimensional modelling and star schemasHands‑on experience producing source‑to‑target mappings and working with data engineers to support implementationUnderstanding of modern data platforms and analytics architectures, ideally within Microsoft or cloud‑based ecosystemsExcellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data concepts to non‑technical audiencesExperience with technologies such as Python, SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric is advantageous

About You

Characteristics that can spell success in this role include:

Naturally curious and analytical, with a strong desire to understand why things work the way they doPassionate about driving change through data, analytics, and AI, not just producing outputsClient‑centric, with a clear focus on outcomes, value, and measurable impactComfortable working across ambiguity, evolving requirements, and complex stakeholder landscapesConfident engaging with senior business stakeholders and technology teams alikePragmatic, collaborative, and able to balance rigour with paceKeen to continuously learn, develop, and stay current with emerging data and AI trends

Enjoy your career

Some Of The Best Things About Working At Avanade

Opportunity to work for Microsoft’s Global Alliance Partner of the Year (20 times)A minimum of 80 hours per year dedicated to learning, certifications, and professional developmentAccess to global Data & AI communities, accelerators, and subject‑matter expertsThe chance to work on cutting‑edge initiatives across AI, Agentic AI, analytics, and modern data platformsClear and supported career progression across Consultant and Senior Consultant levels

A great place to work

At Avanade, you’ll gain distinctive experiences, limitless learning, and ambitious growth in return for your skills and ideas. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone feels a strong sense of belonging and is empowered to do their best work.

You’ll join a supportive community of collaborators who will mentor, challenge, and learn alongside you — in a company purpose‑built for business‑critical, leading‑edge technology solutions that improve how people work, interact, and live.

We work hard to provide an inclusive, diverse culture with a deep sense of belonging for all our employees. Visit our Inclusion & Diversity page.
