Analyzing marketing campaign performance to identify drivers of member acquisition, product adoption, and engagement.Supporting the development of dashboards and automated reporting solutions that improve efficiency and business visibility.Conducting exploratory analyses to answer ambiguous business questions and uncover actionable insights from member and marketing data.Evaluating customer behavior and segmentation trends to support marketing strategy and targeting decisions.Assisting with measurement frameworks for major initiatives and product launches, including defining key performance indicators and success metrics.Creating executive-ready presentations that communicate findings, recommendations, and business impact to leadership.Researching emerging analytics techniques and tools that can improve reporting, measurement, and decision-making processes.


The Summer Associate Program is a 12-week internship program beginning in May 2027 and ending in August 2027 Students will work on impactful projects and meaningful work during their internship. To qualify for this position, applicants must be currently pursuing a degree from an accredited college or university and have an anticipated graduation date of December 2027 or later.

Responsibilities

Support the analysis of marketing, member, and business performance data to identify trends and opportunities.Conduct research and exploratory analysis to help answer strategic business questions.Collaborate with analysts and business partners on marketing measurement and business intelligence projects.Gather, organize, and validate data from multiple sources to support analytical initiatives.Help evaluate the effectiveness of marketing campaigns, member programs, and business initiatives.Translate data findings into clear, actionable recommendations for business partners.Participate in team meetings, project discussions, and leadership presentations.Present project findings and recommendations to team members and leadership at the conclusion of the internship.Gain exposure to business intelligence, data analytics, marketing strategy, and financial services operations.


Qualifications

Must be currently pursuing master's degree from an accredited college or university.Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to draw clear, logical conclusions and recommendations from data.Experience working with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI and/or Tableau.Ability to analyze and interpret large datasets to identify trends, insights, and opportunities.Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.Ability to manage multiple tasks and work effectively in a collaborative team environment.Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering accurate, high-quality work.Interest in analytics, business intelligence, marketing strategy, or data-driven decision making.Demonstrated problem-solving skills and willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and analytical techniques.

The Consumer Loan Experience Management team seeks to increase product engagement, loyalty, and member value throughout the auto lending lifecycle. The Summer Associate will identify best-in-class experiences as our members transition through key touch points from application to loan servicing. The Summer Associate will utilize internal member data analytics reporting combined with vendor data to identify efficiencies and pain points throughout the lending journey. The Summer Associate will work in a flexible hybrid manner and report to leadership at either our Vienna, VA or Pensacola, FL campus. Responsibilities will include analyzing data and competitive trends to identify areas of opportunity and then creating recommendations to influence decision-makers. rows.descriptionText:
Overview

The Marketing Data Science & Analytics team partners with Marketing, Product, and Business stakeholders to turn data into actionable business insights. The team is responsible for campaign measurement, reporting, business intelligence, forecasting, customer analytics, and strategic research that help Navy Federal understand marketing performance, member behavior, and business outcomes. Our work supports executive decision-making by translating complex data into clear recommendations that improve member acquisition, engagement, and growth. The Summer Associate will work alongside analysts and business intelligence professionals on real-world business problems, gaining exposure to marketing analytics, reporting automation, data visualization, and strategic analysis. The role will involve analyzing large datasets, developing insights, creating presentations for leadership, and supporting initiatives that help answer key business questions.

Analyzing marketing campaign performance to identify drivers of member acquisition, product adoption, and engagement.Supporting the development of dashboards and automated reporting solutions that improve efficiency and business visibility.Conducting exploratory analyses to answer ambiguous business questions and uncover actionable insights from member and marketing data.Evaluating customer behavior and segmentation trends to support marketing strategy and targeting decisions.Assisting with measurement frameworks for major initiatives and product launches, including defining key performance indicators and success metrics.Creating executive-ready presentations that communicate findings, recommendations, and business impact to leadership.Researching emerging analytics techniques and tools that can improve reporting, measurement, and decision-making processes.

rows.title: Senior Marketing Associate
rows.descriptionText:
About Our Organization: Punchbowl News is a news content company focused on power, people, and politics in Washington. We are seeking a Senior Marketing Associate to join our growing team.
Punchbowl News’ primary focus is breaking news about power, the nation’s political leadership and explaining to our audience of political junkies how Washington works. We produce (at least) three newsletters each day, a daily podcast, dozens of events and more across our growing product suite.
Punchbowl News’ theory is that power in Washington emanates from the Capitol – and that’s the center of our focus. Our audience includes members of Congress, high-ranking members of the Trump administration, lobbyists, top-level reporters, media executives, Wall Streeters, tech and Fortune 500 executives and everyday political fans.
FLSA Status: ExemptEmployment Status: Full-time RegularPrimary Location: Washington, DC
Job Summary: Punchbowl News is seeking an innovative, nimble and data-driven Senior Marketing Associate to support growth and engagement among existing and prospective subscribers across our full portfolio of products and channels. Success will be measured in a variety of ways, including supporting list growth, contributing to free-to-paid conversion, and helping grow channel value and audience engagement.
The ideal candidate is highly collaborative, comfortable working across teams, politically curious, detail-oriented, proactive and analytical with a growth mindset. The candidate should be comfortable using data to help inform marketing strategies while also assisting with audience design and executing creative campaigns. This person would ideally come in with some exposure to a subscriber or member-focused environment and familiarity with marketing campaigns across a range of platforms and mediums.
Responsibilities:
General MarketingSupport execution of campaigns that convert free subscribers into paid members, including working closely with the Subscriptions team to help identify top targets and assist with nurture campaignsHelp build out messaging and audience segmentation plans for custom editorial products alongside the Director of Marketing and our digital ads partnerContribute ideas for marketing activations tied to events and partnerships, from experiences that drive member value to tactics that generate subscriptionsProduce collateral for our sales teams, from product one-pagers and testimonials to case studies and pitch decks
Social MediaSupport the Digital Content team in executing a strategy that turns organic social media engagement into subscription and list growthHelp promote events, partnerships and products across channels, supporting efforts to use each as a tool to boost subscriptionsWork closely with our digital ads partner to help create and refine paid social campaigns as needed across platformsEngage in social listening to track mentions of Punchbowl News across platforms
Email & NewslettersDraft the monthly marketing newsletter for the Portal, our legislative intelligence platform, to promote key updates and features to existing and potential subscribersWrite copy for marketing promotions in our newsletters that highlight products, launches and important milestonesSupport list-building efforts for key marketing initiatives such as Premium+ newsletter trials and event promotions, while helping qualify leadsHelp execute email campaigns designed to capture data and convert free subscribers to paid members
Performance TrackingMonitor marketing metrics regularly, from cost-per-acquisition to pageviews and social media engagement, and flag trends or suggest adjustments to optimize campaign performanceHelp compile and report relevant data to stakeholders on a regular basis, such as tracking content that is effectively driving subscriptions for the editorial teamAssist in building A/B testing plans to find what works across areas like marketing campaigns and social posting to identify areas for improvement
Qualifications:2-4 years of relevant experience (newsroom experience a plus)Experience using an email service provider or CRM for emails and list creation. Experience with HubSpot is a bonus, though not requiredExperience with organic or paid social media advertising a plusStrong copywriting skills and ability to engage in marketing speak authenticallyAn interest in data and leveraging it to make informed decisionsAbility to thrive in fast-paced, deadline-driven environmentsExcellent communication and cross-team collaboration skillsEnthusiasm for politics, journalism and digital storytellingA yearning to constantly grow and stay updated on marketing trendsExperience working within a subscription or membership-oriented business is preferredDesign experience a plus, though not required
Compensation & Benefits:The salary for this role is in the range of $75,000-$95,000. Final compensation will be based on scope, work experience, and relevant skills.
In addition to salary, Punchbowl News is pleased to offer other benefitsHealth Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, with 100% of premiums covered by Punchbowl News for employees and eligible family members.Retirement Plan: 401(k) with employer-matching contributions, available after six months of employment.Paid Time Off: 20 days of paid vacation annually, in addition to most federal holidays.Office-Wide Breaks: Two additional weeks of paid company-wide time off—end of August and end of December.Parental Leave: Up to 20 weeks of fully paid leave for birth parents. Non-birth parents or partners are eligible for 12 weeks of paid leave.Professional Development: Ongoing learning opportunities through internal training, programs, and external classes.
This is an in-person role based in Washington, DC, with required on-site attendance Monday through Thursday, and remote work on Fridays.

rows.title: Digital Engagement Associate
rows.descriptionText:
About Reingold

Reingold is a full-service marketing and creative firm in Alexandria, VA. For more than 40 years, we’ve been driven by a simple mission: to help organizations –– whether in the government, nonprofit, or business sector –– as they strive to make the world a better place. We hire top-notch talent to develop and launch compelling, inventive communications campaigns, leveraging the latest technology and digital media strategies that enable our clients to meet their audiences where they are.

We’re proud to say we’ve built a team of curious, passionate pros — from marketers and tech wizards to designers and strategists — who love what they do and bring their A-game every day. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We believe great ideas come from collaboration, humor, and a little bit of fun along the way.

When you work at Reingold, you get more than a job, you get a community. We offer competitive salaries, a comprehensive benefits package, a dynamic hybrid work environment, a vibrant workplace and growth opportunities in a variety of specialty areas. That means when we find great people (and they find us), they stick around for the long term.

That's where you come in. We’re looking for a digital engagement associate to join our Digital Project Management (DPM) team. In this role, you’ll manage the day-to-day coordination of digital projects and campaigns for a mix of government, nonprofit, and association clients, gathering requirements, building and maintaining roadmaps, tracking budgets and timelines, and keeping internal teams and clients aligned. You’ll also build working knowledge of digital marketing execution (paid media, email, SEO) so you can speak fluently to what your teams are producing, QA the work before it reaches the client, and eventually help shape channel strategy.

This is a Level 3 (L3) role on our DPM career ladder: you’re independent in managing established workstreams end to end, comfortable juggling several client accounts at once, and beginning to take ownership of client relationships, while still building toward full specialization.

This is a hybrid role. If you’re local to our Raleigh, North Carolina office, you’ll be required to come in one day a week. If you are local to our headquarters in Alexandria, Virginia, you will be required to come in two days a week.

Essential Functions

Here’s the work you’ll do:

Project & Product Coordination

Gather and document client requirements, objectives, and goals for digital experience and marketing engagements.Support Discovery workstreams and lead Story Mapping / Experience Canvas activities; help set up definition workshops.Prioritize product and campaign launches, identify milestones, and create and maintain roadmaps in Confluence and epics in Jira.Manage day-to-day budgeting, task assignments, and communication between internal teams and clients for assigned accounts.Monitor product and campaign KPIs, build and interpret Jira and analytics dashboards, and collaborate with Content Strategy, UX, and Analytics teams to keep messaging and brand consistent across deliverables.Identify and help remove roadblocks, internally, with clients, and with third-party vendors, before they put a timeline or budget at risk.Guide interdisciplinary teams on Agile and Kanban practices; participate in client calls, take accurate notes, and follow through on action items without needing a reminder.Track billable time accurately across multiple client accounts and consistently hit deadlines in a fast-moving agency environment.

Digital Marketing Execution

Support the planning, execution, and QA of paid media, email marketing, and SEO campaigns, including budget pacing, list segmentation, and rendering/link/UTM checks.Run and document A/B tests across paid and email, such as subject lines, send times, ad copy, creative, and landing pages, so the next campaign starts smarter.Track rankings, traffic, and overall channel performance; help investigate movement and translate results into recommendations for clients.Integrate AI into the daily workflow where appropriate, to streamline processes and strengthen insights.

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time.

This role is a good fit for someone with these qualifications, experience and skills:

Required Qualifications

General client-facing professional experience (agency, in-house, consulting, or a comparable setting), with no requirement to have specialized in a single marketing channel.Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and client accounts at once.Ability to work with clients to gather and document project requirements and translate them into actionable plans.A genuine interest in digital engagement and digital project management, with curiosity about how paid media, email, SEO, and content work together.Openness to, and excitement about, working in an AI-forward environment, comfortable using AI tools day to day and eager to keep learning new ones.An entrepreneurial spirit, comfortable taking initiative, proposing new approaches, and figuring things out without a fixed playbook.Curiosity, comfort with ambiguity, and a drive to succeed, even as priorities shift.Excellent oral and written communication skills, both with clients and internal teams, and the ability to explain a technical concept to someone who doesn’t work in marketing.A bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or a similar field (or equivalent work experience).

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with Agile and Kanban practices at an agency, product company, or software development shop.Familiarity with the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence) and collaborative tools such as Miro or Figjam.Hands-on experience running or supporting live campaigns in one or more focus areas, such as paid media, email marketing, or SEO.Working knowledge of Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager, including how to build a campaign, not just read a report about one.Familiarity with GA4 and Google Search Console.Comfort with spreadsheets, including pivot tables, lookups, and turning messy exports into a clean report.Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics (GA4), Meta Blueprint, or HubSpot.Hands-on experience with SEO tools such as Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or Moz.Hands-on GEO/AEO experience: implementing structured data, building answer-shaped or entity-rich content, prompt-set testing, or citation tracking across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, or AI Overviews.Experience supporting projects for state or local government agencies or organizations in highly regulated industries; ability to obtain a security clearance.

Supervisory Responsibilities: This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Work environment and physical requirements: Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

Travel: Occasional travel to client sites may be required on an as-needed basis.

Additional Information

The base salary range of $64,400.00 - $96,600.00 represents the low and high of the company’s pay range for this position. The budgeted starting salary is in the lower half of the base salary range. Individual compensation will vary based on experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and business needs. Full-time employees are eligible for comprehensive health and wellness benefits, 401(k) employer contributions and matching, and other benefits.

Reingold is dedicated to providing equal opportunity for individuals of all abilities. If you require assistance or need accommodation at any stage of the application process because of a disability or medical condition, please feel free to email careers@reingold.com or contact a member of the People & Experience team at 202-333-0400.

Reingold has a policy of maintaining a workplace free of drugs and alcohol. For access to the full policy, which is part of the Reingold Employee Handbook, email careers@reingold.com. Reingold ensures a safe, healthy, and productive work environment for its employees and others. All applicants are advised that full compliance with this policy is a condition of employment at Reingold.

Applicants must have authorization to work for any employer in the United States. We are currently unable to sponsor or to take over sponsorship of an employment visa. U.S. citizenship may be required for future project assignments that involve access to classified information. Candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance if required.

Reingold is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We invite applications from all interested individuals including veterans and persons with disabilities.

rows.title: Budget Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Currently hiring for the position of Budget Analyst under our Army Research Laboratories contract in Adelphi, MD. ALL APPLICANTS MUST BE U.S. CITIZENS.
We are looking for a college graduate with a strong background (and GPA – 3.0 is acceptable, but 3.5 or higher is preferred) in budgeting, accounting or finance in order to help the Budget Office personnel perform basic budgeting functions for large contracts. Candidates should have a strong working knowledge of Excel spreadsheets (overall analysis capabilities, formulas, macros) as well as a familiarity with general budgeting or accounting practices. Any experience with Federal budgeting systems OR SAP, specifically DoD (i.e. GFEBS/SOMARDS), is a plus. Upon hiring, candidate will be fully assimilated/trained into all of the knowledge areas required for the position. Here is an excerpt from our current contract’s Statement of Work that more explicitly describes the position:
The Contractor shall provide input to GFI or create its own spreadsheets/reports in order to track and monitor commitments, obligations, transfers and disbursements of specific accounting and appropriation data. The Contractor shall provide insights in terms of trend analysis on the time to make the award for any obligations received from internal ARL sources or other outside Agencies. Utilizing Financial Tracking tools (such as General Fund Enterprise Business System (GFEBS) and Standard Operation and Maintenance Army Research and Development System (SOMARDS)) the Contractor shall track and monitor commitments, obligations, transfers and disbursements of specific accounting and appropriation data. The Contractor shall also perform Un-liquidated Obligation and Commitments document research (including validating that account balances are properly documented and current; recommend adjustments to the appropriate budget analyst for incorrect balances; and process approved adjustments into the accounting systems). rows.title: Marketing & Brand Design Associate — Two Brands. Two Industries. A Lot to Create.
rows.descriptionText:
Marketing | Brand Design | Content | Digital | Creative
Full-Time | Washington, DC | In-Person | $50,000–$70,000 + Overtime Eligible
Some marketing jobs give you one channel to manage.
This one gives you two brands to help build.
Hylton-Rodic Law is a growing intellectual property law firm working at the intersection of science, technology, law, and innovation. EPIARX Diagnostics is a growing private pathology practice helping families, healthcare organizations, attorneys, and other professionals find answers when they matter most.
Different industries. Different audiences. Different voices.
And one creative role with a lot of room to make your mark.
We're looking for an emerging marketer and designer with serious creative instincts—someone who doesn't just know how to make things, but has ideas about what should be made and how to make it better.
You might spend one morning developing the visual concept for a life-sciences campaign and the afternoon creating collateral for a new pathology service. You could design a conference campaign, build a newsletter, develop a new sub-brand, reimagine a webpage, turn a technical topic into a scroll-stopping LinkedIn post, create firm swag, or take a rough business-development idea from “What if we...?” to finished campaign.
We will give you context, objectives, feedback, and room to grow.
We do not want to give you every creative answer.
We want someone who can take a rough idea, push it further, and occasionally put something in front of us that makes us stop and think:
“You just blew our socks off.”
Not every project. Not every time.
But if the idea of occasionally surprising us with something better than what we asked for sounds like your kind of challenge, keep reading.
Two Organizations. Two Very Different Stories to Tell.
Hylton-Rodic Law (HRL)
HRL is a boutique intellectual property law firm headquartered in Washington, DC. We work with biotechnology, pharmaceutical, university, and life-sciences innovators to protect and commercialize technologies shaping the future of medicine and science.
Our brand is sophisticated, intelligent, polished, creative, and decidedly not stuffy. You'll help us tell the stories behind innovative technologies, our people, our clients, and a law firm we're deliberately building differently.
EPIARX Diagnostics
EPIARX is a modern private pathology practice providing independent autopsy, pathology, consultation, and related services. Our audiences range from families seeking answers to funeral homes, hospitals, attorneys, and healthcare professionals.
The voice is different: clear, compassionate, trustworthy, accessible, and human.
EPIARX is growing its services, referral relationships, and regional presence. You won't simply maintain an established brand. You'll help build what comes next.
Working across both organizations will teach you something enormously valuable: how to understand an audience, switch voices, translate complicated subjects, and create marketing that actually supports growth.
What You'll Actually Do
You'll work across HRL and EPIARX, with priorities shifting as campaigns, events, business-development initiatives, and organizational needs evolve.
You'll help:
Create original visual concepts, graphics, carousels, social content, and campaigns for LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and other channels.Write, edit, design, and publish newsletters, blogs, website content, email campaigns, and digital communications.Turn complicated topics in intellectual property, life sciences, healthcare, and pathology into content people can actually understand—and want to read.Create polished print and physical collateral, including brochures, flyers, conference materials, mailers, signage, leave-behinds, business cards, and branded materials.Maintain and develop both organizations' Squarespace websites, including content, imagery, layout, landing pages, and new marketing initiatives.Support SEO/AIO and digital-content optimization.Build marketing calendars and move campaigns from idea → creation → review → publication.Help develop brands and sub-brands, including visual concepts, service identities, messaging, taglines, templates, and branded materials.Support email campaigns and CRM/marketing data through GoHighLevel.Help coordinate conferences, webinars, sponsorships, speaking engagements, and other events.Partner with business-development team members on campaigns, presentations, outreach materials, and growth initiatives.Coordinate with printers, photographers, designers, and other outside partners when needed.Create internal culture materials, welcome items, celebrations, swag, and the occasional project we haven't thought of yet.
And most importantly:
Bring ideas.
We don't expect every idea to be used.
We do expect you to have them.
We Can Teach You Our Industries. Bring Us the Creative Instinct.
You do not need to arrive knowing patent law or pathology.
You do need to be curious enough to learn them.
And you need an eye.
You understand typography, composition, hierarchy, imagery, color, spacing, and the details that separate something merely finished from something genuinely designed
You can start with a blank page—not just a template.
You can take a rough brief, develop a creative direction, make thoughtful choices, and explain why you made them.
You write exceptionally well and understand that words and visuals have to work together.
You notice when something isn't good enough before someone else has to tell you.
You are comfortable receiving detailed feedback, revising your work, killing an idea that isn't working, and coming back with something better.
Your first draft should give us something to react to—not something we have to rescue.
We're not looking for someone who has already mastered everything.
We're looking for talent, taste, curiosity, judgment, drive, and the desire to become exceptional.
What You Should Bring
Required
Bachelor's degree or equivalent demonstrated experience in graphic design, visual communication, marketing, advertising, communications, or a related creative discipline.Approximately 0–4 years of relevant professional experience, including substantive internships, freelance work, or exceptional student work.A portfolio demonstrating strong original visual-design work.Strong understanding of typography, composition, visual hierarchy, layout, and brand consistency.Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills.Experience creating digital and/or print marketing materials.Ability to take a creative brief from concept through finished execution.Strong organization and project-management skills.Proficiency with modern creative tools. Canva is useful, but Canva proficiency alone is not the design qualification for this role.
Especially Valuable
Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Illustrator, InDesign, and/or Photoshop.Figma or comparable design tools.Squarespace or other website-building experience.CRM/email-marketing experience; GoHighLevel is a plus.SEO/AIO or digital-content optimization.Photography, video, motion graphics, or multimedia production.Experience developing visual identities, campaigns, or brand systems.Experience with science, healthcare, technology, professional services, or other complex subject matter.
Compensation & Benefits
$50,000–$70,000 annually, depending on experience.
This position is non-exempt and overtime eligible.
Benefits include health, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) with employer matching; commuter benefits; paid time off; mental-health days; celebratory birthday leave; Sunshine Fridays; professional-development support; and our extended year-end holiday break.
Yes, We Want to See Your Work.
A résumé tells us where you've been.
Your portfolio tells us what you can do.
Please submit one combined PDF application package, in this order:
Cover letterRésuméCollege transcript — unofficial is acceptablePortfolio/work samples
Your portfolio should include 3–6 examples of your strongest work. Professional, internship, freelance, academic, student-organization, and personal projects are all welcome.
For at least two pieces, briefly tell us:
What was the objective? Who was the audience? What did you personally create? What creative choices did you make—and why?
If a piece was collaborative, clearly identify your contribution.
Applications without a portfolio demonstrating original creative work will not be considered.
Your Cover Letter
Please don't use your cover letter to summarize your résumé.
We already have that.
Instead, imagine it's your first week working with us.
You have been asked to create one piece of marketing for HRL and one for EPIARX.What would you create—and why?
Then tell us briefly about one piece of marketing, design, content, or brand work you've created that you're particularly proud of. What did you contribute? What problem were you trying to solve? What made the finished work successful in your view?
There are no “right” answers.
We want to see how you think.
Please combine all four required application materials into a single PDF before uploading. Incomplete application packages will not be considered.

rows.title: Digital Engagement Associate
rows.descriptionText:
About Reingold

Reingold is a full-service marketing and creative firm in Alexandria, VA. For more than 40 years, we’ve been driven by a simple mission: to help organizations –– whether in the government, nonprofit, or business sector –– as they strive to make the world a better place. We hire top-notch talent to develop and launch compelling, inventive communications campaigns, leveraging the latest technology and digital media strategies that enable our clients to meet their audiences where they are.

We’re proud to say we’ve built a team of curious, passionate pros — from marketers and tech wizards to designers and strategists — who love what they do and bring their A-game every day. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We believe great ideas come from collaboration, humor, and a little bit of fun along the way.

When you work at Reingold, you get more than a job, you get a community. We offer competitive salaries, a comprehensive benefits package, a dynamic hybrid work environment, a vibrant workplace and growth opportunities in a variety of specialty areas. That means when we find great people (and they find us), they stick around for the long term.

That's where you come in. We’re looking for a digital engagement associate to join our Digital Project Management (DPM) team. In this role, you’ll manage the day-to-day coordination of digital projects and campaigns for a mix of government, nonprofit, and association clients, gathering requirements, building and maintaining roadmaps, tracking budgets and timelines, and keeping internal teams and clients aligned. You’ll also build working knowledge of digital marketing execution (paid media, email, SEO) so you can speak fluently to what your teams are producing, QA the work before it reaches the client, and eventually help shape channel strategy.

This is a Level 3 (L3) role on our DPM career ladder: you’re independent in managing established workstreams end to end, comfortable juggling several client accounts at once, and beginning to take ownership of client relationships, while still building toward full specialization.

This is a hybrid role. If you’re local to our Raleigh, North Carolina office, you’ll be required to come in one day a week. If you are local to our headquarters in Alexandria, Virginia, you will be required to come in two days a week.

Essential Functions

Here’s the work you’ll do:

Project & Product Coordination

Gather and document client requirements, objectives, and goals for digital experience and marketing engagements.Support Discovery workstreams and lead Story Mapping / Experience Canvas activities; help set up definition workshops.Prioritize product and campaign launches, identify milestones, and create and maintain roadmaps in Confluence and epics in Jira.Manage day-to-day budgeting, task assignments, and communication between internal teams and clients for assigned accounts.Monitor product and campaign KPIs, build and interpret Jira and analytics dashboards, and collaborate with Content Strategy, UX, and Analytics teams to keep messaging and brand consistent across deliverables.Identify and help remove roadblocks, internally, with clients, and with third-party vendors, before they put a timeline or budget at risk.Guide interdisciplinary teams on Agile and Kanban practices; participate in client calls, take accurate notes, and follow through on action items without needing a reminder.Track billable time accurately across multiple client accounts and consistently hit deadlines in a fast-moving agency environment.

Digital Marketing Execution

Support the planning, execution, and QA of paid media, email marketing, and SEO campaigns, including budget pacing, list segmentation, and rendering/link/UTM checks.Run and document A/B tests across paid and email, such as subject lines, send times, ad copy, creative, and landing pages, so the next campaign starts smarter.Track rankings, traffic, and overall channel performance; help investigate movement and translate results into recommendations for clients.Integrate AI into the daily workflow where appropriate, to streamline processes and strengthen insights.

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time.

This role is a good fit for someone with these qualifications, experience and skills:

Required Qualifications

General client-facing professional experience (agency, in-house, consulting, or a comparable setting), with no requirement to have specialized in a single marketing channel.Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and client accounts at once.Ability to work with clients to gather and document project requirements and translate them into actionable plans.A genuine interest in digital engagement and digital project management, with curiosity about how paid media, email, SEO, and content work together.Openness to, and excitement about, working in an AI-forward environment, comfortable using AI tools day to day and eager to keep learning new ones.An entrepreneurial spirit, comfortable taking initiative, proposing new approaches, and figuring things out without a fixed playbook.Curiosity, comfort with ambiguity, and a drive to succeed, even as priorities shift.Excellent oral and written communication skills, both with clients and internal teams, and the ability to explain a technical concept to someone who doesn’t work in marketing.A bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or a similar field (or equivalent work experience).

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with Agile and Kanban practices at an agency, product company, or software development shop.Familiarity with the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence) and collaborative tools such as Miro or Figjam.Hands-on experience running or supporting live campaigns in one or more focus areas, such as paid media, email marketing, or SEO.Working knowledge of Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager, including how to build a campaign, not just read a report about one.Familiarity with GA4 and Google Search Console.Comfort with spreadsheets, including pivot tables, lookups, and turning messy exports into a clean report.Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics (GA4), Meta Blueprint, or HubSpot.Hands-on experience with SEO tools such as Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or Moz.Hands-on GEO/AEO experience: implementing structured data, building answer-shaped or entity-rich content, prompt-set testing, or citation tracking across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, or AI Overviews.Experience supporting projects for state or local government agencies or organizations in highly regulated industries; ability to obtain a security clearance.

Supervisory Responsibilities: This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Work environment and physical requirements: Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

Travel: Occasional travel to client sites may be required on an as-needed basis.

rows.title: Grants & Contracts Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
We are seeking a Grants & Contracts Analyst who will provide dedicated professional level sponsored funds management for more than 80% of time with specific responsibility for pre-award and post-award functions that include, but may not be limited to, proposal preparation, submission, budget development, account maintenance and oversight, billing/invoicing, reporting, compliance, and closeout. Works independently on a variety of grants/contracts that range from simple to moderately complex. While this role may assist with some aspects of non-sponsored funds, the primary goal of this position is to ensure timely, effective and efficient functioning of sponsored funding. This is an exempt position.

Job Scope/Complexity

Will work independently most of the time, with support from Principal Investigator (PI) and/or senior/management level grants & contract professionals on increasingly more complex grants/contracts. Will provide standard professional administrative level guidance on protocols, regulations and guidelines to PI and other scientific/research professionals within the department. May interact with external research/administrative professionals.

Types of sponsored awards for which the position is responsible

This role functions at an intermediate level, with responsibility for independent management of simple to moderately complex grants/contracts, including those from NIH, NSF, DOD and NASA. These grants, contracts and awards may involve detailed budgets, subawards and special instructions in RFA, career awards, training awards, multi-project grants, complex foundation grants, subawards from other institutions on their federal pass-through grants and pharmaceutical company clinical trials.

Specific Duties & Responsibilities

Partner with departmental faculty and/or budgetary staff and the Office of Research Administration toward the planning and development of application submissions to various federal offices, private agencies/foundations and commercial companies. Understand and utilize institutional policies for pre-award grant process and sponsor guidelines. Review all sponsored project proposals for assigned faculty prior to them being forwarded to the Grants & Contracts Manager and ORA for signature. Review involves accuracy, content, adherence to all relevant guidelines. Provide instruction, preparation assistance and support related to grant application procedures. Serve as liaison between research units, central offices and funding agencies. Review budgets and related justification for appropriateness and completeness of content. Ensures that all applicable and indirect costs have been applied. May also provide groundwork for subcontract negotiations. Ensure compliance in all other areas related to grant and contract management, including sponsoring organization guidelines, internal protocols, accurate protocol information within grant documents, conflicts of interest, etc. Manage all assigned grant submissions to ensure timeliness and accuracy. Maintain ongoing updates and communications related to current grants and contracts, this includes regular auditing and reporting to principal investigators and departmental leadership. Assist with closeouts as needed. Coordinate the process of setting up awards in designated department/division after grant number is assigned, including reviewing award, verifying award set-up and ensuring personnel is set up appropriately. Ensure that post-award responsibilities are completed, including budget distribution, account reconciliation, e-form setup, effort reporting, cost transfers, paying invoices and paperwork finalization related to subcontract setup. Conduct complex award management activities and provide oversight to other employees, including monitoring and managing accounts, audits, evaluations and reporting. Provide information and direct assistance required to complete contract and grant closeouts. Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree.Two years of administrative/budgeting experience.Additional education may substitute for required experience, and additional related experience may substitute for required education beyond a high school diploma/graduation equivalent, to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula.

Preferred Qualifications

Thorough knowledge and understanding of the Johns Hopkins University accounting system and related fiscal offices.

Position Summary

The Junior Healthcare Credit Analyst supports the evaluation and underwriting of healthcare real estate financing opportunities, including skilled nursing, assisted living, memory care, and other healthcare-related assets. Working closely with senior credit team members and originators, this role assists with financial analysis, due diligence, credit memoranda, and transaction underwriting from initial opportunity review through loan approval and closing. The Junior Healthcare Credit Analyst is expected to develop a strong foundation in healthcare lending, commercial credit analysis, financial statement analysis, and loan structuring.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

 Assist with the analysis of business, facility, and personal financial statements, operating performance, and cash flow to evaluate borrowers, guarantors, and healthcare facilities. Support originators and senior credit team members during the transaction process by gathering information, conducting preliminary analysis, and identifying potential credit considerations. Develop working knowledge of credit analysis, including primary and secondary repayment sources, cash flow, guarantor strength, collateral adequacy, and balance sheet analysis. Assist in preparing term sheet recommendation packages for prospective healthcare real estate financing opportunities. Prepare and maintain supporting analyses and documentation for Loan Committee and credit approval packages, including financial spreads, profitability models, risk ratings, HVCRE assessments, stress testing, and other required documentation. Assist with coordinating, organizing, and reviewing financial, operational, legal, appraisal, environmental, and other due diligence materials. Participate in transaction discussions with originators, credit team members, borrowers, operators, appraisers, attorneys, consultants, and lending partners as appropriate. Support the underwriting of healthcare real estate transactions, including skilled nursing facilities, assisted living facilities, memory care communities, and other healthcare-related assets. Develop knowledge of healthcare industry trends, regulatory considerations, and market conditions impacting healthcare real estate. Participate in special projects, process improvement initiatives, and portfolio reviews as assigned.

Qualifications And Requirements

 Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field preferred. 0-2 years of experience in commercial credit, financial analysis, banking, commercial real estate, healthcare finance, accounting, or a related field. Relevant internship experience may be considered. Foundational understanding of financial statements, accounting concepts, cash flow analysis, and financial modeling. Interest in developing expertise in healthcare real estate and commercial lending. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Ability to work collaboratively with originators, credit analysts, portfolio managers, credit officers, and other stakeholders. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills. Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

In accordance with Maryland's Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, we are committed to providing transparent wage information for all posted job opportunities. The wage range for this position is $65,000 to $65,000 annually. Compensation is determined based on factors such as Experience, Qualifications, and Internal equity.

Additionally, this position includes a comprehensive benefits package and other forms of compensation, including:

 Employer-provided health benefits: medical insurance, dental and vision insurance, disability insurance, life insurance, mental health support services, and wellness program Paid time off: vacation days, sick leave, volunteer days Retirement plan: 401(k) with employer match Other compensation elements: Discretionary annual bonus and overtime pay for non-exempt positions

rows.title: Contract Operations Specialist

The Contract Operations Specialist is responsible for reviewing executed customer contracts and accurately entering key commercial terms into internal systems. This includes products and services purchased, pricing, contract dates, billing terms, and payment schedules.

rows.title: Operations Senior Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
We improve lives

The IDB Group is a community of diverse, versatile, and passionate people who come together on a journey to improve lives in Latin America and the Caribbean. Our people find purpose and do what they love in an inclusive, collaborative, agile, and rewarding environment.

About This Position

We are looking for a service-oriented, dynamic, and motivated professional to join our team as Operations Senior Analyst to perform technical and analytical activities to improve the quality of the Department's operational products.

You will work in the Climate Change and Sustainable Development Department (CSD) as part of the CSD Front Office, you will collaborate closely with operations teams, contributing to the quality and effectiveness of the Department's loan project proposals and Technical Cooperations (TCs), enhancing the performance of its operations portfolio, and advancing CSD's operational agenda across its areas of work by facilitating coordination between CSD Divisions and Units.

What You’ll Do

Provide analytical, technical, and research support to sovereign-guaranteed and non-sovereign-guaranteed operations throughout key project review and approval stages.Review project proposals to strengthen their design, evaluability, development effectiveness, institutional and financial analysis, risk management, and overall quality. Ensure operational products align with Bank policies, operational standards, departmental priorities, country needs, and relevant international practices. Conduct sector research, policy reviews, comparative analyses, and data-driven assessments to inform project preparation and implementation. Monitor pipeline and portfolio performance, identify implementation bottlenecks and emerging risks, and recommend actions to improve project delivery. Track the preparation, quality, and timely submission of project completion reports and help teams incorporate findings and lessons learned. Prepare dashboards, analytical reports, research briefs, briefing notes, presentations, and other materials to support management decision-making and strategic planning. Coordinate with CSD divisions and units to advance operational effectiveness, disseminate knowledge and good practices, and support departmental initiatives

What You'll Need

Education: Bachelor's degree in economics, public policy, public administration, international relations, political science, law or related field, or other fields relevant to the responsibilities of the role. Experience: One (1) year of relevant applied professional experience (preferably three [3] years), with a strong background in project design and/or management, evaluability, monitoring and evaluation. Experience supporting the project cycle, including project preparation, implementation, and reporting, as well as data analysis and dashboard development, is desirable. Experience in the LAC public sector and/or international development organizations is highly desirable. Experience at the IDB and knowledge of IDB policies, instruments, procedures, and systems are preferred.Languages: Proficiency in Spanish and English, spoken and written, is required. Additional knowledge of French and Portuguese is preferable. 

Requirements

Citizenship: You are a citizen of one of our 48-member countries. We may offer assistance with relocation and visa applications for you and your eligible dependents.Consanguinity: You have no family members (up to the fourth degree of consanguinity and second degree of affinity, including spouse) working at the IDB, IDB Invest, or IDB Lab.

Type of contract and duration

 International staff contract, 36 months initially, renewable upon mutual agreement.

What We Offer

The IDB group provides benefits that respond to the different needs and moments of an employee's life. These benefits include:

A competitive compensation package, including an annual base salary expressed on a net-of-tax basis.Leaves and vacations: 24 days of paid time off + 8 personal days + sick leave + gender-neutral parental leave.Health Insurance: IDB Group provides employees and eligible dependents with a robust medical benefits program that covers medical, dental, vision, preventive care, and prescription drugs.Pension plan: defined benefit pension plan that provides financial security and support employees in planning for their future.We offer assistance with relocation and visa applications for you and your family when it applies.On-site position with the occasional flexibility of teleworking.Health and well-being: Access to our Health Services Center that provides preventive care and health education for employees.Development support: We offer tools to boost your professional profile, such as mentoring, 1:1 professional counseling, training and learning opportunities, language classes, mobility options, among others.Other office amenities (as available): Lactation Room, Daycare Center, Gym, Bike Racks, Parking, spouse career support, and others.

Our culture

At the IDB, we work so everyone brings their best and authentic selves to work while finding their purpose. Our people consistently strive for excellence, and we recognize and celebrate the impact of their contributions.

In our efforts to drive innovation, we intentionally include all voices, cultivate a sense of belonging and champion fairness. We welcome individuals from underrepresented groups to join us and share their unique perspectives.

rows.title: Data Analyst, In-Store
rows.descriptionText:
About The Team

The SevenRooms Data & Analytics team is the foundational data hub powering go-to-market, product, finance, and operational decisions across the In-Store business. We design and maintain the pipelines, models, and infrastructure that connect SevenRooms' systems with the broader DoorDash data ecosystem — and we're investing aggressively in making our datasets ready for both human and AI consumption. Within the team, our product-focused analytics work owns the funnels, personas, and feature-adoption insights that inform what products and features get built, how it's launched, and how it performs in the market.

About The Role

We're hiring a Data Analyst to be the data partner for our Product Management, Product Marketing, and executive teams at SevenRooms. You will own the building of data products, feature launch analytics, and the PLG instrumentation that connects product usage signals back into Salesforce, Gainsight, and our outbound motions.

You will report into the Manager, Data & Analytics on our Data & Analytics team in our SevenRooms organization.

You're Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will…

Own product analytics end-to-end — funnels, adoption, retention, and ROI for every major feature launch on the SevenRooms platform.Build net new data products aimed at improving analytic and reporting capabilitiesPartner with Product Managers and Product Marketers on pre-launch hypotheses , beta testing results, post-launch measurement, and ongoing optimization.Design and ship PLG automations that translate product behavior into opportunity tagging, expansion signals, and CSM workflows.Apply GenAI and ML techniques — partnering with our GTM Engineer — to product analytics use cases like web-sourced feature adoption opportunities, transactions predictive modeling, and Add-On ICP scoring.Communicate closely in support of multiple PM’s with reporting and ad-hoc analysis

We're Excited About You Because…

A degree in Math, Physics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a similar domain2+ years of experience analyzing product data and partnering with Product Management teams in a SaaS environment.Expert SQL skills and proficiency with a cloud BI tool such as Looker, Tableau, or Mode.Hands-on experience with product instrumentation and analytics platforms such as Pendo, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Heap.Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous product questions into rigorous, scoped analyses that ship recommendations — not just dashboards.Strong written and verbal communication skills, including comfort presenting to product and executive audiences.

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See Below For Paid Time Off Details

For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.

$98,600—$145,000 USD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

On any given day you will be challenged by three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation

Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumersDemonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives

Business Intelligence

Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualizationDrive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies

Data Management

Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitionsWork collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governanceBuild and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality

Our ideal candidate will have:

Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics disciplineScripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)Experience utilizing and developing within Snowflake services

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 2 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.  At least 1 year of experience working with at least one scripting language  At least 1 year of experience utilizing business intelligence visualization tool  At least 1 year of experience querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms

Preferred Qualifications:

Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics disciplineAt least 2 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQLAt least 2 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc. At least 1 year of experience utilizing and developing within AWS servicesAt least 1 year of experience working with and demonstrating knowledge of data governance, data quality management concepts and data quality tools (i.e. Informatica DQ)

rows.title: Budget Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Currently hiring for the position of Budget Analyst under our Army Research Laboratories contract in Adelphi, MD. ALL APPLICANTS MUST BE U.S. CITIZENS.
We are looking for a college graduate with a strong background (and GPA – 3.0 is acceptable, but 3.5 or higher is preferred) in budgeting, accounting or finance in order to help the Budget Office personnel perform basic budgeting functions for large contracts. Candidates should have a strong working knowledge of Excel spreadsheets (overall analysis capabilities, formulas, macros) as well as a familiarity with general budgeting or accounting practices. Any experience with Federal budgeting systems OR SAP, specifically DoD (i.e. GFEBS/SOMARDS), is a plus. Upon hiring, candidate will be fully assimilated/trained into all of the knowledge areas required for the position. Here is an excerpt from our current contract’s Statement of Work that more explicitly describes the position:
The Contractor shall provide input to GFI or create its own spreadsheets/reports in order to track and monitor commitments, obligations, transfers and disbursements of specific accounting and appropriation data. The Contractor shall provide insights in terms of trend analysis on the time to make the award for any obligations received from internal ARL sources or other outside Agencies. Utilizing Financial Tracking tools (such as General Fund Enterprise Business System (GFEBS) and Standard Operation and Maintenance Army Research and Development System (SOMARDS)) the Contractor shall track and monitor commitments, obligations, transfers and disbursements of specific accounting and appropriation data. The Contractor shall also perform Un-liquidated Obligation and Commitments document research (including validating that account balances are properly documented and current; recommend adjustments to the appropriate budget analyst for incorrect balances; and process approved adjustments into the accounting systems). The Contractor shall also provide insights in terms of trend analysis on the time to make the award for any obligations received from internal ARL sources or other outside Agencies. The Contractor shall research the entire spectrum of pertinent Financial Management Regulations in order to provide insights on the appropriate use of funding for particular upcoming technical requirements.
As knowledge is gained/mastered, there is significant growth built into the contract to advance in both position and salary.
NOTE: Occasional travel may be required to visit contractor or Government sites.

rows.descriptionText:
The Opportunity

As a Senior Associate on the AI Governance team within the Digital Assurance & Technology team, you will focus on developing AI governance frameworks that align with industry standards. As a Senior Associate, you will manage projects that assess governance, risk, and control programs while translating complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders. This role presents a unique opportunity to influence AI practices and drive impactful change within the organization.

In this role, you will be part of our Risk and Compliance team, where you will leverage your skills to analyze complex problems and develop deliverables within client service engagements. You will use a broad range of tools, methodologies, and techniques to generate new ideas and solve problems, while upholding professional and technical standards. This position offers a unique opportunity to develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is changing, all within our Assurance practice.

Responsibilities

 Navigating complex regulatory landscapes to provide risk management solutions for clients Building and maintaining meaningful client relationships to understand and anticipate their needs Utilizing critical thinking to break down complex concepts and develop actionable insights Applying risk governance methodologies to enhance internal controls and mitigate risks Interpreting data to inform strategic recommendations and support decision-making processes Upholding professional and technical standards in alignment with firm guidelines and independence requirements Collaborating with teams to generate innovative ideas and solve regulatory compliance challenges Mentoring junior team members to foster their development and enhance team performance

What You Must Have

 At least a Bachelor's degree At least 2 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

 Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Business Administration/Management, Computer Science/Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Economics, Engineering, Finance, Mathematics/Statistics, Project/Technology Management Applying experience in AI/ML governance, risk, controls, audit, testing, and validation, including awareness of AI lifecycles and leading risk frameworks such as NIST and ISO Supporting the design and assessment of AI governance models, policies, standards, and control programs, while translating technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders Demonstrating skills in risk governance within complex environments Navigating ambiguity while maintaining professional standards Building meaningful client relationships and anticipating needs Utilizing critical thinking to break down complex concepts Interpreting data to inform insights and recommendations Developing a deeper understanding of changing business contexts

rows.descriptionText:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

Start Your Career Where Innovation Meets Purpose 

Are you an explorer and experimenter, someone who’s not afraid to ask questions and stretch boundaries? At Accenture Federal Services, our Summer Analyst (Intern) Program is designed for curious minds who want to dive into the world of technology, AI, and federal innovation. If you’re excited by the idea of solving real-world problems, learning new tools, and working side-by-side with project teams, this is your starting point.

As a Summer Analyst, you’ll gain hands-on exposure aligned to the three (3) core positions we’re hiring for in our analyst community:

AI & Data Analyst: Dive into data analytics, machine learning, and intelligent automation. You’ll explore how we use tools like Python, SQL, and Power BI to uncover insights, optimize decisions, and deliver AI-powered solutions for federal agencies. Product & Platform Engineering Analyst: Get a taste of full-stack development, cloud-native engineering, and AI integration. You’ll work with modern frameworks, learn agile delivery, and help build secure, scalable systems that support mission-critical operations. Technology Analyst: Explore how we help federal clients adopt emerging technologies, apply structured thinking, and deliver innovative solutions. You’ll learn how to analyze business needs, experiment with next-gen IT, and contribute to digital transformation efforts. 

What You’ll Do

Collaborate with project teams to solve real-world client problems within federal missions Translate business and mission objectives into technology‑driven strategies and solutions Experiment with emerging technologies, frameworks, and approaches—including agentic AI and modern development tools Apply structured thinking, creativity, and analysis to develop recommendations and impactful solutions Contribute to software engineering, data analysis, or technology advisory tasks depending on project alignment Participate in learning experiences, mentorship opportunities, workshops, and networking across AFS Support digital transformation efforts through research, testing, documentation, and solution design 

Basic Qualifications 

Must be a rising senior/4th year undergraduate student, with graduation by August 31, 2028.  Strong academic track record (3.2+ cumulative GPA) from a 4-year accredited institution.  U.S. citizenship required (due to federal contract requirements)  Ability to travel 25-50% preferred, but requirements vary by team and location.

rows.title: Junior Credit Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
CFG Bank, based in Baltimore, Maryland, is a leading financial institution serving the national healthcare and multifamily markets and the Mid-Atlantic region. As the 6th largest bank in Baltimore by deposits and the largest locally based, we've grown from $1 billion to over $6+ billion in assets by 2026. With over 30 years of expertise, we rank among the top five healthcare bridge-to-HUD lenders in the country. At CFG Bank, we redefine banking by blending big bank capabilities with personalized boutique service. Recognized as a “Best Place to Work” by the Baltimore Business Journal across multiple years, we’re intentional about creating an environment where people feel valued, supported, and excited about work each day. Our goal is simple: to make every team member feel that choosing CFG Bank was one of the best decisions of their career. Join us and experience what sets CFG Bank apart.

Position Summary

The Junior Healthcare Credit Analyst supports the evaluation and underwriting of healthcare real estate financing opportunities, including skilled nursing, assisted living, memory care, and other healthcare-related assets. Working closely with senior credit team members and originators, this role assists with financial analysis, due diligence, credit memoranda, and transaction underwriting from initial opportunity review through loan approval and closing. The Junior Healthcare Credit Analyst is expected to develop a strong foundation in healthcare lending, commercial credit analysis, financial statement analysis, and loan structuring.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

 Assist with the analysis of business, facility, and personal financial statements, operating performance, and cash flow to evaluate borrowers, guarantors, and healthcare facilities. Support originators and senior credit team members during the transaction process by gathering information, conducting preliminary analysis, and identifying potential credit considerations. Develop working knowledge of credit analysis, including primary and secondary repayment sources, cash flow, guarantor strength, collateral adequacy, and balance sheet analysis. Assist in preparing term sheet recommendation packages for prospective healthcare real estate financing opportunities. Prepare and maintain supporting analyses and documentation for Loan Committee and credit approval packages, including financial spreads, profitability models, risk ratings, HVCRE assessments, stress testing, and other required documentation. Assist with coordinating, organizing, and reviewing financial, operational, legal, appraisal, environmental, and other due diligence materials. Participate in transaction discussions with originators, credit team members, borrowers, operators, appraisers, attorneys, consultants, and lending partners as appropriate. Support the underwriting of healthcare real estate transactions, including skilled nursing facilities, assisted living facilities, memory care communities, and other healthcare-related assets. Develop knowledge of healthcare industry trends, regulatory considerations, and market conditions impacting healthcare real estate. Participate in special projects, process improvement initiatives, and portfolio reviews as assigned.

Qualifications And Requirements

 Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field preferred. 0-2 years of experience in commercial credit, financial analysis, banking, commercial real estate, healthcare finance, accounting, or a related field. Relevant internship experience may be considered. Foundational understanding of financial statements, accounting concepts, cash flow analysis, and financial modeling. Interest in developing expertise in healthcare real estate and commercial lending. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Ability to work collaboratively with originators, credit analysts, portfolio managers, credit officers, and other stakeholders. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills. Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Compensation Disclosure

In accordance with Maryland's Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, we are committed to providing transparent wage information for all posted job opportunities. The wage range for this position is $65,000 to $65,000 annually. Compensation is determined based on factors such as Experience, Qualifications, and Internal equity.

Benefits And Additional Compensation

Additionally, this position includes a comprehensive benefits package and other forms of compensation, including:

 Employer-provided health benefits: medical insurance, dental and vision insurance, disability insurance, life insurance, mental health support services, and wellness program Paid time off: vacation days, sick leave, volunteer days Retirement plan: 401(k) with employer match Other compensation elements: Discretionary annual bonus and overtime pay for non-exempt positions
