You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and take pride in a diverse environment. We would love to find out more about you as a candidate and do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, or other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital or veteran status, medical condition or disability, or any other legally protected status.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to access job openings or apply for a job on this site as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by contacting USApplicationAccommodation@support.lorealusa.com. If you need assistance to accommodate a disability, you may request an accommodation at any time.

Our Safe Together Plan: Your safety is our highest priority. We will proceed with caution and adhere to enhanced protection standards to ensure our sites are safe for all employees. We must all operate with the shared responsibility for each other’s health & safety in mind.

rows.title: Strategic Revenue Management
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

The SRM Field Manager (T2) serves as a strategic business partner and commercial expert for a designated customer group, driving the seamless integration of promotional strategies and execution frameworks. Reporting to the SRM Field Lead, this role is the key steward of the annual planning and Joint Business Planning (JBP) processes, driving the execution of optimized enterprise trade investment frameworks, and pricing strategies to maximize category value and profit pool growth. By leveraging advanced analytics and democratizing the SRM digital toolkit across field sales teams, the role builds robust in-market capabilities and aligns local executions with overarching national strategy to achieve mutually profitable growth.

Price Pack Planning: Lead the development, alignment, and execution of tailored price-pack and promotional strategies to optimize the overall channel-pack ecosystem and meet specific shopper needs.Strategic JBP & Annual Business Planning: Partner closely with sales teams to elevate Joint Business Planning (JBP) and annual business planning from tactical transactions to strategic commercial partnerships, utilizing scenario modeling and analytics to drive mix accretion and customer margin roadmaps.STAR Process & Upside Deployment: Lead the local deployment of the STAR promotional optimization process, establishing data-driven feedback loops to monitor execution, manage "dial for dollars" routines, and identify commercial upside opportunities.Trade Investment Leadership: Co-pilot and implement optimized trade investment and trade terms execution at the customer level, ensuring full alignment with national guardrails while maximizing ROI on trade spend.Performance Deconstruction & Cost-to-Serve: Lead comprehensive decomposition of performance drivers across channels, translating complex insights into actionable commercial recommendations for sales and SRM leadership.Assortment & SKU Optimization: Input into efficient SKU prioritization, physical/digital shelf assortment strategies, and targeted brand launch initiatives in collaboration with marketing and sales strategy to drive structural margin improvements.Digital Toolkit Democratization: Act as the primary champion for embedding SRM digital capabilities (including Salesforce and Anaplan platforms) into field sales routines to democratize forecasting, planning, and tracking data.Cross-Functional & Matrix Influence: Operate as the central connection point to synthesize pricing, promo, and digital strategies across internal SRM teams, sales capabilities, business management, and major retail partners.

Technical & Functional Skills: Possess strong technical and analytical skillsCustomer Focus: Understand customer needs and align trade strategiesLeveraging Insights to Action: Translate trade insights into actionable recommendations for the sales teams and the enterpriseDrive for Results: Demonstrate a strong commitment to achieving goals and objectives

Key Supporting Competencies

Analytical Acumen: Ability to analyze trade data from various sources, manipulate information, and make appropriate recommendationsProblem Solving: Effectively identify and address trade-related challenges and opportunitiesPeer Relationships: Collaborate and foster positive relationships with cross-functional teams involved in trade-related activities

Key Functional Skills/Knowledge

Demonstrated ability to manipulate information from various sources, analyze data, and make appropriate recommendations.Strong Excel skillset for data manipulation and analysis.Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with internal and external teamsProactive and service-oriented mindset to drive continuous improvement in trade processes.Learning Agility: Ability to adapt quickly and apply new learnings quickly

3-5 years of working experience and/or internship experience in a related field1-3 years experience in SRMFour-year college degreeExperience demonstrating advanced problem-solving and analytical capabilities in a cross-functional team environment

1–3 years of hands-on experience in Ecommerce/Digital Commerce, showing a deep understanding of omnichannel pricing, digital promotional execution, and platform KPIs.

rows.title: Associate Manager, App & Loyalty
rows.descriptionText:
We are Reckitt

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

Mead Johnson Nutrition

Mead Johnson Nutrition (MJN) is Reckitt’s specialized, science-led infant and child nutrition business. With over 100 years of pediatric nutrition expertise, MJN is known for its clinical, science-based approach to innovation and its expanding focus on specialized nutrition. Its market-leading brands, including Enfamil and Nutramigen, support early childhood development and lifelong health. MJN operates in over 50 countries and plays a vital role in delivering high-quality nourishment to families around the world. Enfamil is the leading global infant formula brand, and the most recommended by pediatricians in MJN's core markets.

Marketing

Marketing is at the heart of Reckitt. We pride ourselves on our unique way of driving growth for some of the world's most loved and trusted health, hygiene and nutrition brands. Our purpose and fight are what motivates us to design and deliver distinctive communications throughout our consumer funnel, so that we deliver category growth as well as a positive impact on society. With extensive media and digital teams embedded throughout the organisation, we measure both our business and our societal impact. Our global teams lead on our overarching brand strategy, brand guardianship and innovation pipeline in close partnership with R&D. Leaving our local marketing teams to deliver on our regional goals in partnership with our Sales teams. With the scale of our 2500 marketing community - alongside our leading-edge Marketing Academy - your opportunities to grow and upskill will be extensive.

About The Role

Do you want to make a difference in millions of lives? Come join our team. As Associate Product Manager, App & Rewards on Enfamil at Reckitt, you will be responsible for providing helpful insights, knowledge, and value for expecting and new parents via our mobile app and rewards program. You will enhance the app experience, drive increased engagement, brand affinity, and product sales. You will also own the ongoing operations and continued enhancement of the Enfamil Rewards program, a key engagement driver for the brand.

As part of the Site & App Team, you will be core to connecting with and providing value to parents, caregivers, and moms, delivering educational content, rewards, and helpful utilities. Your work will be directly attributed to the overall growth of the business and will be highly visible to business leadership. You will report to the Team Lead, Web/App/Rewards, sitting within the broader Digital Marketing and Consumer Engagement team.

You will partner with the Product Manager, Web to develop the product roadmap, assess performance opportunities, own implementation plans, and lead successful launches that drive KPI improvements. You are passionate about contributing to great consumer-centric digital products, and this shows in your past work. You are a strategic and analytical thinker with a genuine curiosity for AI-driven personalization. You work well with others, and you always put the consumer’s needs first. You’re both a thinker and a doer. Your work will support our mission to nourish the world’s children for the best start in life by keeping our mobile app and rewards program fresh, up-to-date, and contextually relevant for the moms and caregivers who depend on it.

Your focus & time should be split:

60% — Creating, deploying, and running campaign and feature enhancement projects/initiatives

20% — Engaging with cross-functional partners on Operations & Administration

20% — Data Reporting, Analysis, and AI-driven Optimization

You must bring an entrepreneurial can-do spirit, a data-driven and AI-curious mindset, and the discipline to deliver enhancements on time and on target.

Your responsibilities

Vision & Strategy Support

Partner with Product leaders to shape and execute the product roadmap for the mobile app and rewards program. Contribute to strategic planning by surfacing insights from user behavior, performance data, competitive trends, and AI-driven signals. 

App Experience & Feature Enhancements

Support the development and deployment of new app features and utilities. Maintain and prioritize the product backlog in collaboration with design and development teams, ensuring it includes maintenance tasks, bug fixes, and feature enhancements. Write clear business requirements, user flow diagrams, and functional specs as needed. 

Performance Analytics, AI & Optimization

Own reporting and analysis for app and rewards KPIs, including downloads, MAU/WAU, engagement metrics, and rewards redemption rates. Use Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Firebase, and Snipp’s native reporting tools to monitor performance and identify optimization opportunities. Partner with Consumer Insights and Data Science teams to analyze custom KPIs and uncover deeper behavioral insights. Build and execute A/B testing plans in partnership with UX and analytics teams. Leverage data for audience segmentation, targeting, and personalization strategies that drive engagement and conversion. 

Push Notifications & Campaign Execution

Manage the ongoing push notification stream, including regularly scheduled and ad hoc messages, with hands-on configuration in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC). Collaborate with CRM and 1:1 teams to ensure messaging is timely, relevant, personalized, and aligned with broader campaign goals. 

Rewards Program Operations

Configure and maintain the Enfamil Rewards program using the Snipp rewards management platform. Maintain the prize catalog and coordinate with third-party vendors to procure prizes. Support program budget management and ensure alignment with campaign goals and operational needs. Lead campaign planning, redemption logic, and user experience enhancements. Ensure rewards data flows accurately into the CDP for use in audience targeting and personalization. 

The experience we're looking for

Bachelor’s degree required in Marketing, Computer Science, or related field of study. 3–5 years of relevant experience in mobile app product management and/or loyalty/rewards program management. Strong knowledge of web and app development capabilities, processes, technologies, tech vendors, and third-party offerings. Experience working in loyalty marketing or customer rewards programs, particularly in digital or e-commerce environments. Hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms and CRM tools — Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) strongly preferred. Familiarity with CDPs and how customer data is leveraged for segmentation, targeting, and personalization. Experience maintaining a prioritized backlog and participating in sprint/release planning in an Agile environment. A data-driven mindset with genuine curiosity for AI-powered personalization, predictive analytics, and emerging martech. Ability to think quickly and creatively about problems and develop efficient solutions with an understanding of technical feasibility. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to balance multiple rapidly-moving projects. 

This role is not currently sponsoring visas or considering international movement at this time.

The skills for success

Consumer Insights, Analytical skills, Presentation skills, Drive Innovation, Creativity, Marketing optimization, Digital Marketing, Commercial accumen, FMCG/Consumer Health Experience, Negotiation.

What we offer

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.

US salary ranges

USD $113,000.00 - $169,000.00

US pay transparency

The base salary range for this role will vary based on experience in job and industry, training and education, skills relevant to the position, and other factors permitted by law. In addition to the base salary, the position is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, which is subject to change each year. Reckitt offers eligible employees competitive benefits including medical, prescription, dental, vision, and life and disability insurance; paid time off for vacation, sick and Company recognized holidays; a 401(k) plan; 16-week paid parental leave or 26 weeks for the birthing parent; adoption and fertility support; tuition reimbursement; discounts; and much more. Our compensation and benefits packages aim to give our talent the reward, protection, and peace of mind they deserve. If reasonable accommodation is needed to complete your application, please contact NAtalentacquisition@reckitt.com. Reckitt is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals.

Equality

We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

We are currently looking to hire a Human Resources Manager based in our manufacturing plant in Dubois, Pennsylvania!The Human Resources Manager is a key HR leader for the manufacturing site and an important member of the Plant Leadership team. This leader plays a critical role in enabling Danone’s manufacturing transformation by supporting the adoption of disciplined ways of working and fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.
This role serves as the primary HR leader for the DuBois, PA manufacturing site. The role leads a team of one HR Coordinator. This is a union facility comprised of approximately 125 team members and three production lines manufacturing plant-based products under the Silk and So Delicious brands.

Employee & Labor RelationsLead employee and labor relations matters, including investigations, grievances, and conflict resolution, ensuring fair, consistent, and compliant outcomesBuild and maintain strong, productive relationships with union representatives (where applicable) and plant stakeholders.Coach leaders to strengthen frontline leadership capability and reduce risk through effective people management. Change & Continuous ImprovementSupport the people and change management aspects of Danone’s manufacturing operating system and continuous improvement initiatives.Enable disciplined routines, standard work, and leadership behaviors that support sustainable adoption of new ways of working.Use people data and metrics to identify trends, measure progress, and drive targeted improvement actions. HR Operations & ComplianceEnsure compliance with labor and employment law, company policies, and HR processes.Maintain accurate HR data and support reporting/analytics.Partner with centers of excellence (COEs). 
Physical DemandsThis role requires the ability to perform essential job functions, with or without reasonable accommodation.While performing the duties of this job, the Plant HR Manager is regularly required toStand, walk, and move throughout the manufacturing facility, including production, warehouse, office, and outdoor areas, for extended periods of timeSit intermittently to perform administrative, planning, and reporting functionsUse hands and fingers to operate computers, phones, office equipment, and other standard business toolsReach with hands and arms and occasionally bend, stoop, or crouch while observing operations or engaging employees on the production floorMust be able to travel occasionally to manufacturing sites, corporate offices or offsite meetings as business needs require.The Plant HR Manager may occasionally be required to lift and/or move materials such as files, training materials, personal protective equipment, or office supplies. Lifting is generally limited and incidental to the role and does not involve continuous or production level of physical exertion. 
Work EnvironmentThis position is based primarily in a manufacturing plant environment and requires regular presence on the production floor. The employee may be exposed to moderate noise, moving mechanical parts, and temperature variationsAppropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) is required when accessing designated areas of the facility.Work schedules could include nights, weekends and/or holidays to provide the ability to support a 24/7 or a 24/5 manufacturing environment as business needs dictate.

For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted its energy, innovation, and scientific excellence solely to one business: Beauty. What You'll Be Doing

rows.descriptionText:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

« Pour visualiser la description de poste en français, veuillez sélectionner le français dans le menu déroulant au haut de la page. »

At EA, we believe games are powerful because they bring together multiple ways people engage: play, watch, create, and connect. And increasingly, the biggest entertainment platforms aren't just places to consume content - they're places where communities build.

Creator-made content is already a proven part of EA's history - from community creation tools in Battlefield to The Gallery in The Sims 4. We believe new creative technologies and tools will expand how players engage with and contribute to our experiences, supported by thoughtful product design, safety systems, and global reach. Our focus is on enabling more players to participate in creative expression by making creation easier, safer, and more rewarding.

As a Technical Artist, you will operate at the intersection of art, game technology, and machine learning data. You will develop workflows that extract, organize, normalize, and validate structured assets and world information from EA content pipelines for use in research.

You will bring an end-to-end understanding of how game assets are authored, assembled, transformed, and rendered. You will partner with artists, engineers, and researchers to preserve the relationships and semantics that make extracted content useful for neural motion, world models, neural rendering, and environment or level-layout research.

This is a hybrid role, working three days per week in Redwood City, Montreal, or Vancouver.

You will report to the Lead Technical Director.

Responsibilities

You will design and implement workflows to extract meshes, materials, textures, rigs, animation, levels, prefabs, and related metadata from game content pipelines.You will preserve scene hierarchy, transforms, dependencies, variants, coordinate systems, units, and other relationships required to reconstruct content correctly.You will extract and organize world information such as collision, navigation, cameras, lighting, environmental settings, and level composition.You will define representations and interchange formats that make game assets usable by machine learning and research workflows.You will build automated validation that confirms extracted assets and scenes maintain expected visual, structural, and technical fidelity.You will connect asset and world data to relevant source, build, scene, and capture metadata so researchers can understand provenance and context.You will identify third-party, licensed, sensitive, or otherwise restricted content and support appropriate filtering and handling.You will partner with infrastructure and data teams to organize extracted content within established storage and discovery systems.You will collaborate with researchers across neural motion, world models, neural rendering, and environment generation to turn repeated needs into reusable workflows.

Qualifications

7+ years of technical art, content-pipeline, tools, or related game-development experience, including experience on AAA titlesStrong understanding of end-to-end game art and content production pipelinesExperience with 3D asset formats, scene graphs, materials, textures, rigs, animation, level data, and coordinate-system transformationsExperience with major engines such as Frostbite, Unreal, Unity, or proprietary technologyProficiency with Python or another scripting language used for content-pipeline automationExperience developing or extending DCC, engine, or asset-processing toolsExperience validating visual and technical fidelity across asset conversions or pipeline stagesFamiliarity with machine learning data requirements, neural rendering, motion systems, world models, or procedural world-building is beneficial

rows.title: Senior Manager, Culture Marketing Seeding
rows.descriptionText:
Position Overview

At adidas, we never launch a product unless we consider it perfect.

Our brand teams bring together creativity, cultural insight, product expertise, and operational excellence to create meaningful connections with consumers. Through thoughtful product seeding, we put the right product in the hands of influential talent, partners, and cultural voices who help shape how adidas shows up in sport, fashion, and culture.

As Senior Manager, Culture Marketing Operations, you will lead the development and execution of Culture Marketing seeding strategy in partnership with the Director of Culture Marketing Seeding. You will own product planning, inventory governance, operational frameworks, and performance measurement to maximize product investments and enable scalable support of adidas' global talent, partner, and influencer networks.

Working across Global Brands, Communications, Business Units, Product Marketing, Market teams, agencies, and vendors, you will drive alignment from seasonal planning through execution. This role is strategically important to strengthening operational discipline, improving visibility into seeding performance, and ensuring resources are deployed against the brand's most important cultural opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

 Seeding Strategy: Lead the development and execution of Culture Marketing seeding strategy aligned with brand priorities, cultural relevance, and consumer impact. Allocation Governance: Establish seeding frameworks, allocation principles, and prioritization models that maximize product investment and support strategic talent and partner relationships. Product Planning: Own end-to-end forecasting, allocation, inventory management, and product lifecycle oversight across Culture Marketing seeding initiatives. Inventory Management: Drive accurate inventory tracking, reconciliation, reporting, and governance while continuously improving seeding processes and tools. Seasonal Planning: Partner with Global Brands, Communications, Business Units, Product Marketing, and Market teams to develop seasonal seeding and gifting plans aligned with product and campaign timelines. Cross-Functional Execution: Lead planning and delivery of key seeding initiatives, aligning stakeholders, resources, timelines, and business objectives. Agency and Vendor Management: Manage external agency and vendor partners against established scope, budget, service levels, and performance expectations. Analytics and Reporting: Develop performance measurement and reporting frameworks that provide visibility into inventory health, seeding impact, operational efficiency, and business opportunities. Financial Management: Manage seeding budgets, forecasting, and spend tracking while maintaining financial discipline, compliance, and responsible stewardship of company resources. Team Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop the Seeding team through clear objectives, accountability, collaboration, and capability building that supports evolving business needs.

Required Qualifications

 Strong knowledge of the sports industry with a demonstrated passion for fashion, streetwear, and relevant cultural trends. Strong strategic planning and prioritization skills with the ability to balance long-term objectives and immediate business needs. Strong understanding of inventory management, product allocation, and operational planning. Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and build alignment across a complex matrix organization. Data-driven approach to decision making with the ability to translate insights into clear business actions. Strong financial acumen, including experience with budgeting, forecasting, spend management, and vendor oversight. Strong attention to detail with a results-focused approach to execution. Ability to prioritize and oversee multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. Demonstrated leadership capabilities with the ability to establish accountability, foster collaboration, and develop team capabilities.

Preferred Experience

 Experience supporting product seeding, gifting, influencer, talent, or Culture Marketing programs within a global consumer brand environment. Experience partnering across Brand, Communications, Product Marketing, Business Units, and regional or Market organizations. Experience developing reporting, analytics, or performance measurement frameworks for product investment and operational programs.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This position follows the adidas Hybrid work policy, requiring in-office attendance Monday through Thursday with flexibility to work remotely on Friday. In-office attendance is required on Fridays when the work requires a high degree of collaboration or an in-person presentation. The working location for this position is Los Angeles, California. The role operates in a highly collaborative, cross-functional, and global environment. Travel expectations are based on business needs.

REPORTING STRUCTURE

This role works in close partnership with the Director of Culture Marketing Seeding and leads, coaches, and develops the Seeding team. The position has significant cross-functional exposure across Global Brands, Communications, Business Units, Product Marketing, Market teams, agencies, and vendor partners.

Compensation & Benefits

Salary Range: $131,560.00 - $145,029

Compensation for this role is subject to applicable adidas compensation practices and may vary based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location.

Requirements

Eligible regular full-time employees may have access to the following benefits, subject to applicable plan terms, eligibility requirements, policies, and formal plan documents:

 Comprehensive medical coverage including HSA with employer funding or FSA options, dental, vision, and prescription plans. Adoption, surrogate, and fertility support programs. Short and long term disability coverage. Basic life and AD and D insurance with supplemental employee paid options. 401(k) plan and Stock Purchase Plan with employer match or applicable adidas contributions. Education assistance for eligible full time employees. Paid parental and other eligible leave programs. Flexible Time Off accrued at 0.4388 hours per day for employees with less than five years of service, increasing with tenure. Twelve Company-Designated paid holidays, including a Floating Holiday, plus milestone Service Time Off for eligible employees. Employee product discounts and access to wellness and Employee Assistance programs.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

At adidas, we foster a workplace culture built on respect, collaboration, and opportunity where employees can grow, contribute, and perform at their best.

We value diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds because they strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and help us better serve athletes, consumers, and communities around the world.

adidas is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

adidas celebrates diversity, supports inclusiveness and encourages individual expression in our workplace. We do not tolerate the harassment or discrimination toward any of our applicants or employees. We are an equal opportunity employer.

rows.title: Director, Decision Sciences (Visual Analytics Team)
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

Company description

As a Director of our Intelligent Interfaces team, you will create innovative analytics systems that reveal, explore and explain complex patterns and phenomena from Epsilon’s peta-scale and massively dimensional digital marketing ecosystem. You will reduce this complexity into sophisticated, intuitive interfaces that demonstrate the business value of Epsilon’s platform directly to our stakeholders and global customers, which include some of the world’s largest brands. Our challenges span hundreds of millions of highly detailed individual profiles across hundreds of millions of websites and apps, tied together by powerful real-time analytics that make near-instantaneous decisions on messaging to those profiles trillions of times a day. This provides an incredibly rich environment of business questions and answers that are hidden within petabytes of data. This position reports to the VP of the Decision Sciences Visual Analytics (DSVA) team.

You will be leading an R&D team focused on using the latest in artificial intelligence, combined with visual analytics, to provide deep insights on complex data sets for user communities ranging from clients to analysts. Our focus is on understanding complex marketing activities, customer profiles, personas, marketing touch points, path to purchase, and more within the context of the Epsilon digital marketing platform. Thousands of attributes over time must all be condensed into meaningful, actionable insights. You will also work closely with our systems team that provides the backbone of large-scale compute to bring petabytes of data into our platform, where we can query and manipulate it interactively. Our tech stack is evolving to keep pace with the times; however, you can expect to be working with TypeScript, React, Node.js, Databricks, LLMs, LangChain, and more.

Candidates should have extensive experience leading a team in applied R&D settings. You need to have a good eye for detail in interface work, whether visualizations and charts or AI workflows. A key need for this position is to tame complexity and nurture simplicity, in order to make our insights accessible to clients. This is not a pure people manager role. Ideal candidates will be hands-on with technology—designing sketches, creating prototypes, and iterating on outputs. Manage recruitment, while developing recruiting strategies to source, attract and recruit to fill key positions. Collaborate with team members to create innovative sourcing and recruitment strategies. Own the strategy to lead recruiting discussions with field managers and HR. Develop an effective interview and sourcing strategy. Keep data integrity top of mind and ensure the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) is always updated. Lead and/or take part in special projects that support continuous business process improvement.

Minimum of 3 years’ experience in talent acquisition/recruitment, specifically aligned to high-volume recruiting. Ability to develop strong relationships with candidates, HR business partners, and field managers. Excellent project management skills (i.e., critical thinker, manages expectations, follows timeline, communicates progress effectively, etc.). Strong intellectual curiosity and a desire to understand business functions. Ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. 

Circana Behaviors

Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location: This position can be located in the following area(s): Remote, United States

An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is $45,000 to $52,000 USD.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

You can apply for this role through the Circana careers website or Intranet site for internal candidates. This role is subject to AI-assisted screening. rows.title: Lead, Client Success
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

Company Description

How You’ll Make An Impact

As a Lead, Client Success, you will act as a pivotal individual contributor, owning client & agency relationships and driving the strategic adoption of Epsilon’s person-first digital media solutions. You will collaborate closely with Epsilon Sales, Publicis agency partners, and internal cross-functional teams to transform client business objectives into high-performing media realities.

Role

This is an ideal role for a media professional who wants to be at the center of the action bridging the gap between high-level strategy, pitching new products and ideas that meet client objectives as well as hands-on execution. You’ll have the opportunity to:

Partner with Client Leadership/Sales Team to identify and advance optimization, upsell, and digital media growth opportunities. Synthesize performance insights and support QBRs and strategic readouts. Connect campaign results to broader business goals and future investment planning. Develop innovative, data-driven media proposals and campaigns that leverage Epsilon’s industry-leading identity products.Directly influence Epsilon’s growth by ensuring delivery excellence and operational health.

Who You Are

You are a client-focused professional with a passion for marketing, client success, and digital media. You excel at getting things done, staying organized, and building strong working client and internal relationships. You are comfortable working with data to monitor performance and communicate insights, and you have a strong attention to detail that helps ensure high-quality execution.

You’re eager to learn how strategy and execution come together to drive results. You’re proactive about identifying issues early, escalating appropriately, and partnering across teams to support client outcomes and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

 What You’ll Bring With YouBachelor’s Degree from a four-year college or university.8+ years of experience in digital marketing, media, analytics, or client success.Experience in developing, nurturing and managing client relationships.Proven track record of driving and maintaining revenue growth with clientsExceptional organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.Comfort working with performance data to monitor campaign health and identify trends.Ability to build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholdersExcellent communication and interpersonal skills.Highly organized with a strong attention to detail.Why You Might Stand Out From Other Talent:Direct experience within the digital media landscape, specifically with platform-based execution.A self-starter who recognizes potential challenges early and approaches them with a proactive outlook.A history of building strong client and internal partnerships to drive collective delivery excellence.
Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision, 1 Voice.

Additional Information

When you join Epsilon, we’ll create something EPIC together. We’re a global leader in data and identity, with deep expertise in digital media, clean rooms, customer data platforms, loyalty and marketing services. Positioned at the center of Publicis Groupe, Epsilon helps brands deliver personalized experiences at scale and build lasting customer relationships by unlocking the full potential of data and identity. Epsilon operates in 30+ countries across EMEA, the Americas and APAC, with more than 8,000 employees.

Check out a few of these resources to learn more about what makes Epsilon so EPIC:

Our Culture: https://www.epsilon.com/us/about-us/our-culture-epsilon

Life at Epsilon: https://www.epsilon.com/us/about-us/epic-blog

Epsilon Has Five Values That Define Our Culture And Guide Us As We Create Value For Our Clients, Our People And Consumers. We Seek Candidates Who Align With Our Company Values, Demonstrate Them And Make Them Meaningful In Their Day-to-day Work

Act with integrity. We are transparent and have the courage to do the right thing.Work together to win together. We believe collaboration is the catalyst that unlocks our full potential.Innovate with purpose. We shape the market with big ideas that drive big outcomes.Respect all voices. We embrace differences and foster a culture of connection and belonging.Empower with accountability. We trust each other to own and deliver on common goals.

Because You Matter

Benefits

As an Epsilon employee, you deserve perks and benefits that put you, your family and your finances first. Our benefits encompass a wide range of offerings, including but not limited to:

Time to recharge: Flexible time off (FTO), 14 paid holidays, paid sick timeFamily well-being: Parental/new child leave, childcare & elder care assistance, adoption assistanceExtra perks: Comprehensive health coverage, 401(k), tuition assistance, commuter benefits, professional development, employee recognition, charitable donation matching, health coaching and counseling

Epsilon benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms.

Epsilon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Epsilon’s policy is not to discriminate against any applicant or employee based on actual or perceived race, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy), marital status, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, mental or physical disability, religion, creed, color, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression (including transgender status), veteran status, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law. Epsilon also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories. Epsilon will provide accommodations to applicants who need accommodations to complete the application process. Please reach out to LeaveofAbsence@epsilon.com to request an accommodation.

For San Francisco Bay and Los Angeles Areas: Epsilon will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment in a manner consistent with the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance and San Francisco Police Code Sections 4901-4919, commonly referred to as the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. Applicants with criminal histories are welcome to apply.

Compensation Range: USD $80,000.00 - USD $120,000.00/Annually. This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on the skills, qualifications, and experience of the applicant along with the requirements of the position, and the Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. Temporary roles may be eligible to participate in our freelancer/temporary employee medical plan through a third-party benefits administration system once certain criteria have been met. For regular roles, the Company will offer medical coverage, dental, vision, disability, 401k, and paid time off. The Company anticipates the application deadline for this job posting will be 11/9/2026.

rows.title: Executive Producer, Social
rows.descriptionText:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism, and holds power to account. Our team of award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial professionals, and industry-leading digital experts are committed to making a difference and represent a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We offer a challenging and exciting environment for career development, with a focus on training, growth and fostering an inclusive culture.
We are looking for an executive producer, social, to lead a dedicated team of social producers and commission and executive produce our news, features and opinion social media content off-platform.
This role will oversee the production of short-form video while also producing, editing and repurposing video, photography, text and graphics to bring our journalism to new audiences in creative and compelling ways. No subject is off-limits. We cover everything – including global politics, the climate crisis, culture, and pure human-interest stories.
This is a permanent, full-time position working a nine-day fortnight, which will include weekend work, early and late shifts.
About the roleOversee daily story selection and editing for off-platform journalism, focusing on Instagram and TikTokDirect and sign off concepts and design and work with producers and hosts on areas such as scripting, style and picture selectionEnsure posts and videos meet the highest editorial and technical standards and legal compliance, making confident editorial decisions on verification, and copyrightWork with the head of short-form and head of video to commission and project manage social-first longer term projects and investigationsTrain new staff and manage the rota with administratorsWork with our head of production to spend budgets efficiently and remain within agreed budgetWork closely with other teams to share resources and execute collaborative projects, including communicating closely with the reactive video teamWork with senior team members, channel managers, colleagues in marketing and other departments to set strategic course for audience expansionEnsure communication is smooth and collaborative with our colleagues on other desks and social media teams in Australia and the USPut in place systems to improve workflowThis role is office-based and will not include on-the-ground shooting
About youExtensive experience in visual and social news storytellingExperience working in a newsroomExperience working with all major social media platforms, underpinned by a nuanced understanding of each platform's unique ecosystem, and how to make and optimise content performance for each platformExperience managing a team, supporting and developing junior colleaguesUnderstanding of how to make text, photos, graphics and video work together visually on social mediaUnderstanding of the specific needs of social media audiencesStrong writing skills with a flair for summarising long, complex information into engaging and concise copyFamiliarity with content management systems and analytics of all major social media platformsSubstantial experience editing video and producing and editing videos for social media from start to finish using Adobe PremiereDesign skills with ability to produce static content with Adobe Creative Suite and FigmaKnowledge of Adobe After Effects, and ability to shoot video is a strong advantageJournalistic training including knowledge of media law and OSINTStrong news senseStrong planning and organisational skills, plus experience juggling multiple deadlinesDigitally savvy with an aptitude for picking up new technical skills and analysing dataAn understanding of the evolving ways people consume news video on and off platformAn awareness of the needs and interests of GNM's audiencesIdeally, you'll have a demonstrable ability to bring a diverse perspective to this role
We actively encourage applications from groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media.
We operate in a hybrid environment working at least three days a week from our offices in King's Cross in London.
Job share applications are welcome. If you are keen to apply jointly with someone else as a job share, you should make a single application and combine your application documents.
The salary range for this NUJ position starts at £60,748, with the final offer determined by the successful candidate's skills, experience, and responsibilities.
How to applyTo apply, please upload your latest CV and a cover letter which outlines why you'd love to take on this role, and why you're a great match for what we're looking for.
We appreciate the time taken to prepare each application we receive. We do not use AI-assisted technology to review applications; every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team. Thank you for bearing with us during the screening process.
The closing date for applications is Thursday October 15 2026.
All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to help your application, this includes providing documents in accessible formats or personalising the process to better support your needs.
Benefits at the GuardianYou'll have six weeks of annual leave per year (plus bank holidays) with the option to purchase an additional 5 days. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). We believe in giving back, which is why employees are given 2 volunteering days annually and the option of payroll giving. Season ticket loans are also available.
You are entitled to private healthcare, life cover, income protection, and eye tests. You can also opt in to dental insurance.
We have enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave policies in place. We also support our employees by offering an IVF, menopause, baby loss, and trans equality policy.
Culture and wellbeingWe want everyone to feel like they belong at the Guardian and we champion diversity of thought. Our various employee forums provide a platform to use their voice to foster an inclusive workplace. We became the first major media organisation to achieve B Corp status.
We offer tools to help you prioritise your wellbeing including access to our employee benefits platform which provides tailored support for health and wellbeing. In addition, we also offer free yoga and pilates classes. These run alongside our corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.
Our canteen has views overlooking the Regents Canal and caters for breakfast, lunch and dinner.
Learning and developmentWe encourage personal and professional growth. Employees have access to a broad range of tools and solutions, and we are happy to support the pursuit of professional qualifications through vocational courses and apprenticeships.
We value honesty in your application.AI generated content must not be presented as your own work. Please review our guidance on the use of AI in your application here.

Ability to accurately estimate software tasks and work to schedule. Exposure to observability tools and practices (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana) are preferred. Understanding of databases and data architecture choices (SQL vs NoSQL, caching layers, and data access patterns)Track record of tuning performance and reliability for highly available services and web applicationsFamiliarity with web security fundamentals and secure engineering practicesBachelors of Masters Degree in Compute Science/Software Engineering or related subject  What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. rows.title: Senior Curation Editor
rows.descriptionText:
JOB DETAILS

BBC Studios — Commercial News

Location: Washington, DC Office (Hybrid - 3 days)

Schedule: Mon–Fri, 11am–7pm ET

WE ARE BBC STUDIOS

A globally renowned media company borne of the BBC. We make and distribute the world’s most sought-after TV, audio, and digital content. At Digital News & Streaming, our ambition is to entertain, educate, and inspire through world-class journalism in all forms. Our reporting takes you across the world and then provides the tools to live a more informed and fulfilled life.

BBC Studios is seeking a Senior Curation Editor for bbc.com, based in Washington, DC, reporting to the Lead Curation Editor. We continue to consolidate and enhance our BBC website and apps for global audiences, including in North America, and you will be a key part of the team curating this experience — managing the homepage and other key indexes during the US afternoon and evening window.

The right candidate will demonstrate strong editorial judgment, a sharp eye for engaging headlines and visuals, and a keen sense of US and global audience needs in the digital space. During your shifts, you will work hands-on in the CMS to ensure we always have a rich, timely content mix across the site and app. You will also contribute to daily editorial planning and curation strategy for major news events and special initiatives.

You will have experience with digital publishing best practices and optimization tactics, and a desire to deepen your understanding of analytics and develop your ability to draw actionable, real-time insights to improve engagement.

Success in this role requires close collaboration with colleagues across time zones — from Singapore and London through to the US East and West coasts. Strong communication, handover discipline, and organizational skills are essential, as is the ability to work autonomously during your shift while staying aligned with the team's editorial priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Curate and optimize content for bbc.com and the app, maintaining editorial integrity and responsiveness to breaking newsCraft compelling headlines and select impactful visuals, prioritizing mobile-friendly presentationPlan and execute real-time updates, push alerts, and long-term curation strategiesLeverage audience data and industry trends to enhance engagement and user experienceCollaborate with teams across BBC News, Sport, Features, BritBox, Audience Development, and Product to align prioritiesCommunicate effectively across time zones, managing handovers and stakeholder relationships with colleagues in Singapore, London, and New York to ensure seamless 24/7 coverageDocument clear handovers and flag technical issues promptlyParticipate in a rotating schedule for public holiday coverage, with occasional weekend work. 

Knowledge, Skills, Training And Experience

5+ years in digital journalism, with experience in homepage management, news curation, or digital publishingStrong editorial judgment and ability to prioritize under pressureDeep understanding of audience behavior, engagement strategies, and analyticsEffective communication and collaboration skills in a fast-paced, distributed environmentCommitment to impartiality and BBC's editorial values

COMPETENCIES 

Strong communicator — able to convey editorial decisions clearly to colleagues across departments and time zones, including non-specialists, and to communicate effectively with people working remotely across multiple BBC sitesAutonomous and problem-solving oriented — able to exercise sound editorial judgment and make confident calls independently during your shift, escalating when appropriateDetail-focused while maintaining a view of the bigger picture — brings precision to headline writing and content selection without losing sight of the overall editorial mix and audience goalsKeen to challenge the status quo and take initiative — proactively identifies opportunities to improve curation workflows, surface content more effectively, and drive positive changes across the teamFlexible and adaptable — able to sustain high performance under pressure and pivot quickly as breaking news, changing priorities, or evolving audience needs demand

Benefits And Perks

100% Employer-Paid Medical and Dental Insurance (PPO plans)Generous Paid Time OffFlexible, Hybrid Working ArrangementsStrong commitment to work/life balanceFree Retirement Consulting for all employeesPet InsuranceCommuter BenefitsGym Reimbursement

Compensation

The anticipated annual base salary for this position is $90,000 to $100,000. The actual base salary offered depends on the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and geographic location of the position.

About the role Roku is looking for an Assistant General Counsel, Litigation to join our Legal team. This role owns Roku’s litigation portfolio outside of intellectual property matters — including consumer class actions, commercial disputes, and government investigations, with a particular focus on privacy-related litigation and related regulatory enforcement actions — across a business that spans hardware, streaming, and one of the fastest-growing advertising platforms in media. You will manage disputes and government inquiries end-to-end, from first notice through resolution — building the strategy, directing outside counsel, and making the call on when to fight, settle, or escalate. This role reports to the VP, Deputy General Counsel, Strategic Litigation and IP. We think of running a case as a creative act, not just a process. The matters that land here rarely come with a clean playbook — the facts are incomplete, the law is unsettled, or the right answer just isn’t obvious yet. We’re looking for someone who is energized by that kind of ambiguity: who can construct a novel argument or a case theory nobody else saw, stay clear-headed when a matter is genuinely indeterminate, and write their way to a conclusion — briefs, internal memos, demand letters, whatever the moment calls for — with the kind of clarity and force that changes how people see the case. The estimated annual base salary for this position is between $260,000 and $280,000 with additional equity. Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographic location. This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off.What you’ll be doing Litigation portfolio management Own Roku’s corporate litigation portfolio outside of intellectual property — including consumer class actions, commercial and contract disputes, and privacy-related claims under laws such as the VPPA, CIPA and other wiretap-style statutes, BIPA, and CCPA — from intake and early case assessment through resolution Define case strategy and make recommendations on when to litigate, settle, or escalate, in partnership with the Deputy General Counsel, General Counsel, Legal teammates, and business stakeholders Government investigations and regulatory matters Manage government investigations and inquiries — from the FTC, state attorneys general, data protection authorities, and other regulators — spanning privacy, consumer protection, advertising, and related areas incomplete facts, unsettled law, and genuine uncertainty — and make sound, well-reasoned judgment calls anyway Write the arguments, memos, and correspondence that move a matter forward — clear, persuasive, and built to withstand scrutiny from a judge, a regulator, or Management Litigation operations and outside counsel Help build and scale repeatable litigation processes — intake, early case assessment, playbooks, and post-mortems — across the litigation portfolio, consistent with Roku’s broader litigation operating model Manage outside counsel relationships and budgets across consumer About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Role

The Product team shapes the experiences that power Revolut. They turn complex problems into simple, scalable solutions — collaborating across Design, Engineering, and Data to build features our customers love.

We're looking for a Product Strategy Intern to be part of the CEO Office. You'll identify market gaps, opportunities, and actionable product initiatives that drive mass adoption in core and expansion markets.

This is a 6-month internship with a possibility to join full-time at the end of the programme.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What You’ll Be Doing

Supporting senior executives and the CEO in developing a point of view on specific fintech verticals, and defining a cohesive long-term strategy for the company and product departments Acting as the eyes and ears of the company, feeding information from the market back into company strategy and department roadmapsTracking and analysing competitive position and product performance globallyHelping scope and launch new verticalsDefining initial product proposition and go-to-market strategies for new expansion markets

What You'll Need

A STEM or other highly quantitative degree from a top-tier universityA track record of outstanding achievement in different areasA business, product, or strategy internship in a top-tier consultancy, investment bank/PE/VC, or fast-growing tech companyExcellent problem-solving skillsEmpathy for customers and a customer-centric approach to design

Nice to have

A track record of building successful products or features using data, customer feedback, common sense, and/or machine learning

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

 Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment. Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

WORKING PATTERN: Our work style is hybrid, which involves spending at least two days per week, or 40% of our time in the office. Colleagues with disabilities can be supported with workplace adjustments including hybrid working expectations in line with our Flexibility Works policy.

What you’ll be doing:

Here at Lloyds Banking Group, we put our customers at the heart of everything we do, and every colleague has an important part to play.

The Cards Originations Credit Risk team sits within the Chief Credit Office and is accountable for making automated credit decisions for annual lending of c.£8bn through our market leading Credit Cards products across brands.

We produce insight through analytics to make sure we lend responsibly and continually improve our credit strategies to optimise our decisions to benefit our customers and the Bank.

The team is responsible for defining all aspects of credit risk strategy, preparing loss forecasts, proactively managing risk and reward through strategy optimisation while ensuring the portfolio remains resilient and within risk appetite.

We're looking for a highly motivated individual who is curious, numerate and ready to learn and respond in a fast-paced environment within the team.

In this role you’ll:

Use tools such as SAS and Excel to manipulate and interrogate data whilst ensuring you work within a robust control environmentCarry out data analytics to support customer needsProduce regular high quality and trusted reporting and analyticsCollaborate with other teams within credit risk and infrastructure to deliver improvements to credit strategiesAdopt a continuous improvement attitude, looking for opportunities to automate and transform processes

Why join us?

We’re on an exciting journey to transform our Group and the way we’re shaping finance for good. We’re focusing on the future, investing in our technologies, workplaces, and colleagues to make our Group a great place for everyone.

What we’re looking for?

Comfortable working with numbers and have either a good degree in a numerate subject or equivalent quantitative experience gained in previous rolesExperience in use of or willing to learn programming languages e.g. SAS, SQL, BigQueryCurious and Analytical problem solvers, able to work creatively with data to draw out insight and answer business questions.Proactive in progressing their own personal development and collaborating with others to improve the culture of the wider teamPrior experience of credit risk in a retail banking environment is a strong plus

We know that great talent comes from many backgrounds. We recognise that skills are developed in many ways, so if you have relevant, transferable experience, we encourage you to apply.

This is a place for you:

Our ambition is to be the leading UK business for diversity, equity and inclusion supporting our customers, colleagues and communities and we’re committed to creating an environment in which everyone can thrive, learn and develop.

We also offer a wide-ranging benefits package, which includes:

A generous pension contribution of up to 15%An annual performance-related bonusShare schemes including free sharesBenefits you can adapt to your lifestyle, such as discounted shopping24 days holiday, with bank holidays on topA range of wellbeing initiatives and generous parental leave policies

Ready for a career where you’ll learn and thrive?

Apply today and find out more.

Please note our roles can generate a considerable amount of interest and close early so don't miss out on this opportunity to apply today.

At Lloyds Banking Group, we're driven by a clear purpose; to help Britain prosper. Across the Group, our colleagues are focused on making a difference to customers, businesses and communities. With us you'll have a key role to play in shaping the financial services of the future, whilst the scale and reach of our Group means you'll have many opportunities to learn, grow and develop.

We keep your data safe. So, we'll only ever ask you to provide confidential or sensitive information once you have formally been invited along to an interview or accepted a verbal offer to join us which is when we run our background checks. We'll always explain what we need and why, with any request coming from a trusted Lloyds Banking Group person. 

We're focused on creating a values-led culture and are committed to building a workforce which reflects the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Together we’re building a truly inclusive workplace where all of our colleagues have the opportunity to make a real difference.

rows.descriptionText:
About Revolut
People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.
As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
About the role
Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They’re among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.
We’re looking for a Business Risk Manager to sit within the first line of defense. You'll take an analytical approach to develop sustainable growth strategies that align with operational risk frameworks and take our risk management procedures to the next level.
Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.
What you'll be doing
Identifying, assessing, documenting, and reviewing risksDesigning, implementing, and testing controlsDeveloping and testing key proceduresCreating and reviewing key risk indicatorsRegistering risk events, managing, and delivering risk incident reports
What you'll need
A degree from a top university 2+ years of experience in operational risk management within financial servicesExperience with risk identification and monitoringPrevious examples of practically interpreting and organising complex dataA solid track record of achievement, having won competition awards (can be any of academic, professional, and/or sport)The ability to quickly assume responsibilitiesAn organized and methodological approachExcellent interpersonal skillsAn understanding of control frameworks (e.g., COSO, ISO 31000) and risk taxonomy, including operational, financial, and compliance risksFamiliarity with process mapping, RCSA execution, control testing, and issue remediation
Nice to have
Knowledge of US regulatory frameworksExperience with data analytics or visualization tools to support risk monitoring and reportingFamiliarity with automation and process optimization tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Figma) and their use in improving control effectivenessA proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, fast-paced environments, collaborating with multiple stakeholders across business and technical teams
Compensation range
US: $108,000 - $127,000 gross annually*Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process*Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience
Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

In this role, you will act as an AVP within the Reward Policy & Governance team, supporting the delivery of key reward governance activities across Barclays. You will support the development and execution of reward governance frameworks, contribute to pay disclosure and pay transparency requirements, and assist with regulatory remuneration activities and Remuneration Committee reporting. Working within a specialist team of reward professionals, you will partner closely with Directors responsible for Executive Reward, Pay Disclosures & Pay Transparency, Regulatory Conformance, and Reward Analytics to help deliver high-quality governance, reporting, and analytical outcomes across the reward agenda.

You will collaborate with stakeholders across HR, Finance, Risk, Compliance, and Legal to support both business-as-usual requirements and strategic reward initiatives. Your responsibilities will span pay disclosures, pay transparency, reward governance, regulatory reporting, and reward analytics, providing broad exposure across multiple areas of reward. You will work with large and complex reward datasets to produce accurate reporting, meaningful insights, and robust governance outputs while supporting key regulatory requirements and conformance activities. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to high-profile reward initiatives, including remuneration committee reporting, regulatory compliance activities, and evolving pay transparency programmes, making it an excellent opportunity to broaden your expertise across the reward function.

To be successful as an Assistant Vice President Reward Policy & Governance, you will have experience with:


Reward, Compensation, Benefits, or related remuneration disciplines, with understanding of reward principles and practices.Analytical and problem-solving, including the ability to interpret complex data, identify trends, and provide clear recommendations to stakeholders.Working with multiple stakeholders and the ability to build effective relationships across HR, Reward, Finance, Risk, and business teams.Organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, deliver to deadlines, and maintain high levels of accuracy and attention to detail.


Other Desired Skills Include


Experience supporting regulatory remuneration requirements, pay transparency initiatives, remuneration governance, or statutory pay disclosures.Experience within financial services or another regulated environment.Knowledge of reward reporting, remuneration frameworks, and governance processes.


You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills

To develop and implement executive compensation programmes and provide advice related to financial/ tax/ regulatory treatment of such programmes, in alignment with regulatory standards.

Responsible for the development, implementation and delivery of executive compensation policies/programmes, aligned with the organisation’s strategy and applicable regulations, market trends, and shareholder and proxy agency guidance. Supporting executive compensation engagement with stakeholders including shareholders and other investors, regulators and the media.Providing support to the senior population (principally Group ExCo) on reward and performance matters including performance management and objective setting, management and communication of compensation outcomes, responding to individual reward queries, tax information, financial advisor and broker liaison.Providing advice and guidance on reward programmes including base salary, bonus, long-term incentives, equity compensation, setting of vesting periods and details of malus and clawback terms as appropriate. Engagement on, communication of and operational delivery of deferred compensation plans and all employee share plans for the firm globally. Ensuring regulatory conformance and managing associated reward processes.Managing external disclosures related to reward including Annual Report reward disclosures, fair pay reporting, Pillar 3 remuneration disclosures, pay gaps disclosures and other applicable disclosures. Supporting on planning and preparation for any new disclosure obligations for the firm.Delivery of the annual reward cycle in collaboration with the Compensation Team, Finance, Risk, Compliance and other key teams, including working with finance to manage activity linked to reward accruals, budgets and reporting; governance around material risk takers and other similar populations; annual and ad hoc regulatory reporting on reward.Supporting Group and subsidiary remuneration committees, including on incentive funding, market insights, regulatory obligations and other reward-related matters.


Assistant Vice President Expectations


To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomesIf the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.Communicate complex information.  Opening up a world of opportunity.
