Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in a relevant technical field such as computer science or equivalent years of practical work experience5+ years of post-Bachelor’s machine learning experience; or Master’s degree in a technical field + 4+ year of post-grad machine learning experience; or PhD in a relevant technical field + 1 years of post-grad machine learning experienceExperience developing machine learning models for ranking, recommendations, search, content understanding, image generation, or other relevant applications of machine learning

Preferred Qualifications:

Advanced degree in computer science or related fieldExperience working with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, Caffe2, PyTorch, Spark ML, scikit-learn, or related frameworksExperience working with machine learning, ranking infrastructures, and system design

rows.title: Pre/Post Silicon Validation Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Meta's Infrastructure Silicon organization is building custom ASICs to power the compute demands of AI, data center, and next-generation platform workloads. We are looking for an experienced Silicon Validation Engineer to join our team, working across the full silicon lifecycle from early pre-silicon design input and FPGA emulation to post-silicon bring-up, characterization, and deployment in the production fleet. You will play a central role in validating custom silicon, driving emulation bring-up, and leading debug efforts across hardware, firmware, and software layers to ensure successful product delivery. Your work will directly influence the reliability and performance of Meta's custom infrastructure chips at scale.

Pre/Post Silicon Validation Engineer Responsibilities:

Work across all aspects of the silicon lifecycle to deliver reliable, performant silicon - from early architecture and design input, through pre-silicon test readiness and validation, to post-silicon bring-up, characterization, and fleet deploymentDefine and execute silicon validation strategies, including test plans, coverage models, regression frameworks, and productization readiness criteriaDevelop and maintain emulation infrastructure for custom silicon, including FPGA-based emulation platform bring-up and configurationPartition and map RTL designs onto emulation platforms, optimizing for timing closure, resource utilization, and debug visibilityBuild and maintain software, scripting, and automation infrastructure for validation and emulation workflows, including silicon diagnostics, performance analysis, debug tooling, job scheduling, and results analysis across bare-metal and full-stack systemsDebug complex hardware, firmware, and software interactions across RTL, firmware, and software layersroot-cause, resolve, and remediate silicon issues across the product lifecyclePartner with RTL design and verification engineers to identify and resolve functional bugs prior to tape-outEnsure continuity between pre- and post-silicon environments so that emulation accurately models silicon behavior and validation content transitions cleanly into lab and data center bring-upUnderstand production system use cases to improve silicon validation, and feed insights from the production fleet back into next-generation architecture and designEvaluate and integrate new validation and emulation tools, methodologies, and platform capabilities to improve throughput and debug efficiencyLead end-to-end validation efforts, driving strategy, planning, execution, and post-silicon enablement and provide technical guidance to peers on validation methodology, debug techniques, and infrastructure best practices

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience6+ years of experience in ASIC/SoC development cycles with pre-silicon and/or post-silicon validation, hardware verification, or FPGA-based emulation for custom siliconExperience troubleshooting, debug, and analytics for silicon products, including debugging hardware-software interactions using waveform viewers, logic analyzers, and hardware debug probesExperience with ASIC design or development, emulation, and post-silicon validationExperience developing automation scripts and test infrastructure in Python, C/C++,Experience collaborating with internal and external partners across RTL design, verification, firmware, software, and systems teams in a custom silicon environment

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with RTL partitioning, FPGA synthesis, and timing closure on large-scale emulation platforms such as Palladium, Veloce, or ZebuExperience working with emulation/FPGA platforms for test content development, debug, and post-silicon enablementExperience with post-silicon bring-up and transitioning validation content from emulation to silicon environmentsFamiliarity with SystemVerilog, UVM, or formal verification methodologies as complements to emulation-based validationExperience with hardware description and simulation tools such as VCS, Xcelium, or QuestaExperience with infrastructure or data center silicon domains such as networking ASICs, AI accelerators, or storage controllersExperience with some of the following modules/domains: PCIe, Networking, Ethernet, Flash, Memory, CPU, GPU, DRAM (LP/DDR4/5 and/or HBM)Understanding of embedded systems, including common bus protocols such as I2C, SPI, USB, and/or PCIeExperience with Linux systems and server systems managementExperience in application and host driver development, including RDMA Gen Driver, DPDK, or Meta RoCE/RoCEv2, for NIC product validation

About Meta:

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.

Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@meta.com.

The mission of the Sales Strategy & Operations group is to maximize ads business growth and performance by being the objective, trusted partner to the Sales Leadership – through strategic planning, cross-functional collaboration and operational excellence. Your role will be aligned to the North America Large Customer Sales (LCS) team, which focuses on driving advertiser revenue growth via depth of brand / business unit spend across the largest and most prominent Fortune 500 advertisers.

Problem solving and analysis to solve business problems, including AI, spreadsheet analytical skills. Ability to evolve in a highly-dynamic environment - prioritizing initiatives, defining milestones or KPIs and driving results with ownership and adaptability. rows.title: TikTok Shop - Special Projects Manager, Collectibles

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities
Team Overview
You've seen the virality and impact of #TikTokMadeMeBuyIt. Join the team that is redefining how people discover, engage with, and shop through content and creators. At TikTok Shop, we're building the future of commerce by bringing together entertainment, community, and shopping into one seamless experience.

Our US Operations team partners closely with merchants, creators, brands, and cross-functional teams to build high-growth business categories and create long-term value for both sellers and consumers. We are an entrepreneurial, fast-paced organization where innovation, ownership, and execution are highly valued.

Responsibilities
- Develop category and business strategies by diagnosing key growth opportunities, structural challenges, and operational bottlenecks across TikTok Shop’s Collectibles business.
- Partner closely with cross-functional (XFN) teams to define goals, pilot initiatives, and identify key areas for continuous improvement.
- Conduct data-driven analysis, competitor benchmarking, and hypothesis testing to solve business challenges and identify new growth opportunities.
- Work with product & tech teams to design scalable, tech-driven solutions that lower entry barriers for merchants and enhance overall platform competitiveness.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualification(s):
- Strong quantitative and analytical skills
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous business problems, develop hypotheses, and translate data into actionable strategic recommendations.
- Experience in e-Commerce strategy & operations, category management, management consulting, or business strategy, with a proven track record of driving strategic initiatives.
- Hands-on experience in project management and cross-functional collaboration, with the ability to execute solutions that drive measurable business impact.
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment with a structured and problem-solving mindset.

Preferred Qualification(s):
- A background in mathematics, statistics, business analytics, or related fields
- Experience in high-growth, fast-paced environments, particularly within marketplace, e-commerce, consumer technology, or consumer goods sectors.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request


Job Information
【For Pay Transparency】Compensation Description (Annually)
The base salary range for this position in the selected city is $121600 - $272000 annually.
Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.
Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Employees have day one access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) savings plan with company match, paid parental leave, short-term and long-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year, 10 paid sick days per year and 17 days of Paid Personal Time (prorated upon hire with increasing accruals by tenure).
The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.
For Los Angeles County (unincorporated) Candidates:
Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Our company believes that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment:
1. Interacting and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external clients and/or colleagues;
2. Appropriately handling and managing confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information and access to information technology systems; and
3. Exercising sound judgment.

rows.title: Strategy & Analytics Associate Graduate (TikTok Shop) - 2027 Start (MBA)
rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities

About the team:

The E-commerce Strategy team for TikTok Shop plays a critical role in setting direction and accelerating growth of the US market. The team operates at the center of global strategy planning, research and analysis, partnering closely with regional and industry leaders to identify market opportunity, determine operation directions and set key team targets. We are looking for a highly analytical and strategic thinker to partner with a fast-growing global e-commerce business. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, data, and operations, and will play a key role in driving business growth through insights and execution.

We are looking for talented individuals to join our team. As a graduate, you will get opportunities to pursue bold ideas, tackle complex challenges, and unlock limitless growth.

Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date by the end of the year. Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume.

Candidates can apply to a maximum of two positions and will be considered for jobs in the order you apply. The application limit is applicable to our Company and its affiliates' jobs globally. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.

Responsibilities:

Business Planning & Performance Tracking:

 Participate in planning short-, medium-, and long-term scale and revenue targets for international e-commerce operations. Assist in building the business metric system, formulating target breakdown and tracking mechanisms, identifying key issues during operations, and proposing improvement suggestions to support business reviews and operational decision-making.

Market Research & Strategy Optimization:

 Combine market environment, industry trends, and business development characteristics to conduct market segmentation research and ad-hoc analysis. Identify key tracks and growth opportunities to support business strategy optimization and resource allocation.

Business Diagnosis & Problem Solving:

 Develop a deep understanding of business logic and operational pipelines, proactively identify business pain points, and conduct ad-hoc analyses focusing on merchant growth, traffic conversion, and user behavior. rows.title: Senior AI Backend Software Engineer, TikTok - Asset Services
rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities
The Creation team is an international R&D group tasked with building creative capabilities for TikTok. We're dedicated to productizing AI and multimedia technologies to create world-class creation experiences for TikTok users. Our tech stack includes front-end, back-end, mobile, and desktop development, as well as multimedia technologies like audio/video processing and AR effects, in addtion to visual and graphic algorithms. Our team spans major cities in China (Beijing, Shanghai, Hangzhou, Shenzhen, and Guangzhou), Singapore, as well as the United States (San Jose, Seattle, and Los Angeles). Join us to craft the best creative tools with the most cutting-edge AI and multimedia technologies!

The Asset Service which has managed almost 100 million assets for multiple scenarios (such as TikTok effect and template). We manage the whole lifecycle of multiple assets, including creation, operations to consumption. Our distribution service QPS has reached 1 million, and we have provided the service for multi-regions in the global world, and distribute the material to the UGC creator. We will keep more efficient, stable and compliant to provide rich materials for the UGC creator to help them create more interesting content. Besides, we're also working on AIGC features in order to improve user experience and creator efficiency. The team is based in the US and CN, and our mission is to develop Loki into an efficient and reliable asset platform that, like the Norse god Loki, transforms assets into dynamic formats, to ensure magically easy asset creation, management, and consumption across multiple products.

As a Backend Engineer in our team, you'll play a key role in shaping this dynamic and ever-evolving platform, significantly contributing to TikTok's continued global impact.

Responsibilities
- Work closely with cross functional teams like product managers, designers, and Frontend engineers to deliver state of the art user experience in the above products mentioned;
- Build world-class products end-to-end, which combine usability, accessibility, elegance, performance, and maintainability;
- Guarantee the creation experience of 100 million-level UGC users and 10 million-level designers;
- Construct an AI Native service ecosystem and development workflow;
- Build an Agent system serving intelligent creation.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
- Experienced in building backend services for large-scale consumer-facing applications;
- Deep understanding of computer architectures, data structures, and algorithms;
- Have good team communication and collaboration skills;
- Understand modern distributed system architecture;
- In-depth AI application experience and understanding of AI Coding paradigms.

Preferred Qualifications
- BA/BS Degree in Computer Science or related major.
- Industry experience in a software development environment.
- Experience in building AI Agents and understanding the construction principles of knowledge bases/Skill systems/memory.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

rows.title: Senior CRM & Personalisation Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Job description:

 Role overview:   Senior CRM & Personalisation Manager
London
Currys London Campus at Waterloo (Hybrid)
Permanent
Full Time
Grade 5   We’re iD Mobile, one of the UK’s leading mobile virtual network operators. We launched in May 2015 and have over 2.6 million Pay Monthly customers. We’re pretty sure our success has a lot to do with our wide range of feature-packed plans. We offer everything from super-value Pay-as-you-go and SIM-only deals, right up to the latest smartphones from the big-name manufacturers. We’re delighted about our success so far and have very ambitious plans for the future.   iD Mobile is an exciting place to work. We’re a relatively young and dynamic start-up, and we value innovation, imagination, and creativity. If you’ve got a great idea, we’ll help you run with it. We’re passionate about finding new ways to address our customers’ needs. We’re a little different to other start-ups though, because we’re part of Currys PLC, Europe's leading electrical and mobile retailer. So, while iD Mobile has only been going for a few years, we’re part of a much bigger family.   The Senior CRM Strategy and Personalisation Manager leads the definition of the CRM strategy for the iD Mobile, working with the Head of CRM and stakeholders across the business to shape and agree it. The role leads the move from manually built customer segments to data-led, automated personalisation, and defines who we talk to, when and through which channels - working within the commercial guardrails set by the Customer Profitability and Financial Performance team to grow retention, in-life margin and long-term customer value. Role overview: As part of this role, you'll be responsbile for:  Defining and leading CRM strategy across the customer lifecycle to drive engagement, retention, and margin Owning data-driven customer targeting and segmentation Shaping contact strategy, channel mix, and hierarchy to deliver well-sequenced, effective communications Evaluating and introducing new channels such as RCS and WhatsApp Delivering a personalisation roadmap using Hightouch, Movable Ink, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud Turning commercial and profitability guardrails into audience, offer, and contact decisions Owning outbound calling lists for Sales and Retentions, aligned to broader CRM activity Line-managing the Insight and Data Planning Manager, driving a test-and-learn culture Leading CRM technology evolution, including automation and AI-driven decisioning Presenting CRM strategy and performance to senior leadership    You will need:  Experience defining and automating customer segmentation and audience strategy Strong multi-channel contact strategy and planning skills Knowledge of GDPR and PECR compliance Hands-on experience with Hightouch (or similar) and Salesforce Marketing Cloud Ability to translate data and analytics into clear targeting decisions Commercial acumen, with decisions grounded in profitability and incrementality Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams at a senior level Background in mobile, telecoms, retail, or a subscription business    Desirable:  CDP or ESP implementation experience, ideally Salesforce Marketing Cloud Familiarity with WhatsApp and RCS Experience with predictive analytics, CLV modelling, and AI-driven personalisation    Education & Experience:  Degree in business or marketing (preferred) Significant CRM, lifecycle, or customer marketing experience with a strategy, segmentation, or personalisation focus    We know our people are the secret to our success. That’s why we’re always looking for ways to reward great work. You’ll find a host of benefits designed to work for you, including:  Holiday benefits - 25 days of annual leave (plus bank holiday entitlement)  Private medical insurance Life Assurance Competitive pension scheme Access to discretionary bonus Hybrid working; our primary Currys Campus is at Waterloo (WeWork)  Why join us: Join our team and we’ll be with you every step of the way, helping you develop the career you want with new opportunities, on-going training and skills for life.   Not only can you shape your own future, but you can help take charge of ours too. As the biggest recycler and repairer of tech in the UK, we’re in a position to make a real impact on people and the planet.   Every voice has a space at our table and we’re committed to making inclusion and diversity part of everything we do, including how we strengthen our workforce. We want to make sure you have a fair opportunity to show us your talents during our application process, so if you need any additional assistance with your application please email careers@currys.co.uk and we’ll do our best to help.

rows.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Data Governance & Metadata Systems
rows.descriptionText:
Marqeta processes hundreds of billions of dollars in payments a year, in a highly regulated card-issuing environment. Data provenance, quality, and access control are foundational to meeting our regulatory obligations and the needs of critical business functions, and we treat them as engineering problems. We are hiring the engineer who will design and lead implementation of the data governance platform, with contracts, compliance requirements, and quality standards enforced in CI and in the write path.

You will be its technical lead. The role sits within the Data and ML team, which owns the data lake, the analytics platform, and our ML platform. You will work alongside the leads who define governance policy and enterprise data models, translating what they need into what the platform can enforce and telling them what it will cost. You will set technical direction across the platform team and partner with TPMs and engineering managers on planning and prioritization.

We work Flexible First. This role can be performed remotely within the United States. We’d love for you to join us!

What You'll Build

The data asset registry, and the control plane that grows around it, with the data catalog as its primary interface: the source of truth for asset state, ownership, and metadata enrichment.The contract model, and the libraries and CI modules other teams consume so contracts, compliance rules, and breaking changes are checked automatically.The emission framework that lakehouse and warehouse pipelines instrument against, and the work of getting those pipelines onto it, so lineage, freshness, and completeness are captured rather than assembled by hand.The data quality framework: where checks run, what a failure blocks, and the limits of what stewards can express in a rule.Impact analysis over the lineage graph that supports regulatory requests like deletion, purpose limitation, and subject access.Tooling data stewards use to curate at volume and work remediation, plus campaign instrumentation so coverage and blockers stay visible.Compliance automation: retention and residency controls, evidence that those controls operated, and contract-driven access controls built with our security team, who own PII classification.

What We're Looking For

You have built a control plane or policy engine that applies authoritative governance decisions across an organization rather than leaving each team to re-implement them, and you operated it in production.You can explain what a failed check does to downstream consumers and backfills, because you have had to design that behavior in CI and in the write path.You treat the engineers and stewards who use your platform as customers, and you have driven adoption of something that constrained them without authority over them.You have decided what to build, extend, and buy on a platform with a multi-year arc, and can walk through a call you got wrong.You have built controls that generate their own evidence, rather than stitching evidence together for auditors after the fact.Deep in Python, proficient in Java, and fluent in infrastructure as code.8+ years in backend or infrastructure engineering, including substantial recent work on metadata, data quality, governance, or developer platforms.

Nice-To-Haves

Experience extending a metadata platform in production, whether custom plugins, APIs, or model changes. We run DataHub Cloud.Experience working with column-level lineage at scale, with OpenLineage or otherwise.Experience working with Iceberg, Snowflake, Airflow, Kafka, Flink, Spark, or Kubernetes in production.Experience working in regulated environments (e.g., SOX, PCI-DSS).Experience working in payments or card issuing.

Compensation And Benefits

Marqeta calibrates pay to a competitive value according to working location. Compensation is aligned according to three tiers within the United States:

National: A baseline tier that applies to most of the geographic territory of the United States.Premium: Slightly elevated from the National tier, and oriented toward a narrower set of higher cost-of-living areas, such as Los Angeles CA and Seattle WAPremium Plus: A tier for the most expensive working areas, like the San Francisco Bay area and New York City.

Visit this page or consult with a recruiter to determine which tier would be applicable to you.

When determining salaries, we consider several factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior experience, and work location. The new-hire base salary range for this full-time position is:

National: 200,500 - 250,600Premium: 210,200 - 262,800Premium Plus: 220,000 - 275,000

We also believe in recognizing the contributions of our people. That's why we award annual bonuses to eligible employees, rewarding both individual performance and the success of the entire company.

Along with monetary compensation, Marqeta currently offers

Multiple health insurance optionsFlexible time off – take what you needRetirement savings program with company contribution and after tax contributionsEquity in a publicly-traded company and an Employee Stock Purchase ProgramFamily-forming benefits, fertility support and generous parental leave base salary top-upFree therapy sessions, financial and professional coaching, and legal adviceMonthly stipend to support our remote work modelAnnual “development dollars” to support our people growth and development

About Marqeta

Marqeta is on a mission to change the way money moves. We’re one of the earliest enablers of embedded finance, a market opportunity sized up in the trillions. Our card issuing platform provides unprecedented flexibility and control for companies to issue cards, authorize transactions, and manage payment operations in real time. Marqeta is powering the most well known brands in the new economy (Block, Cash App, Affirm, Instacart, Doordash, Uber, Walmart, etc). You don’t need to be a Payments expert to join the Marqeta Team, let us help you with that. This is the opportunity of a lifetime to work with innovators around the world and unlock equitable financial access for all.

Marqeta’s Values

– Solve for the Customer: With a deep understanding of our customers' business and empathy for their needs, we deliver products and services that drive their success. Earning and keeping their trust guides everything we do.

– Do What's Right: Knowing businesses and livelihoods depend on us, we pursue solutions that disrupt responsibly and deliver high-quality results that our customers count on. We own our work from start to finish.

– Simplify and Innovate: We approach challenges with curiosity and take smart risks. Innovation comes from finding better, simpler ways to achieve extraordinary outcomes.

– Win as a Team: We succeed together by embracing diverse perspectives and pushing each other to raise the bar. We lead with humility and set aside hierarchy to work as a team.

– Make it Count: We drive forward with focus and agility. With a sense of urgency and purpose, we get the job done, and done right.

Equal Employment Opportunity, Accommodations and Privacy

Marqeta is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, childbirth, or related medical conditions), veteran status or uniformed service member status, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, physical or mental disability, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information (including testing or characteristics) or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

At Hims & Hers, we know that telling empathetic, engaging, and uplifting stories about health is how we make people comfortable on the path to better health. We also know that creative is the key to an effective modern growth engine: what grows brands is brilliantly executed ideas across channels.

We’re hiring a Senior Manager of Creative Strategy to drive that engine at Hers: someone who understands and respects the creative process, and can tie it back to the analytical thinking and metrics at the core of modern brands. You’ll turn customer insight and performance data into ideas that help millions of people discover and engage with our products across Meta, YouTube, TikTok, and emerging channels.

You’ll lead a dedicated creative pod, partnering closely with editors, producers, media buyers, and creative leaders to develop, test, and scale high-performing creative across channels, and you’ll help build the systems that allow winning ideas to move quickly across categories and campaigns. The best candidates are just as comfortable reviewing performance dashboards as they are developing the next winning creative concept.

You Will

Own the creative strategy for the Hers brand across performance marketing channels, ensuring every campaign reflects the brand while driving measurable business results.Use performance data, customer insights, and market trends to develop creative hypotheses, concepts, scripts, and production-ready briefs.Shape creative that helps women feel informed, supported, and confident throughout their healthcare journey while delivering work that is emotionally resonant, stigma-free, and unmistakably Hers.Establish a high bar for creative strategy and briefing, ensuring every concept is grounded in customer insight, a clear hypothesis, and measurable success criteria.Lead a multidisciplinary creative pod, partnering closely with editors, producers, and studio teams to develop high-quality creative.Create fast, effective feedback loops across Creative, Growth, and Media Buying to continuously improve performance.Partner with Growth, Creative, and Analytics leaders to rapidly test, learn, and iterate using performance data to continuously improve creative effectiveness.Partner with Product, Clinical, Legal, and Brand teams to ensure creative accurately reflects our products while meeting regulatory requirements.Lead regular performance reviews, providing visibility into wins, key learnings, strategic pivots, and new growth opportunities.Capture and scale what works by building repeatable creative frameworks that can be adapted across products, audiences, and markets.Operate confidently within healthcare marketing guardrails, partnering across Legal, Medical, and Marketing teams.

You Have

First and foremost: a strong portfolio of performance creative that has won at scale on paid social: you can show the work, the data behind it, and the customer insight that made it win.5+ years of experience in creative strategy, content strategy, or performance creative (ideally in-house at a high-growth ecommerce or DTC brand) including experience leading teams and building creative functions.Deep expertise developing creative for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other performance channels, with a strong understanding of platform-specific creative best practices.Deep data fluency: you are comfortable in ad performance data, can identify actionable patterns yourself, and let evidence lead creative decisions.Experience managing multidisciplinary creative teams and collaborating across marketing, design, and product functions, including with remote or distributed post-production teams.Strong ownership mindset with the ability to move quickly, make decisions with imperfect information, and continuously iterate based on performance.Exceptional business acumen with the ability to connect creative decisions to customer behavior, business performance, and long-term brand growth.

Experience in telehealth, healthcare, weight loss, or another regulated or sensitive categoryExperience standing up in-house creative teams or transitioning work from external agenciesExperience adapting and localizing winning creative across international marketsFamiliarity with UGC and creator-driven production models, including remote capture

$200,000—$250,000 USD

About Us

StubHub is the world’s leading marketplace to buy and sell tickets to any live event, anywhere. Through StubHub in North America and viagogo, our international platform, we service customers in 195 countries in 33 languages and 49 available currencies. With more than 300 million tickets available annually on our platform to events around the world -- from sports to music, comedy to dance, festivals to theater -- StubHub offers the safest, most convenient way to buy or sell tickets to the most memorable live experiences. Come join our team for a front-row seat to the action.

rows.title: Staff AI Native Software Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we've tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind. Whether it's supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we're not just here to move money— we're here to move our global customers forward.

We're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders.

About the Role:

As a Staff AI Native Software Engineer, you direct AI agents to build products and solutions, rather than writing code directly. You leverage AI coding agents to replace manual tasks, build and ship entire applications and basic agents end-to-end. You're a full-stack product builder who thinks in terms of "I need to solve this customer problem" and orchestrates AI to get there. You are measured by the speed of delivery and the robustness of what you ship, not the volume of your commits.

You Will:

Build complete applications, workflow automations, and basic agents within your team's product area using AI coding agentsTranslate customer needs into buildable specifications and ship solutions from requirements through deploymentInstrument solutions to track usage and outcomes, iterating based on what you learnEvaluate AI-generated output against Remitly's standards for security, privacy, reliability, and quality before shippingParticipate in customer conversations to understand acute problems and identify automation opportunitiesDocument your approaches, effective prompts, and patterns for the team

You Have:

Proficiency with AI coding agents for end-to-end application developmentAbility to write effective prompts and iterate to achieve desired outcomesUnderstanding of full-stack applications: frontend, backend, data, and infrastructureFamiliarity with common architectural patterns (web applications, APIs, databases, queues)Awareness of fundamental design principles, common UI/UX patterns, and basic product development conceptsAbility to read and interpret basic analytics (usage metrics, conversion rates, error rates)Strong communication skills and a collaborative, learning-oriented mindset

Compensation Details. The starting base salary range for this position is typically $208,000-$260,000. In the U.S., Remitly employees are shareholders in our Company and equity is part of our total compensation plan. Your recruiter can share more information about medical benefits offered, as well as other financial benefits and total compensation components offered with this role.

Our Benefits:

Flexible paid time offHealth, dental, and vision + 401k plan with company matchingPaid parental, medical, military and family care leaveMental Health & Family Forming BenefitsEmployee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)Continuing education and travel benefits

Our Connected Work Culture: Driving Innovation, Together

At Remitly, we believe that true innovation sparks when we come together. Our Connected Work Culture fosters dynamic in-person collaboration, where ideas ignite and challenging problems find solutions faster.Under the Company's current hybrid-work expectations, employees in this position work onsite Tuesday through Thursday each week. Additional onsite attendance may be required based on business needs, and the Company may modify its hybrid-work expectations from time to time. These intentional in-office moments are vital for deepening relationships, fueling creativity, and ensuring your impact is felt where it matters most.

Remitly is an E-Verify Employer

At Remitly, we are dedicated to ensuring that our workplace offers equal employment opportunities to all employees and candidates, in full compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

Remitly is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

rows.title: Senior CRM Manager
rows.descriptionText:
We’re on a mission to make migration easy.

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

London (hybrid, 3 days in office)

CRM at Marshmallow

CRM sits within the User Experience team, helping Marshmallow build more effective, joined-up communication with our customers across the business. CRM is a meaningful driver of impact for the organisation, with clear opportunities to improve how we engage customers and measure the value of that work.

This role will help shape how CRM is used at Marshmallow by building strong foundations, enabling others to use the platform effectively, and creating the governance needed to make customer communications work better across multiple teams. We’re looking for someone who is excited by ownership, enjoys working cross-functionally, and wants to help scale CRM in a thoughtful, high-impact way. This is an individual contributor role with deep platform and governance ownership, rather than a people-management track. Your impact and progression come from the scale and quality of the systems, frameworks, and cross-team relationships you build, not from growing a team.

What You'll Be Doing

Own and evolve Marshmallow’s CRM operations capability, helping shape how the platform is used across the organisation.Build strong governance frameworks for CRM activity, including how campaigns are prioritised, sequenced, and managed across teamsEnable and support stakeholders across the business to use CRM effectively, increasing adoption while maintaining quality and consistency.Partner cross-functionally with teams across the organisation to identify opportunities, align on priorities, and improve customer communications.Use data and testing insights to inform decisions, optimise performance, and ensure CRM activity is driving measurable impactDrive high-quality campaign execution through strong operational processes, audience segmentation, scheduling, and platform management.

Who You Are

You’re a self-starter who is comfortable with a high level of autonomy and enjoys taking ownership of ambiguous, high-impact work.You’re curious and collaborative, and you like working with lots of different stakeholders to move work forward.You’re someone who believes in enabling others, not gatekeeping expertise, and you’re motivated by helping teams do better work togetherYou’re commercially minded and pragmatic, with a strong instinct for where to focus your time to unlock the most value

What You'll Bring

Experience working in CRM operations or CRM management within an in-house, tech-led business, with a strong understanding of growth-focused customer communications.Recent hands-on experience with Braze is preferable for the role, alongside practical experience building and managing CRM campaigns, segmentation, metadata, scheduling, and audience setupProven experience creating CRM governance and enabling other teams to use CRM effectively across an organisationStrong data literacy, including analysing campaign or email test performance, pulling audiences and segments, and working independently with data rather than relying entirely on analyst support.Confidence in using data tools or AI-assisted analysis to generate insights and support decision-making.

Perks of the job

Bonus scheme designed to reward high performancePrivate medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with OlivaPersonal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a yearMonthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose25 days holiday plus bank holidays4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year

We are able to offer visa sponsorship for this position.

Our process

Initial call with a member from our Talent Team (30 mins)Past Experience interview with Hiring Manager (60 mins)Onsite case study interview with a couple of the team (90 mins)Culture interview (60 mins)

Diversity of thought

We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply.

rows.title: Associate Director, Product Development Research
rows.descriptionText:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

We are looking for an experienced product research leader to support product development across WHOOP's hardware, wearables, algorithms, sensors, and advanced technology portfolio. You’ll manage a team of research staff that own end-to-end research for early-stage innovation, physical products and apparel, and algorithm development out of WHOOP Labs Boston. You will also contribute to the broader WHOOP Labs research strategy, bringing your research expertise to the Human Subjects Research leadership team.

The ideal candidate brings experience leading researchers in a fast-paced technical product environment, with particular preference for experience supporting hardware, sensors, wearables, or other physical products through iterative development cycles. This position is in-person in Boston, MA 5 days per week with travel 2-3 times per year.

Responsibilities

Develop, manage and scale the human subjects research team with an emphasis on professional development and coaching at multiple levels of seniority.Champion research integrity, including ensuring that data collection tools and team practices are optimized for the fast-paced, complex nature of product innovation work.Advocate for the needs of your team and their work to unlock high-volume, high-quality research on site at WHOOP Labs Boston.Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of program initiatives and track progress towards goals.Collaborate closely with other research leaders to build a strong culture across WHOOP Labs and ensure strong ways of working between research execution and operations teams.Partner with stakeholders across signal engineering, machine learning, hardware, apparel, and product to coach on working with HSR and facilitate effective collaboration between teams.Champion of culture of team trust, support, and communication, emphasizing the complexities of conducting public-facing, high-engagement activities.Partner with the Associate Director of Lab Operations and Associate Director of WHOOP Labs Doha to build the WHOOP Labs brand across the global organization.Reports to the Sr. Director of Human Subjects Research

Qualifications

5+ years of experience in a Research Manager, Research Lead, or similar human subjects research leadership role within a technical product development environment.2+ years of direct people management experience, with a demonstrated ability to coach and develop researchers across disciplines and levels.Experience supporting research for consumer hardware, sensors, wearables, connected devices, or other physical products strongly preferred.Familiarity with physical product development processes, including early-stage prototyping, iterative testing, hardware development timelines, and/or feasibility explorations.Data-driven approach to strategic planning, comfortable reviewing metrics and identifying ways to measure research ROI and impactExperience collaborating across multiple functions including engineering, privacy/legal, research, recruitment, and product.Passion for building a strong team culture and coaching future research leaders.Strong organizational, communication, and documentation skills.Passion for health, wellness, and WHOOP’s mission.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $140,000 - $180,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

rows.title: Senior Manager, Field Quality
rows.descriptionText:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP believes in the power of humans to transform how they feel, perform and age; we serve the aspiring!

WHOOP is seeking a Senior Manager, Field Quality to lead field quality across our Hardware and Accessories & Apparel (A&A) portfolio and oversee our Failure Analysis function and Quality Lab. Reporting to the Vice President of Hardware Quality, you will translate the broader quality strategy into scalable programs, operating mechanisms, and measurable outcomes that improve product quality and the member experience. You will connect field performance, member feedback, failure analysis, manufacturing and supplier data, and product insights to identify emerging risks, drive root cause and corrective action, and ensure learnings from the field influence future product and process decisions.

This is a highly cross-functional leadership role requiring both deep quality expertise and the ability to lead through others. You will build and develop a high-performing team, establish clear quality metrics and escalation mechanisms, and partner across Supplier Quality, NPI Quality, Hardware Engineering, Accessories and Apparel, Reliability Engineering, Supply Chain, Global Operations, Membership Services, and our manufacturing and supplier network to drive continuous improvement across the WHOOP product ecosystem.

Responsibilities

Lead the field quality strategy and execution across Hardware and Accessories & Apparel, establishing KPIs, operating mechanisms, and cross-functional programs that identify emerging quality issues, prioritize risk, and drive measurable improvements in field performance and member experience.Own the Failure Analysis function, Early Field Failure Analysis (EFFA) program, and Quality Lab, establishing scalable processes and technical capabilities to rapidly characterize failures, determine root cause, and translate findings into actionable design, manufacturing, supplier, and process improvements.Build a closed-loop quality system connecting the field back to product development and manufacturing, synthesizing field returns, member feedback, reliability results, manufacturing trends, supplier performance, and failure analysis insights to identify systemic issues and influence upstream quality strategy and product decisions.Lead cross-functional resolution of complex and high-impact quality issues, partnering with Analytics, Supplier Quality, NPI Quality, Hardware Engineering, Accessories and Apparel, Reliability Engineering, Supply Chain, Global Operations, Membership Services, contract manufacturers, and suppliers to establish containment, root cause, corrective and preventive actions, and verification of effectiveness.Establish data-driven field quality management and executive visibility, defining metrics, escalation criteria, and review mechanisms in partnership with Analytics that enable teams and leadership to understand quality performance, make informed trade-offs, anticipate risk, and focus resources on the highest-impact opportunities.Build, lead, and develop a high-performing Field Quality and Failure Analysis team, setting clear priorities and performance expectations, developing technical and leadership capability, and creating scalable systems that enable the organization to operate with increasing autonomy, speed, rigor, and accountability.

 10+ years of experience in field quality, quality engineering, failure analysis, reliability, manufacturing quality, or a related discipline supporting consumer electronics, wearable technology, apparel/accessories, medical devices, or other complex consumer products.Demonstrated experience leading teams and complex quality programs across multiple products or product categories, with the ability to translate broad quality objectives into clear priorities, operating mechanisms, and measurable outcomes.Deep expertise in structured problem-solving and failure analysis methodologies, including root cause analysis, 5 Why, 8D, FMEA, DOE, Pareto analysis, CAPA, and related quality tools.Experience building or leading failure analysis capabilities and laboratories, including the effective application of analytical techniques and equipment to characterize product failures and drive root cause determination.Strong analytical acumen with experience using field performance, return, manufacturing, supplier, and customer/member data to identify trends, assess risk, prioritize investigations, and influence decisions.Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives and influence technical and business stakeholders across Engineering, Product Development, Operations, Supply Chain, manufacturing partners, and suppliers in a fast-paced global environment.Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $200,000 - $245,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

rows.title: Senior Product Sales Specialist - Gas & LNG
rows.descriptionText:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.

For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.

Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.

By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.

This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.

Wood Mackenzie

Intelligence Connected

WoodMac.com

Wood Mackenzie Brand Video

Wood Mackenzie Values

Inclusive – we succeed togetherTrusting – we choose to trust each otherCustomer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisionsFuture Focused – we accelerate changeCurious – we turn knowledge into action

Wood Mackenzie is looking for an enthusiastic, talented, and ambitious sales professional to join our growing Gas & LNG Sales team. The role is to partner with the Account Management and New Logo Sales teams to further identify, grow and embed our Gas & LNG solutions across our existing customer base and new logos. The role will be responsible for growing our Gas & LNG busi

ness across the Americas region.

The Product Sales Specialist (PSS) will report into the Head of Gas & LNG Specialist Sales. You will be instrumental in assisting the sales team achieve its sales targets as well as ensuring knowledge transfer across the business.

We are looking to diversify our talent pool and bring in best practices from across the energy industry to help us achieve our ambitious growth targets. This is your opportunity to grow your brand within the business and externally while working with one of the industry's leading energy intelligence providers.

Main Responsibilities

Product and sector expertise:Develop a deep understanding of the value of Wood Mackenzie’s Gas & LNG solutions and how they support customer decision-making across natural gas, LNG, market fundamentals, commercial strategy, analytics, and investment workflows.Develop and maintain a strong understanding of global and regional gas and LNG markets, including supply, demand, trade flows, pricing dynamics, infrastructure, and market participants.Act as an internal ambassador for the Gas & LNG business, supporting communication of product enhancements and market developments across the organisation and working closely with Sales, Customer Success, Customer Education, Product, Research, Marketing, and Consulting teams.Represent Wood Mackenzie at industry events, conferences, webinars, and customer meetings as a recognised subject-matter expert.Growth mindset:Partner closely with Account Management colleagues to identify and develop new commercial opportunities within existing customer accounts by understanding client workflows, uncovering unmet needs, identifying new buying centres, and demonstrating the breadth of Wood Mackenzie’s Gas & LNG solutions to address those requirements.Collaborate with New Logo Sales teams to support new business opportunities across the sales cycle, including qualification, discovery, needs analysis, solution positioning, and commercial validation.Deliver product demonstrations and value-based presentations that clearly articulate how Wood Mackenzie’s data, analysis, and workflows solve customer challenges and support critical business decisions.Build trusted advisor relationships with stakeholders across energy producers, LNG developers, utilities, traders, financial institutions, infrastructure operators, and energy service providers.Territory planning:Develop, regularly maintain, and own a sales plan for your territory. Identify key growth markets, strategic accounts, expansion opportunities, and potential risks to effectively prioritise your activities.Collaborate with Account Management, New Logo Sales, Customer Success, Research, Consulting, and other Product Sales Specialists to build and execute account strategies that drive sustainable revenue growth.Maintain an accurate pipeline and opportunity forecast within CRM systems and contribute to regular business reviews and planning activities. Product development collaboration:Work closely with the Product and Research teams to help shape the Gas & LNG product development roadmap based on customer feedback, market trends, customer workflow knowledge, and competitive intelligence.Act as the voice of the customer internally, helping ensure our solutions continue to evolve in line with changing market needs.Support the launch and commercial adoption of new Gas & LNG products, services, datasets, and workflow solutions.
Qualifications

Significant experience in client-facing, pre-sales, business development, account management, consulting, or solution specialist roles.Strong knowledge of natural gas and LNG markets, including market fundamentals, commercial dynamics, trading, investment, or strategic planning processes.Experience engaging with oil & gas companies, LNG developers, natural gas producers, midstream and infrastructure operators, and a strong understanding of their commercial, strategic, and investment workflows.Demonstrated ability to communicate complex market analysis and data-driven insights to commercial and technical audiences.Proven commercial track record supporting revenue growth and acting as a trusted subject-matter expert with customers.Self-motivated, energetic, and results-oriented, with a strong focus on delivering customer value.Proven ability to collaborate effectively across multiple internal teams to achieve commercial success.Strong organisational, planning, and prioritisation skills with the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.Intellectual curiosity and a genuine interest in how data, analytics, and market intelligence help customers solve complex business challenges.Experience using CRM systems such as Salesforce is desirable.Experience within the natural gas, LNG, energy analytics, market intelligence, or commodity markets sectors is strongly preferred.

Equal Opportunities

rows.title: Senior Solutions Architect | DX
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

DX'sSolutions Engineering Team at Atlassian is seeking a highly skilled and passionate Solutions Architect to be a key driver in the successful adoption and long-term growth of the DX product ( getdx.com ). You will serve as the technical authority for our customers after the sale, dedicated to solving our Enterprise customers' most complex implementation challenges and ensuring they realize maximum value from our solutions.

This role requires you to be based in the UK.

Responsibilities

Lead Technical Implementation: Partner closely with Customer Success Managers to drive and lead all technical aspects of the post-sales lifecycle, including onboarding, complex integrations, and system architecture, ensuring a seamless transition from evaluation to production.Architecture and Strategy: Lead technical deep-dive sessions to understand a customer’s long-term engineering goals, mapping the DX platform into their existing workflows and organizational structures.Custom Solution Engineering: Design and build tailored technical solutions—often creating integrations or workflows that don't yet exist—to connect the DX APIs with complex client environments and satisfy unique business requirements.Consultative Implementation: Ask thoughtful, detailed questions to navigate the nuances of a customer’s engineering processes, branching strategies, and deployment pipelines to ensure the platform is configured for optimal performance.Trusted Advisory: Act as the technical "North Star" for Enterprise clients, providing strategic guidance on best practices for developer experience (DX) analytics, deployment methodologies, and cultural transformation.Feedback Loop: Capture and synthesize technical feedback and friction points from active customers to collaborate closely with the Product and Engineering teams, directly informing the product roadmap and feature enhancements.


Qualifications

Technical Skills:

Exposure to programming (Ruby/Rails or Python) with a solid understanding of APIs and RESTful services.Experience with version control systems like Git and the GitHub CLI.Familiarity with SQL (Postgres preferred) and the ability to leverage data for analytical solutioning.Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, deployment workflows, and branching strategies.


Consultative Skills

Excellent communication and presentation skills, with extensive experience leading high-stakes technical workshops and executive-level discussions.Ability to translate complex technical architecture into clear business outcomes and value.Strong organizational skills to manage the technical delivery and resource requirements across multiple Enterprise implementations simultaneously.


Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits .

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh .

rows.descriptionText:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Responsibilities

About the role

Atlassian is looking for a Lead Product Designer to join the Growth Platform team, the organization responsible for Atlassian’s front door: www.atlassian.com

Millions of teams visit our website to discover Atlassian and find the products and solutions that can help them work better. We’re evolving that experience from a collection of standalone pages into cohesive, end-to-end customer journeys grounded in clear customer intent and JTBD, and shaped by AI-first experiences.

As a Lead Product Designer, you’ll play a critical role in defining that future. Partnering with another Lead Designer, Product Management, Engineering, Content, and Growth Analytics, you’ll lead both strategy and execution across some of our highest-impact growth experiences.

You’ll put design in the driver’s seat: shaping the evolution of our website and design system, establishing a high bar for visual and interaction craft, and creating experiences that improve engagement, activation, and long-term customer value.

What You’ll Do

You’ll work across the Growth Platform portfolio, setting direction and leading design across several core areas:

Modernization & craft leadership: Elevate the overall look, feel, and narrative of our website to reflect a modern, premium, AI-first technology company. Set an exceptional bar for visual hierarchy, typography, motion, grid systems, responsive design, and interaction quality. Help evolve our website design system to create greater cohesion, quality, and scalability across the experience.User engagement & activation: Design innovative landing, discovery, and onboarding experiences that communicate product value, capture customer intent, and turn interest into meaningful product engagement. Use experimentation and customer insights to improve conversion and early-lifecycle activation.Journey-led architecture & JTBD: Help shift our website strategy from disconnected pages and templates toward cohesive, intent- and persona-driven journeys. Architect experiences that guide customers seamlessly from discovery and evaluation through trial, adoption, and deeper engagement with Atlassian.AI-powered experiences & ways of working: Explore how AI can reshape both how customers discover Atlassian and how we design and build for them. Design for emerging AI-powered discovery and answer-engine experiences, ensuring Atlassian’s products and content are structured and experienced effectively across generative search surfaces. Partner closely with Engineering to prototype new AI-first experiences and evolve the tools and workflows we use to rapidly design, test, and publish experiences on the site.Cross-functional influence & mentorship: Partner with leaders across Design, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Content, and Analytics to shape strategy and champion a design-led approach to growth. Mentor other designers, elevate the quality of critique and decision-making, and help raise the craft bar across the broader Growth organization.


Candidate ProfileWhat You Bring

You have 10+ years of product design experience, with a track record of leading complex, high-visibility web or digital product initiatives from strategy through execution.

Exceptional visual & interaction craft: You bring an exceptional craft bar and a strong point of view on contemporary digital experiences. You’re highly skilled in visual design, typography, spatial layout, motion and micro-interactions, responsive design, and design systems, and you know how to turn those elements into experiences that feel cohesive, distinctive, and polished.AI-first prototyping & tooling: You’re comfortable using AI as part of how you think, design, and make. You have experience prototyping in code and using AI-powered tools to move quickly from ideas to working experiences. You are familiar with generative UI, AI-assisted workflows, personalization, and designing AI-native experiences.Journey-driven systems thinking: You think beyond individual pages and features, designing interconnected experiences and scalable frameworks grounded in customer intent, personas, journeys, information architecture, and Jobs to Be Done.Strategic vision & comfort with ambiguity: You can take complex business goals and ambiguous problem spaces and turn them into compelling future-state visions. You use storytelling and prototyping to make ideas tangible, build alignment, and translate long-term direction into actionable roadmaps and near-term opportunities.Data-informed & outcome-oriented: You connect design decisions to measurable customer and business outcomes across acquisition, conversion, engagement, and activation. You partner with Analytics and Research to form and validate hypotheses, while knowing when data should inform the experience and when strong design judgment should lead.Collaborative leadership & influence: You build trust across disciplines and levels, communicate a clear design point of view, and bring others along with you. You’re comfortable influencing senior and executive stakeholders and partnering deeply with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Content, Research, and Analytics.


What Would Set You Apart

Experience designing high-traffic marketing websites, web platforms, digital storefronts, or other large-scale customer-facing web experiences.Experience working in Growth, experimentation, conversion optimization, or lifecycle activation.Experience operating across organizational boundaries, where influence, alignment, and systems thinking matter as much as direct ownership.

Position Summary

Two Sigma is a leading quantitative investment management and trading firm. The company applies a scientific approach to investing, combining cutting-edge technology, artificial intelligence, data science, and quantitative research with rigorous human inquiry to capitalize on market opportunities and deliver alpha for investors.

Our team of engineers, quantitative researchers and data scientists looks beyond the traditional to test hypotheses and develop creative solutions to some of the world’s most complex economic problems.

We are looking for a quantitative researcher with an excellent background in statistical techniques, machine learning, and data analysis. In this role, you will navigate the full research process and apply a rigorous scientific approach to design sophisticated investment models for trading a variety of global markets.

You Will Take On The Following Responsibilities

Use a rigorous scientific method to develop sophisticated trading models and shape our insights into how the markets will behaveApply machine learning to a vast array of datasetsCreate and test complex investment ideas and partner with our engineers to test your hypothesesJoin our reading circles to stay up to date on the latest research papers in your fieldAttend academic seminars to learn from thought leaders from top universitiesShare insights from conferences focused on statistics, machine learning, and data science

You Should Possess The Following Qualifications

Degree in a technical or quantitative discipline, like statistics, mathematics, physics, electrical engineering, or computer science (all levels welcome, from bachelor’s to doctorate)Intermediate skills in at least one programming language (like C, C++, Java, or Python)Understanding of the ins and outs of machine learning algorithms—and can tweak them as neededExperience with applied machine learning to real-world datasetsPublished your work in journals and/or have presented at conferences

The base pay for this role will be between $165,000 and $325,000. Discretionary bonus can be a significant portion of total compensation. Actual compensation for successful candidates will be carefully determined based on a number of factors, including their skills, qualifications and experience.
